title: Account Director
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Responsibilities:

  • Verwalten und Überwachen von Projekten vom Start bis zum Abschluss mit Fokus auf Timing, Budget und Qualität.
  • Erstellen und Überwachen von Budgets, Forecasts und Ressourcenplänen.
  • Kundeninteraktion pflegen, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und das Projektmanagement entsprechend anzupassen.
  • Arbeiten in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams, um unterschiedliche Perspektiven zu integrieren.
  • Entwicklung und Implementierung klarer Abläufe, um transparente und verlässliche Kommunikation sicherzustellen.
  • Status quo hinterfragen und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.
  • Offenheit für KI und neue Technologien zeigen, um innovative Tools und Arbeitsweisen zu erkunden.

Qualifications:

  • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Begleitung von vielseitigen Projekten.
  • Fähigkeit zur sicheren Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Affinität für Zahlen sowie Budget- und Ressourcenmanagement.
  • Freude an der Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.
  • Bereitschaft, in einem der Standorte Berlin oder Düsseldorf in Vollzeit zu arbeiten.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Account Director - Financiers
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.


Key Headlines
  • First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
  • Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
  • Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
  • Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
  • UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
  • Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

    • Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
  • Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
  • Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
  • Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
  • Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
  • Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.
  • Collaborate with key financier contacts to understand their short, medium and long-term retention strategies, ensuring Keyloop is the partner of choice.
  • Keep product/sales presentation material and POS assets current and available on shared portals.
  • Feed back market intelligence on competitor retention and AI-based offerings to sharpen internal positioning.

    • Skillset and Experience required
  • Experience within the automotive sector, ideally within automotive finance (captive or independent financier).
  • Direct experience working with captive or independent financiers — understanding of their commercial models, customer lifecycle and retention priorities, and relationships with dealer networks. Financier-side experience is strongly favourable.
  • Thorough understanding of the automotive finance customer lifecycle, including origination, contract management, end-of-contract customer journey, and retention and trade cycle management.
  • Experience selling SaaS/cloud-based solutions.
  • Proven track record in account management, ideally managing senior corporate stakeholders within financiers.
  • User or provider experience with customer retention solutions, ideally within automotive finance.
  • Customer- and outcomes-focused, with the maturity and diplomacy to manage engagement across financier stakeholder levels — from operational through to senior commercial/strategic.
  • Able to implement a professional, structured sales approach using MEDDPIC (Keyloop's preferred sales methodology) — covering Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain and Champion — alongside use of Salesforce.
  • Self-driven, ambitious, resilient, highly motivated, competitive, resourceful, excellent communication skills, especially around listening, questioning – politely assertive.
  • Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in another European language — such as French, Spanish, Italian, or German — is preferred.
  • Highly organised within a process-oriented environment. Computer literate and familiarity with SF.com an advantage.
  • Fluency with AI tools such as Claude and Copilot is a plus but not mandatory.
    • Why join us? We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. An inclusive environment to thrive We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day. Be rewarded for your efforts We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials. We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. "At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

title: Account Executive (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter.

Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

  • Negotiate & close: Du führst Verhandlungen auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen, gehst souverän mit Einwänden um und bringst Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

  • Grow your accounts: Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifizierst weiteres Potenzial in bestehenden Accounts. Dein Ziel sind nicht nur gewonnene Deals, sondern nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

  • Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter.

Inspire us by

  • Sales Experience: Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales mit und hast bereits eigenständig Kunden gewonnen und Deals abgeschlossen. Erfahrung mit Small und Medium Accounts ist ein Plus.

  • Ambition & Drive: Du setzt dir hohe Ziele, willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird.

  • Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und kommunizierst souverän mit Entscheidern auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen.

  • Commercial Mindset: Du verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und Kundenbedürfnisse und kannst daraus relevante Sales Opportunities entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datenbasiert.

  • Growth Mindset: Du willst kontinuierlich besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um.

  • Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sprichst fließend Englisch.

  • Mobility: Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %).

What we offer

  • Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen.

  • Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Own your numbers: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln.

  • Work smarter with AI: KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung.

  • Flexibility & Mobility: Drei feste Office-Tage in München-Thalkirchen, flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Bike-Leasing oder Fahrtkostenzuschuss.

  • Team & Culture: Eine ambitionierte Teamkultur, kurze Wege und gemeinsame Erfolge bei Teamevents und OKR-Partys.

  • Health & Balance: EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

  • Best-in-class setup: Mac oder Windows, ergonomisches Equipment und alles, was du für effizientes Arbeiten im Office und Homeoffice brauchst.

  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst.

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Still here?
Dann könnten wir ein perfektes Match sein!

Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen.

title: Account Executive - Berlin (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung 

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt – und Du digitalisierst ihn, Praxis für Praxis. Als Account Executive (x/f/m) in Berlin führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. 

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb: Du begleitest den gesamten Sales-Prozess – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss

  • Umsatz & Wachstum: Du bist verantwortlich für Deine Pipeline, den Umsatz (MRR), Beziehungen und das Wachstum in Deiner Region 

  • Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse von Ärzt:innen, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und begeisterst sie mit unserer digitalen Lösung

  • Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie

 

Dein Profil

  • Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise im Außendienst und B2B-Bereich)

  • Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du glänzt mit exzellenten Akquise- und Pitching-Skills

  • Energie & Überzeugungskraft: Du hast ein hohes Energielevel, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und überzeugst mit Deinem sicheren und professionellen Auftreten

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, hast ein hohes Organisationsgeschick und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) ausdrücken

    Für unsere internen Trainings, All-Hands und den Austausch mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist es hilfreich, wenn du Englisch gut verstehen kannst. Falls du dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

  • Flexibilität & Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt: direkt bei Ärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein Klasse B ist vorausgesetzt

 

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 

Was wir Dir bieten 

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Einen Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1%-Regelung

  • Eine private Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das 1 Monat extra Elternzeit u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner moka.care

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

 

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team, das gewinnen will. Du auch? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil der Doctolib-Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier. 

 

Der Interview-Prozess  

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 25')

  2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Teamlead) (remote - 60')

  3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

  4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

 

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Berlin

  • zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

 

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Agicap Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France. Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies. We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024. These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world. We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure! Home page Customer Stories Our Values

About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.

As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.


You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
  • Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

title: Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | Remote, Deutschland
descriptionHtml:
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort Remote Deutschland: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice in einer Region mit vielen Steuerkanzleien. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das ganze deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 Remote: Homeoffice und Kundentermine in deiner Region.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

title: Account Executive - Strategic
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re building a founding team of Strategic Account Executives in London.

Strategic accounts at Baseten are the largest and fastest-growing AI companies in the world. These are the teams defining the future of what AI products and services look like. These accounts can scale rapidly from one token to billions of tokens in a matter of weeks. This role owns these relationships, working directly with founders and engineering leaders on mission-critical and large-scale-AI problems in production—and shaping what we build next.

This is a highly technical sale. You’ll trade opinions on the latest open-source model releases, run fast and nuanced evaluations alongside customer engineering teams, and often pulling in SMEs from applied research to infrastructure engineers to win. You’ll bring tight sales fundamentals and process discipline, while maintaining flexibility and creativity in how you run each cycle.

This role is pioneering what sales looks like at the bleeding-edge of technology sales. This is a front row seat to the most consequential decisions made at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence. There is no faster place to learn and make an immediate impact.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a focused portfolio of high-growth, strategic AI-native accounts end to end — from technical evaluation and initial workload landing through expansion as inference usage scales.

  • Lead technical evaluations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through close. Bring strong sales fundamentals and process discipline, while staying flexible and creative in how you run each sales cycle.

  • Build trusted relationships with founders and technical leaders, becoming a credible partner on model, infrastructure, and inference decisions.

  • Orchestrate stakeholders across applied research, engineering, and leadership to win technical evaluations and solve customer problems.

  • Bring customer signal back to product, shaping roadmap priorities through the needs and patterns you see in the field.

  • Stay close after close: help customers expand from an initial workload into additional use cases across the organization.

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of sales experience in infrastructure, developer tools, data, or another consumption business, with a record of closing complex technical deals.

  • Proven net-new experience selling complex technical products in fast-moving environments.

  • Strong sales fundamentals across discovery, multi-threading, champion-building, and deal momentum.

  • Genuine curiosity for open-source models and the AI infrastructure landscape. You follow model releases and can hold your own with engineers.

  • Highly dynamic: comfortable when a deal goes off-script, able to meet customers where they are, and willing to change your approach without losing rigor.

  • Strong technical project management: you can run a thorough evaluation across multiple workstreams and create clarity and direction for Baseten to win..

  • Proven ability to sell internally, earning engineering time, aligning leadership, and getting cross-functional teams to move

  • Scrappy, low-ego, collaborative operator. You run toward ambiguous problems, create structure where none exists, and earn internal support without relying on rigid swim lanes.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

title: Account Executive (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The opportunity

This is a new-logo role. You'll win large warehousing, logistics and industrial property owners, operators and FM organisations across the UK that don't work with us yet. You'll run the full sales cycle, from the first cold conversation to signature. Once an account goes live, Customer Success takes it from there.

You'll work a defined UK territory of named target accounts. You'll have reference customers that carry real weight in the supply chain sector, and direct access to the CRO and CEO, who will join your deals when it matters.

What you'll do

Build your own pipeline

  • Build and work a named list of target accounts across UK warehousing, logistics and industrial real estate, with a clear view of why each one should change and what it would take.

  • Generate most of your own pipeline. Business development and marketing will help, but you're the hunter.

  • Reach C-suite and operational leaders through outbound, industry networks, events, partners and existing customer relationships.

Win complex enterprise deals

  • Run the full cycle: discovery, business case, evaluation, negotiation and signature.

  • Replace incumbent CAFM/IWMS platforms, in-house systems and spreadsheet-based processes.

  • Navigate buying groups, procurement, IT security and legal without losing momentum.

  • Qualify rigorously with MEDDICC and use mutual action plans on every live deal.

  • Shape the commercial structure of each deal: pricing, multi-year terms, phased rollouts and land-and-expand entry points.

Lead with the business case

  • Earn access to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Heads of Real Estate and operations leaders.

  • Sell on operating cost, compliance exposure, portfolio performance and risk, not on a feature demo.

  • Bring in Presales, Product and executive sponsors on the deals that justify it.

Forecast with discipline

  • Keep a forecast you can defend line by line and a CRM that reflects reality.

  • Disqualify early and visibly. Time spent on a real deal is worth more than a pipeline that only looks full.

  • Share competitive and market insight with product, marketing and pricing.

What we're looking for

  • A true hunter. You've built a career winning new logos, not managing existing accounts.

  • 5+ years in B2B software sales, at an established, credible software business.

  • Enterprise deal experience. You've closed complex six-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, procurement and IT security reviews. This isn't high-volume transactional sales.

  • Sector knowledge in warehousing, logistics, industrial or supply chain, or in facilities management software. If your background is in commercial real estate, we'd want to see a very strong sales track record.

  • A track record you can walk us through. What you sold, to whom, how you got in, and what you said. We value an honest career story over polished numbers. If you've had a quarter or a year that didn't go to plan, we want to hear what you did about it.

  • C-level credibility. You can build a business case and defend it in front of a finance audience.

  • MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework, used in practice.

  • Understanding of the UK market, and the energy to build something as the new-business team grows.

What we offer

  • Base salary, uncapped commission and accelerators.

  • Dedicated Solution Consulting, BD support and marketing programmes aimed at your segment.

  • A real path into enterprise sales leadership as the team scales.

  • Remote working, with roughly monthly time together in London or Birmingham.

Logistics

  • Location: UK, remote (England or Wales preferred)

  • Travel: roughly monthly to London or Birmingham

  • Employment type: Full-time

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Ad operations manager
descriptionHtml:
About Adcities

Adcities is redefining outdoor advertising by bringing digital-level targeting, measurement and attribution to the physical world.

Our platform leverages real-world signals, mobility data and contextual intelligence to deliver scalable, measurable OOH campaigns across global markets.

We partner with leading publishers and brands such as L’Oréal, Coca-Cola, Telefónica, to unlock the full potential of real-world media through technology.

We are present in the US, LATAM and now accelerating our international expansion in EMEA.

The role

As the ad operations manager, you will be responsible for planning, managing, and executing Adcities' advertising campaigns, implementing our ad manager platform utilities, and supervising campaign performance KPIs. Based in Paris, you will serve as the primary point of contact for agencies, clients, and creative teams once a deal is closed, ensuring a seamless customer journey from technical onboarding to final reconciliation.

This is a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of account management and technical operations.

Tasks

What you will do

  • Campaign planning: lead the planning and execution of campaigns focusing on our contextual targeting capabilities.
  • Demand-side relations: act as the direct interlocutor for agencies and clients to implement campaigns closed by the sales team.
  • Supply-side operations: coordinate and manage relationships with media owners (OOH specialists, retail supports, etc.) to ensure correct campaign execution and inventory availability.
  • Document management: oversee key documentation for campaign coordination, including budgets, purchase orders (POs), technical specifications, and final creative assets.
  • End-to-end monitoring: control the full lifecycle of the campaign, ensuring correct data reconciliation for billing and payment management upon completion.
  • Analysis & reporting: support the sales team in presenting post-campaign reports, analyzing results, and verifying the fulfillment of established KPIs.
  • Tech stack management: efficiently manage our operations tools holded (Financial ERP), Adcities ad manager (proprietary technology), and Jira (project management).
  • International communication: maintain constant interaction with our global engineering and product teams to ensure technical alignment across time zones.
  • Operational efficiency: proactively seek process automation and alternative solutions to improve workflow autonomy.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in ad operations, account management, or technical campaign management within digital media or AdTech.
  • Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem (programmatic, contextual, measurement) and OOH/DOOH market dynamics.
  • Technical proficiency: experience managing technical integrations and working alongside engineering or product teams.
  • Analytical mindset: excellent analytical skills, comfortable with performance data and reporting.
  • Communication: fluent in French and English. Knowledge of additional European languages is a plus.
  • Soft skills: highly organized, autonomous, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

A plus

  • Prior exposure to OOH or DOOH advertising
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
  • Familiarity with the French OOH/DOOH media landscape and key local publishers
  • Existing network within the French media agencies or brands

Benefits

Why join Adcities

  • Join a fast-growing Adtech startup at an early stage of its French expansion, with real opportunities to grow as the team scales
  • Work at the intersection of outdoor, data and AI as the category is being redefined
  • Work closely with experienced founders and a senior leadership team with a strong track record of building successful ventures
  • A competitive package
  • A company culture that is ambitious, transparent and genuinely international

title: After Sales Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
WaschMal ist ein moderner Dienstleister für professionelle Wäschereilösungen und Textilmanagement. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Berufsbekleidung und betrieblichen Textilien effizient, hygienisch und wirtschaftlich zu verwalten.

Unser Leistungsspektrum umfasst die Bereitstellung, Pflege, Reinigung, Reparatur und den Austausch von Berufsbekleidung sowie die individuelle Betreuung unserer Kunden durch ein leistungsstarkes Netzwerk aus Wäschereien, Herstellern und Servicepartnern.

Durch intelligente Servicekonzepte helfen wir unseren Kunden, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, Kosten zu reduzieren und höchste Qualitäts- und Hygienestandards sicherzustellen. Dabei stehen Kundennähe, Zuverlässigkeit und nachhaltige Partnerschaften im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.

Als stark wachsendes Unternehmen setzen wir auf innovative Lösungen, persönliche Betreuung und den konsequenten Ausbau unseres Partnernetzwerks. Unser Ziel ist es, für unsere Kunden der bevorzugte Ansprechpartner für moderne Wäschereidienstleistungen und professionelles Textilmanagement zu sein.

Aufgaben

  • Vertragsimplementierung: Du übernimmst nach Vertragsabschluss die zentrale Verantwortung für die Implementierung neuer Kundenprojekte und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen.

  • Projektmanagement: Du koordinierst alle notwendigen Schritte und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

  • Partnerkoordination: Du organisierst und koordinierst unsere externen Waschpartner und stellst sicher, dass alle benötigten Dienstleistungen und Produkte verfügbar sind

  • Projektverfolgung: Du behältst den Überblick über zahlreiche parallel laufende Projekte, erkennst Handlungsbedarf und sorgst für eine konsequente Nachverfolgung.

  • Reklamationsmanagement: Du kümmerst dich eigenständig um Reklamationen beim Onboarding, koordinierst Lösungen und führst proaktiv Feedbackgespräche, um Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen.

  • CRM-Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst relevante Informationen, Gesprächsinhalte und Projektfortschritte in unserem CRM-System und stellst eine zuverlässige Nachverfolgung sicher.

Qualifikation

  • Idealerweise hast du eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bereits erste Berufserfahrung im After Sales, Projektmanagement oder Vertrieb. Auch Quereinsteiger*innen sind willkommen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.

  • Du besitzt Durchsetzungsvermögen und scheust dich nicht davor, Dinge aktiv anzustoßen und konsequent nachzuverfolgen.

  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und trittst gegenüber Kunden und Geschäftspartnern souverän auf.

  • Du hast Organisationstalent und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office ist für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Kunden oder Partnern mit.

Benefits

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen.

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit direktem Einfluss auf unsere Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

title: Agent Shop and Stations - Victoria Coach Station (On-site)
descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

We're looking for motivated and driven Agent Shops and Stations for Victoria Coach Station (On-site) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success.

About the Role

  • Act as the face of FlixBus UK at one of the UK's busiest coach stations, Victoria Coach Station, delivering a welcoming and seamless customer experience from journey start to departure
  • Assist existing and prospective customers with ticketing queries, journey information, operational updates, cancellations, and delays
  • Drive revenue by selling tickets and promoting relevant FlixBus add-ons to passengers
  • Support drivers and customers by conducting ticket checks, passenger check-ins, and ensuring smooth boarding processes
  • Carry out vehicle audits and quality checks before departure to help maintain service standards and enhance the customer journey
  • Coordinate with station partners and TfL staff to manage live departures and ensure the efficient flow of passengers through the station
  • Respond to incidents, disruptions, delays, and cancellations, keeping customers informed and minimising network disruption while helping passengers continue their journeys smoothly

About You

  • Enjoy providing great customer service and have the ability to deal with difficult situations whilst remaining professional at all times
  • Have previous experience of working in a customer-facing role
  • Possess excellent communication skills
  • Are able to work on a flexible rota including shifts from Monday to Sunday between 06:00 and 00:00
  • Thrive in high pressure, fast moving and dynamic environments
  • See yourself as proactive, motivated, autonomous and have a desire to grow with a business
  • Are able to prioritize key tasks and make decisions quickly on sometimes, limited information

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Opportunity

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs).

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.

About the Role

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.
  • Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.
  • Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.
  • Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
  • A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
  • An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.
  • Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.
  • Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.
  • Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

CEPA Study Abroad is a U.S. based study abroad organization that partners with schools to develop and run custom faculty-led programs in over 40 countries. Our main administrative offices are in Besigheim, Germany and Strasbourg, France. CEPA also partners with the CEPA Foundation to provide service-learning opportunities in Costa Rica, Peru, and Guatemala, programs that align with our organization’s commitment to environmental and humanitarian engagement.

We are a small marketing team, very much mission and values driven, focused on building collaborative relationships and providing meaningful and challenging study abroad programs that enable students to broaden their global perspective, deepen their knowledge, and develop personally and professionally. We are committed to social responsibility and environmental sustainability and have been offsetting our carbon footprint since 2019.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
About the team

Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving.
  • Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.
  • Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.
  • Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms. 

You’ll be great for this position if you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field.
  • 4+ years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems.
  • Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc.
  • Solid Software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintain them in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting)
  • Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse).
  • Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithm optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation. 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp.

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team.

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches.

About us:

SumUp is a leading financial technology company, founded in 2012 with the goal of empowering small businesses around the globe. We’re the financial partner of choice for more than 4 million merchants in over 35 markets. We collectively build, plan and fine-tune the technology that drives SumUp and empowers small businesses around the world.

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their business. With a founders mentality and a 'team-first attitude' our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.
