title: Corporate Paralegal
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

  • Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

  • Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

  • Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

  • Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

  • Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

  • Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice
descriptionHtml:

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is on a mission to make refurbished tech the new norm. To achieve this, we use data to better understand our customers, improve their experience, and make smarter product and business decisions.

Within the Data Division, the Customer Experience Analytics team supports teams working across the customer journey, CRM, and Services. We help the business understand customer behaviors, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and measure the impact of new initiatives.

As a Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice, you will primarily support the Customer Journey and App Analytics scope. You will work closely with Product, Tech, UX, and Business teams to analyze customer behavior, support experimentation, and turn data into actionable insights.

title: Customer Service Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Service Team Leader to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed.

This is a people-leadership role first. You’ll set the standard, coach the team to hit it, and use the numbers to see what’s working and what isn’t. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. And you’ll lead from the front, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output.

  • Set targets for the team, hold people accountable to them, and help everyone get there.

  • Keep response times, resolution and the backlog on track across both desks.

  • Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself.

  • Use the team’s numbers to spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause.

  • Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience leading a customer service or support team (phone, email, chat or ticket-based) against KPIs.

  • A track record of improving how a team performs.

  • Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there.

  • Comfort with numbers: reading a report or dashboard, asking the right questions of it, and turning the answers into improvements.

  • Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong.

  • Curiosity about how tools, automation and AI could make the team’s work easier.

  • Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Zendesk or a similar helpdesk tool.

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

  • Experience setting up weekend cover.

Don’t be put off if you haven’t built helpdesk reports yourself. What matters is that you’ve set targets, held a team to them, and used the numbers to make things better. We’ll help you with the tools.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training and development support.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

Reports to: Daivik Patel, Chief Operating Officer.

Team: 6 support agents across two desks (Client Service and Driver Support).

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets

  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. title: Customer Success Manager (KI-Fokus) - m/w/d
descriptionHtml:
Was wir suchen

Eine Person, die ihre Freunde als „technisch-affinen Menschenfreund“ beschreiben würden, und Lust darauf hat zu erklären und zu beraten.

Aufgaben

  1. Kickoff: Du führst Kickoff-Calls per Video mit neuen Kunden und klärst, wie die Prozesse, die wir für sie automatisieren aussehen.

  2. Setup: Du richtest KI-Systeme nach unserem festen, dokumentierten Standard ein und verbindest ihn mit den Plattformen des Kunden, zum Beispiel Mail, Kalender und etc.

  3. Onboarding: Du begleitest den Kunden, bis alles rund läuft – mit Onboarding-Call und einer Woche Feedback-Runde.

  4. Support: Du betreust unsere bestehenden Kunden und antwortest innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Einen Großteil der Anfragen erledigt unsere KI, du kümmerst dich um den Rest.

  5. Kundenbeziehung: Du schreibst mit den Kunden, beantwortest Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass sie zufrieden sind 🤝

  6. Produkt: Du sammelst Fehler und Kundenfeedback und gehst sie einmal pro Woche mit unserem Team durch, und wirkst aktiv an der Verbesserung unserer Produkte mit.

  7. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag.

So arbeiten wir dich ein

  1. Woche 1: Du lernst unsere Abläufe, unser Studio und den Setup-Standard kennen und baust deinen eigenen KI-Agenten, falls du noch keinen hast (inkl. aller relevanten Schulungen).

  2. Woche 2: Du bist bei Kickoff-Calls und Setups unseres Technik-Teams dabei.

  3. Ab Woche 3: Du führst deinen ersten eigenen Kickoff, und hast einen Mentor an deiner Seite, der dich dabei unterstützt.

  4. Nach rund 4 Wochen: Du machst Calls, Setup und Support eigenständig und übernimmst nach und nach immer mehr Eigenverantwortung.

Qualifikation

  • Du magst Technik und Menschen gleichermaßen und hast ggf. selbst mit KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Codex oder eigenen Agenten gearbeitet.

  • Du telefonierst gern und erklärst Technik so, dass dich ein Schreinermeister und ein Geschäftsführer gleichermaßen verstehen.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und verantwortungsbewusst, gerade mit Kundendaten.

  • Du willst Gas geben, dazulernen und persönlich wachsen.

  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift (C2), denn unsere Kunden sind deutsche Unternehmer. Englisch hilft bei Dokumentation und Tools, ist aber keine Bedingung.

  • Optional: Du wohnst im Umkreis von Düsseldorf oder München (unsere Standorte)

  • Welcher Abschluss dahintersteht, ist uns egal. Unsere Abläufe sind dokumentiert und lernbar – du musst nicht alles von Anfang an können.

Wer nicht zu uns passt:

  • Jemand, der lieber nur am Code sitzt und Kundengespräche als Störung empfindet.

  • Jemand, der Dienst nach Vorschrift sucht. Wir erwarten keine Dauerbereitschaft und kein Wochenende am Laptop, aber dass du Dinge zu Ende denkst und einen eigenen Anspruch an die Exzellenz deiner Arbeit hast ⭐

Wie geht's weiter?

Kein Lebenslauf, kein 0815-Anschreiben. Beantworte ein paar kurze Fragen und beantworte in deinem Anschreiben in eigenen Worten (*nicht KI-geschrieben*):

1) Was hast du bisher selbst mit KI gebaut?

2) Welche KI-Themen interessieren dich aktuell am meisten als Lernfeld?

3) Warum könntest du der perfekte Fit für diese Rolle sein?

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Klue, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence

The Customer Success team is hiring 👋

You're the person who walks into an account and immediately sees what matters: the risk no one's named yet, the expansion hiding in plain sight, the champion waiting to be developed. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks.

If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.

As a Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner.

Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win.

What's In It for You?

This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same.

What You'll Do

  • Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours.

  • Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about.

  • Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year.

  • Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it.

  • Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you.

What Success Looks Like

We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when:

  • GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter.

  • All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks.

  • Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts.

  • Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome.

  • Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book.

  • Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release.

  • Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal.

What You Bring

Must Haves:

  • The experience. track record in a CSM or commercial role with direct revenue accountability. You've owned renewals and expansion targets and hit them.

  • Ownership. ability to lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team without direct authority.

  • Customer facing. Proven success building trust and credibility across a customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive buyers.

  • Commercial fluency. comfortable with upsell conversations, business-case development, and navigating contract dynamics with confidence.

  • Strong discovery skills. can diagnose a customer's business goals, connect them to Klue's platform outcomes, and make the link explicit and repeatable.

  • Change management instinct. knows how to build internal Champions, navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, and drive adoption against organizational friction.

  • Multi-threading instinct. you build relationships across levels by default, not as a recovery strategy.

  • Signal awareness and speed. proactively identifies risk and opportunity in customer behavior, usage data, and relationship health, and acts fast.

  • Technical curiosity. comfortable learning integrations and AI capabilities, and explaining them clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • AI-fluency. actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can model that behavior with customers.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, sales enablement, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with technical integrations (MCP, CRM, Slack, or similar) and comfort guiding customers through deployment.

  • Knowledge of competitive enablement best practices and how revenue teams operationalize competitive programs.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic usage: prompt design, workflow automation, or AI-assisted customer work.

Benefits:

  • Competitive base compensation plus variable

  • Monthly Pension Contribution

  • Extended health & dental benefits that kick in within your first month in seat

  • Opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan

  • Time off. Take what you need. We want the team to prioritize wellness and avoid burnout. Vacation usually falls into 3 categories: recharging, life-event, & keeping a work-life balance. Just ensure the required work gets done and clear it with your team in advance. You need to take at least 28 days off every year.

  • Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO

  • Be part of a high performing team who know how to celebrate their success!

Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. If you know you have what it takes, even if that’s different from what we’ve described, be sure to explain why in your application.

At Klue, we're committed to building a high-performing team where people feel a strong sense of belonging, can be their authentic selves, and are able to reach their full potential. If there’s anything we can do to make our hiring process more accessible or to better support you, please let us know, we’re happy to accommodate.

Why Klue Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark.

If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here.

Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate

How We Work at Klue

We love the balance of connection and flexibility. We work Office-First, with ahybrid touch, and work together in our vibrant offices on Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together.

Our main hiring hubs are in:

  • 🇨🇦 Vancouver (HQ)

Our Commitment to You

  • High Performance Culture. We reward high performance and growth through career development, coaching, and annual performance reviews.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Extended health & dental coverage that starts on Day 1. Fun perks like discounts at Goodlife and Perkopolis are gravy.

  • Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan.

  • Our Vacation Policy is Take The Time You Need. We just ask that you give notice and don’t leave your team hanging.

  • Top-tier tools. All employees will receive a Mac (or PC, if that’s your jam) and access to A+ tooling.

  • AI First. All employees are encouraged to lean into AI to work smarter and faster. Built something cool lately? Show us at our Friday Show, Don’t Tell Meetings.

  • Growth / Leadership. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO, and opportunities to connect with incredible people across the company.

  • Social connection. There’s no shortage of ways to stay connected and have fun. We get together once a year in Vancouver for a company- wide kickoff. Throughout the year our Hubs hold regular social events.

  • Dog-friendly spaces. Bring your four-legged friend along in Vancouver or Toronto, as our offices are pup-approved.

About Klue

We’re on a mission to help organizations stop losing winnable deals. Klue’s AI agents generate market, competitor, and buyer insights in a unified platform. We ensure it’s trustworthy, automated, and activated across every department, so they have the answers they need to own their market.

✨ Here’s what makes us tick:

  • Klue is AI-first at its core. It’s wired deep into our internal processes and tooling, powering our small but mighty team. It drives Klue’s autonomous agents that handle the heavy lifting for customers: collecting intel, generating insights, and ensuring content is updated and available across departments. Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork.

  • Competitor Insights. Klue helps revenue teams win more competitive deals by turning market, competitor, and buyer signals into insights teams can actually use. Our AI analyzes calls, CRM data, and real buyer feedback to give product marketers and sellers a clear picture of what’s happening in their market and why deals are won or lost. We’re a curious, collaborative team building a platform that helps companies compete with confidence, and we’re looking for people who want to do meaningful work alongside others who care about craft and impact.

  • A culture of curiosity, ownership and winning together. We’re a fast-growing, globally-distributed team based in Vancouver (with hubs like Toronto), scaling quicker than ever. We value people who own their domain, act boldly, stay curious and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment.

descriptionHtml:

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
descriptionHtml:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

Dit ga je doen:

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

  • Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

  • Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

  • Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

  • Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

  • Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

Team
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position.

title: Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.

  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.

Was uns gefällt

  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.
  • Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus.

title: Data Analyst - Research Participants - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Data Analyst - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting data analysts based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a data analyst. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

🍊Our mission

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

🍊About the role

The Data Architect owns assigned studies end-to-end, taking full responsibility for both the design of the database on Citrus and the quality of the data it produces, from study planning through database lock. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require.

One person owns the database from study planning through lock, so the design and the data it produces never drift apart. The role also shapes how data delivery on Citrus develops, identifying where manual work can be automated.

🍊About you

  • You work with data programmatically, or are ready to build that skill quickly: Python, R, or SQL are used daily in this role, and you are expected to learn them on the job if you do not already have them

  • You have working knowledge of CDISC standards, particularly CDASH, with SDTM familiarity a plus, and you design with analysis-ready data in mind

  • You have experience with external data transfers and reconciliation

  • You understand GCP, ICH E6 and 21 CFR Part 11 and apply them in day-to-day decisions

🍊What you’ll focus on

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has already run data center feasibility studies on their own, and who can answer the question a client asks in front of a site: how many megawatts can this land absorb. We expect three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen end to end.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. We answer in days where the market takes weeks. You will be the person who answers for that number.

You will run a portfolio of test fits and data center feasibility studies, with occasional work on large logistics and industry. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client.

The core of the role

  • Establish a site's capacity in IT megawatts, working from the local zoning rules and operating constraints, and set out the assumptions behind it.

  • Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions.

  • Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid.

  • Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking.

  • Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap.

  • Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height.

  • Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge.

  • Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: we count projects as much as years. Three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen across their full cycle. One of them should be a project you carried yourself, from capacity through to permit or schematic design. A background in large logistics or industrial buildings is a valid base, provided you add that data center experience to it.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Product knowledge, the sizing cascade of a data center, hall, power, cooling, telecom and logistics, the slab-to-slab height and what it imposes, the rack-and-aisle grid, electrical redundancy, the order of magnitude of a PUE.

  • Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements.

  • Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power.

  • Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges.

  • Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor.

  • Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

  • A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking.

Why Join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company, where the methods and the tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent depending on the case, to discuss together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Data Center Capacity Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years.

The Role

This hire acquires the data center capacity that Mistral's next generation of models will run on. Across Europe, you will negotiate co-location agreements and built-to-suit contracts with data center developers, structure master services agreements and order forms, and make sourcing decisions grounded in a deep understanding of what the capacity will actually be used for: training frontier LLMs, serving inference at scale, or both.

The role sits at the intersection of commercial negotiation and technical infrastructure. You will need to translate workload requirements into contract terms, assess whether a given site can deliver the power, cooling, and connectivity Mistral needs, and close deals that lock in capacity years before the GPUs arrive.

What You Will Do

  • Negotiate master services agreements, order forms, and co-location or built-to-suit contracts with data center developers across Europe

  • Structure capacity sourcing decisions based on workload requirements: training, inference, or hybrid

  • Assess data center sites for power delivery, cooling, connectivity, and commissioning timelines

  • Work with Mistral's science and infrastructure teams to align capacity plans with model roadmaps

  • Manage relationships with existing data center partners including Éclairion and EcoDC

What We're Looking For

  • You have negotiated data center contracts. You have closed master services agreements, order forms, or co-location / built-to-suit deals in the data center or infrastructure sector.

  • You understand capacity delivery. You know what it takes to commission a data hall: power, cooling, connectivity, timelines, and the failure modes that delay go-live.

  • You can translate technical requirements into commercial terms. You have structured sourcing decisions based on workload needs, whether for training clusters or inference serving.

  • You operate across borders. You have worked with counterparties across multiple European jurisdictions and are comfortable with cross-border negotiation.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Runtime Foundation owns the shared cloud foundations that every Snyk service runs on: production Kubernetes clusters, ingress and service mesh, infrastructure provisioning and access, cluster upgrades, reliability and disaster recovery, and our AWS and GCP core services. descriptionHtml:
Key Engineer (Staff / Principal Level) – Backend, Infrastructure & IoT

Berlin | Full-Time | Start ASAP

We're looking for an exceptional engineer. A true A-player who wants to take ownership, build world-class technology, and play a key role in shaping the future of Heidi Systems.

About Heidi Systems

Submetering in Germany still runs mostly on paper. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year.

Heidi Systems changes that end to end. We install meters and gateways in buildings, collect the data and build the platform property managers use to monitor consumption and run the yearly utility billing.

We have paying customers, a growing pipeline and an angel round with unicorn founders and directors from Google and OpenAI. Now we need an engineer who can carry a big part of the technical foundation together with the founders.

The role

You'll be one of the technical leads at Heidi and work directly with the founders. You make the architecture decisions, build them yourself and run them in production.

As the team grows, you'll help hire and mentor the next engineers.

What you'll own

  • Backend services in Go and TypeScript, including the API our SvelteKit frontend talks to

  • Microservices: deciding where to split services and building them, mostly in Go

  • Data pipelines: ingestion, validation and processing of meter, gateway and building data. These numbers end up on invoices, so they have to be right.

  • Databases and storage: PostgreSQL, Supabase and S3. Schema design, performance, backups, replication.

  • IoT and connectivity: MQTT, message brokers, wireless gateways and the bugs that only show up with real hardware in a basement

  • Infrastructure and deployments: Hetzner servers, Docker, Caddy, GitHub Actions, GHCR

  • Monitoring and incidents: logging, alerting and a clear process for when something breaks

  • Engineering standards: code review, testing and how we ship

What you bring

  • A track record of building backends that run in production, and that you owned yourself

  • Experience writing production backends in Go and TypeScript

  • Experience with Supabase, or with PostgreSQL and S3

  • Experience designing and running microservices, ideally in Go

  • Hands-on with Docker and deploying to Linux servers

  • You've set up monitoring, logging and alerting before

  • You debug production issues yourself and can explain afterwards what went wrong

  • You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can walk us through the trade-offs

  • Fluent English

Bonus points

  • Real-time systems, especially MQTT and message brokers

  • Building CI/CD pipelines and DevOps setups

  • AI data pipelines

  • High-volume time-series data

  • Bare-metal or VPS infrastructure, ideally Hetzner

  • Experience in energy, PropTech or infrastructure tech

  • Previous role as founding engineer, tech lead, staff or principal engineer

  • Hiring and building engineering teams

Our stack

  • Languages: Go, TypeScript

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, S3

  • Infrastructure: Hetzner, Docker, Caddy

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GHCR

  • Connectivity: MQTT, IoT data streams, APIs

  • Config: YAML, TOML

We care more about how you make engineering decisions than whether you know every tool on this list.

Why Heidi

  • You work directly with the founders. Most decisions take one call.

  • You own core systems from day one and set many of the standards the team builds on.

  • The problems are real: software, hardware and energy data in buildings across Germany.

  • A renovated Altbau office in Berlin Mitte at Monbijoupark, everyone at one table.

  • Room to grow into a lead role as the engineering team gets bigger.

Location

Berlin, on-site. You live in Berlin or are willing to move. Full-time, start as soon as possible.

How to apply

What you've built matters more to us than your CV. Send us:

  • Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.

title: Director Customer Experience and Engagement
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

About The Role

We are looking for a Director of Customer Experience and Engagement to build and lead the organization responsible for helping Nscale customers realize meaningful value from our platform.

You will own the strategy, operating model, and execution of our customer experience function. This role will be pivotal in working with our customers across the AI lifecycle—from initial requirements gathering to contractual acceptance, onboarding and workload migration through production adoption, optimization, and expansion.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, engineering, product, sales, and infrastructure. You will be accountable for ensuring customers can successfully build and operate AI workloads on Nscale while receiving clear, proactive, and technically credible guidance throughout the relationship.

The right leader will combine strong customer judgment with technical depth and operational rigor. You should be comfortable getting into the technical details enough so that you understand where customers are blocked, influencing product priorities, and advising executives on retention, risk, adoption, and account health.

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to define what world-class customer experience looks like for the fastest growing Neocloud platform in the world.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and Develop Nscale’s initial customer engagement strategy from requirements to PoC execution and signoff
  • Define and own Nscale’s customer experience strategy across onboarding, implementation, adoption, technical success, support coordination, retention, and expansion.
  • Collaborate with a world class set of Solution Engineers across the segments to determine best path for each customer and increase deal velocity and efficiency
  • Establish account-health frameworks that combine product usage, platform reliability, workload performance, customer sentiment, support activity, and commercial risk.
  • Proactively identify at-risk enterprise accounts based on utilization patterns, support tickets, or competitive pressures and orchestrate recovery strategies
  • Create clear escalation and incident-management processes that provide customers with fast response times, strong ownership, seamless internal coordination, and proactive communication.
  • Define and track the metrics that matter, including time to value, activation, platform adoption, workload growth, retention, expansion, customer health, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Turn customer conversations and usage patterns into actionable insights for sales, product and engineering.
  • Scale the function thoughtfully, balancing high-touch customer engagement with automation, self-service resources, and repeatable programs.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience across customer experience, customer success, solution consulting, solutions architecture, professional services, or a related customer-facing function.
  • Growth-stage, enterprise SaaS, developer platform, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure environment preferred, but not required
  • A proven track record of building or scaling customer experience organizations supporting technically complex products.
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to engage credibly with engineering leaders, ML engineers, AI researchers, infrastructure teams, and enterprise platform organizations.

title: Duales Studium 2027: Elektrotechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Starte dein duales Studium bei Emission Partner.

Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Moderne Abgasnachbehandlung ist dabei längst mehr als Mechanik und Katalysatortechnik. Elektronik, Automatisierung und intelligente Steuerungstechnik sorgen dafür, dass Anlagen zuverlässig arbeiten, Prozesse überwacht und Emissionen gezielt reduziert werden können.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

In deinem dualen Studium verbindest du das theoretische Wissen aus dem Elektrotechnikstudium direkt mit der Praxis bei uns. Du planst elektrische Systeme, beschäftigst dich mit Automatisierung und Programmierung und arbeitest an technischen Lösungen für unsere Anlagen.

Du möchtest nach dem Abitur nicht zwischen Studium und Praxis wählen, sondern beides miteinander verbinden und schon während deines Studiums an echten technischen Projekten arbeiten? Dann starte dein duales Studium bei Emission Partner.

Zum 01.08.2027 suchen wir dich für ein duales Studium Elektrotechnik (m/w/d) an unserem Standort in Strücklingen.

Was du bei uns bewirkst

Du bringst unsere Technik unter Strom und intelligente Lösungen in unsere Anlagen.

Während deines dualen Studiums lernst du, wie Elektrotechnik und Automatisierung in unseren Anlagen und Systemen eingesetzt werden.

Du beschäftigst dich mit der Planung elektrischer Anlagen, entwickelst Steuerungslösungen, programmierst Anlagensteuerungen und erstellst Visualisierungen. Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur theoretisch an Aufgabenstellungen, sondern kannst deine Lösungen in realen Projekten begleiten.

Besonders spannend: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren technischen Bereichen zusammen und bekommst Einblicke in den gesamten Prozess von der Planung und Entwicklung über die Programmierung bis zur Montage und Inbetriebnahme.

So arbeitest du bereits während deines Studiums an Technologien mit, die dafür entwickelt werden, Schadstoffemissionen zu reduzieren.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Du wirkst bei der Planung neuer elektrischer Anlagen sowie beim Umbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Anlagen mit.
  • Du lernst, Anlagensteuerungen zu programmieren und technische Abläufe zu automatisieren.
  • Du erstellst Visualisierungen für unsere Anlagen und unterstützt dabei, Bedienung und Prozessüberwachung weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest an der Automatisierungs- und Elektrotechnik unserer Sonderanlagen zur Abgasnachbehandlung mit.
  • Du erstellst und bearbeitest Schalt- und Stromlaufpläne, Kabellisten und technische Dokumentationen.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Elektroinstallation und begleitest Projekte von der Rohmontage bis zur fertigen Anlage.
  • Du lernst, elektrische Bauteile und Systeme auszulegen, zu prüfen und aufeinander abzustimmen.
  • Du begleitest technische Projekte und arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen.
  • Du kannst das Wissen aus deinen Studienphasen unmittelbar in echte technische Aufgabenstellungen bei uns einbringen.
  • Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Projekte und mehr Verantwortung.


Das bringst du mit

Uns ist wichtiger, dass du technisch neugierig bist und komplexe Zusammenhänge verstehen möchtest, als dass du schon alles kannst.

  • Du verfügst zum Studienstart über die erforderliche Hochschulzugangsberechtigung.
  • Mathematik, Physik und Technik interessieren dich und du möchtest wissen, wie technische Systeme funktionieren.
  • Du begeisterst dich für Elektrotechnik, Automatisierung und Programmierung.
  • Du denkst logisch und findest gerne Lösungen für technische Probleme.

Dein duales Studium bei uns

Dein duales Studium verbindet deine Praxisphasen bei uns in Strücklingen mit den Studienphasen an der PHWT in Vechta.

So lernst du die wissenschaftlichen und technischen Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik an der Hochschule und kannst dein Wissen anschließend direkt bei uns in der Praxis einsetzen.

Während andere zunächst hauptsächlich Theorie kennenlernen, bekommst du bei uns früh Einblicke in reale Entwicklungs- und Anlagenprojekte. Mit jedem Semester wächst dabei nicht nur dein Wissen, sondern auch die Verantwortung, die du bei uns übernehmen kannst.

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role
Someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit’s own vacuum facilities.

You start with testing: you build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design. As the programme matures, your role grows into design ownership, calculating, designing and building the thruster yourself, and testing your own designs. Your results decide what flies.

Responsibilities

Test and verify

  • Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

  • Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests.

  • Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results.

  • Keep clear records of every test configuration and result, giving traceable evidence for system verification and qualification.

Build

  • Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

  • Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

Design

  • Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last.

  • Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers to integrate and test each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

  • Over time, take ownership of thruster design and performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration, and turn test results into design changes, then re-test.

Requirements

Essential

  • Practical electric propulsion testing experience, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances.

  • Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition systems.

  • Working knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation, and of plasma physics, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

  • A rigorous approach to test planning, data quality and documentation.

  • Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site.

Nice to have

  • Experience with plasma diagnostics such as Langmuir probes or retarding potential analysers.

  • Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware, or with test rig design or hardware verification for flight programmes.

  • Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

  • Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. descriptionHtml:
About the role: What's in the Box

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.

The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

What you'll do: The Recipe

  • Lead and grow a team of mid-to-senior engineers: set clear expectations, give regular and honest feedback, and own their development - including building the case when someone is ready for the next level.
  • Own the people and stay technical. This role carries real hands-on expectations - you still deliver code yourself, not management at a distance.
  • Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.
  • Make our project-based way of working work for people. You lead project staffing with the Director of Engineering and the product managers, putting engineers where the work and their growth both fit. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.
  • Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.
  • Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.
  • Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.
  • Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

  • At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.
  • Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.
  • A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you need to earn the team's respect.
  • Daily, practical experience building with AI tooling: you've shipped real work with it, you know where it fails, and you learn as readily from others as they learn from you.
  • A product-oriented mindset: you can reason about the business problem, prioritise for customer impact, and push back on low-value scope.

From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!
