title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Interesse an admkrs? (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Wir schreiben hier keine Stelle aus. Diese Seite ist für Leute, die admkrs kennen, unsere Arbeit verfolgen und einen konkreten Grund haben, warum sie genau hier hingehören. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft, lies weiter. Wenn du gerade an zwanzig Agenturen dieselbe Bewerbung schickst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Ort.

Du sagst uns, welche Lücke du bei uns schließt. Nicht wir dir. Wir sind rund 20 Leute in München, arbeiten für Marken wie ESN, arena und asambeauty an Performance-Kampagnen, Creatives, Video und eigener Technologie. Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur.
  • Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung.
  • Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben.
  • Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein.

Warum wir?

  • Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen.
  • Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter.
  • Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst.
  • Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München.

Darauf schauen wir

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit.

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern.

title: Internal Communications Manager
descriptionHtml:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

The Opportunity

Internal communications at Multiverse isn't a downstream function. It's a strategic one.

You'll own the story Multiverse tells itself — making sure every colleague understands who we are, why it matters, and where we're going. That means shaping All Hands, advising the exec team, translating data into narratives people can actually repeat, and building the rhythms that keep colleagues informed week to week — not just when something big happens.

We operate in a fast-moving space with real external scrutiny. You'll need to be a strong instinctive writer, calm under pressure, and confident enough to tell leadership what needs to be said and when. If you want to own the internal narrative of one of the most ambitious companies in the UK skills and AI space — this is the role.

Specifically, you will

  • Own the canonical story Multiverse tells itself: maintain a living messaging framework that captures who we are, what we do, and why it matters, keeping it current as the business evolves

  • Produce internal briefing materials ahead of major external moments like regulatory decisions, product launches, policy developments, so leadership is never scrambling and every Multiverser finds out what the need to know, first.

  • Own the internal FAQ and "what to say if asked" resources that equip every colleague to be an informed and confident ambassador for the business

  • Take editorial ownership of All Hands: theme, narrative arc, content commissioning, and speaker preparation, ensuring it consistently moves the needle on alignment and energy

  • Support our Exec team with internal-facing communications - town halls, written updates, video messages - ensuring tone and content are consistent with our external narrative

  • Build a rhythm of regular leadership communication that doesn't only happen at All Hands, so colleagues feel informed week-to-week, not just quarter-to-quarter

  • Own the content programme that tells the employee story: learner outcomes, team culture, career progression, mission moments, taking guidance and inspiration from the EVP and aligning with priority recruitment marketing campaigns where required

  • Partner with the People team on key cultural moments so messaging is coherent and consistently on-brand

  • Own and optimise our internal channels (Slack, intranet, email newsletters), deciding what goes where, at what frequency, and in what format, and build measurement into the channel strategy through open rates, engagement, and feedback loops

  • Work hand-in-hand with Data & Insights and the wider Comms team to translate internal performance data into narratives that colleagues can understand, use, and repeat

  • Build a simple framework for measuring whether internal comms is working — do people feel informed, do they understand the strategy, can they articulate the narrative — and report quarterly to the Director of Communications on channel health and narrative consistency

About you

  • You embody the mission. You believe in equipping workers to win in the AI era, and you want every colleague to feel that purpose in how they show up at work

  • You have hands-on experience leading internal communications in a fast-moving, complex organisation, and you've owned narrative, channels, and leadership comms

  • You understand that internal comms is not a downstream function. You sit at the intersection of Data & Insights, Product, and external Comms

  • You're a strong, instinctive writer and editor, able to sharpen a leadership message, a town hall script, or a sensitive change announcement with equal confidence

  • You know how to translate data into story: you can take customer ROI evidence, learner outcomes, or operational performance figures and turn them into something every Multiverser can articulate and believe in

  • You're fluent in AI tools and use them to move faster and think bigger, but you apply rigorous human judgement to everything that goes out under Multiverse's name

  • You're calm and clear-headed under pressure: comfortable drafting sensitive internal communications in real time when external scrutiny spikes, and confident telling leadership what needs to be said and when

  • You're operationally strong on channels - Slack, intranet, email

  • You partner well with senior leaders: you can hold your own in a room with the exec team, give honest counsel on tone and timing, and earn trust quickly

  • You thrive in networked organisations, collaborating fluidly with People, Product, Tech, Data & Insights, and the wider Comms team

  • You see All Hands and leadership comms as strategic levers, not logistical exercises, and you have a track record of using them to drive genuine alignment

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!

title: International Data Acquisition Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

As an International Data Acquisition Manager at Socure, you will be instrumental in expanding and managing our global data assets to power Socure’s identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance solutions. Your primary focus will be sourcing, evaluating, onboarding, and managing third-party data providers across international markets, with a strong emphasis on data quality, operational scalability, and regulatory compliance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Data Acquisition and Strategy, you will collaborate closely with the Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and external data partners. Together, you will identify and operationalize data sources to enhance product performance, broaden geographic reach, and drive Socure’s international growth.

 

This role is especially critical as Socure deepens its international investments, building in-region capabilities and expanding its product support in the EU, UK, LATAM, and other key markets.

 

What You'll Do

Vendor and Data Management

  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

  • Assist in preparing RFIs, RFPs, diligence materials, and vendor assessments to evaluate provider capabilities, data quality, compliance posture, operational fit, and commercial value.

  • Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle.

  • Help manage renewals and identify new vendors to improve product quality, expand coverage, and enhance cost efficiency.

 

Collaboration and Internationalization Strategy

  • Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Socure products and international scenarios to assess the relevance, incremental value, and risks of potential data sources.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to align on priorities, plan integrations, and ensure effective operationalization of new data sources.

  • Contribute to data acquisition that promotes inclusivity, coverage, and fairness in identity verification across diverse populations and regions.

  • Represent the Data Acquisition team in cross-functional meetings, clearly communicating findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Quality and Integration

  • Assist in due diligence for prospective data sources, including data quality assessments, overlap and coverage analysis, compliance reviews, and performance testing.

  • Support structured evaluations and proof-of-concept testing for new vendors and datasets using evidence-based methods to determine business value and product impact.

  • Monitor and report on data quality metrics, vendor performance, feed reliability, and issues such as drift, schema changes, or outages; help coordinate remediation as necessary.

  • Work with internal technical teams to plan integrations, including understanding schemas, APIs, delivery models, and operational dependencies.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage day-to-day operations across the international data acquisition lifecycle, including vendor communications, issue resolution, documentation, and follow-up on action items.

  • Track and document cost, usage, and value metrics for acquired datasets, supporting budgeting, renewals, prioritization, and vendor decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve evaluation frameworks, and scale the team’s operating model as international data needs expand.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data acquisition, vendor management, procurement, partnerships, data operations, or a related field.

  • Experience evaluating or managing third-party data providers, ideally across multiple markets or jurisdictions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess data quality, business value, and operational trade-offs.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory and privacy frameworks impacting data acquisition and usage, including UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and other relevant data protection requirements.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, including experience maintaining structured documentation and evaluation records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with data vendors in identity verification, fraud prevention, financial services, regtech, or compliance-related markets.

  • Familiarity with international identity, KYC/eKYC, or watchlist-related data ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of global data landscapes, including government, credit bureau, mobile network, utility, electoral, or equivalent data sources used in various countries.

  • Familiarity with data integration concepts, including APIs, batch delivery, schemas, and operationalizing external data feeds.

  • Experience using SQL or similar tools for data analysis, profiling, or evaluation.

  • Experience working with UK and European market data providers or supporting products in the UK and internationally.

title: Internship - Founders Office (Talent)
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission
As the Founders’ Office Intern (Talent) at telli, you’ll work right alongside the founding team on the thing that decides how fast we grow: hiring. You’ll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company builds its team and a very hands-on role in finding, assessing and closing the people who join us next. Your focus is talent, with the option to grow into broader ops and strategic projects in the founders’ office over time.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the hiring engine behind telli’s growth

  • spot outlier candidates through LinkedIn, Juicebox, communities, referrals and new channels you come up with

  • write signal-based outreach that gets replies, and don’t take a plain “no” for an answer

  • run first interviews: assess fit quickly and pitch telli to the best candidates

  • own hiring pipelines across teams, from outreach to offer, and keep hiring managers and interviewers aligned

  • track the funnel per role, spot friction like unusual drop-off rates and fix it

  • build automations and AI workflows, e.g. for sourcing, messaging, interview prep and candidate coordination

  • help shape how telli shows up as an employer, through job posts, social content and events

  • once you’ve got hiring running, pick up first ops and strategic projects alongside the founders’ office

  • work closely with Dat, Ennie & the founding team

what makes you a great fit:

  • you’re hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work

  • you’re open, curious and love meeting new people

  • you have an eye for what makes someone exceptional

  • you can sell: you get people excited about an opportunity and handle objections

  • you take ownership, move fast and follow up with urgency

  • you’re data-minded, tech- & AI-savvy and pick up new tools fast

  • you communicate clearly and top-down in English and German

  • you have first experience in recruiting, sales, a startup or your own projects

  • you could imagine joining full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you’ve never used AI or automation tools and aren’t keen to learn

  • you don’t get excited about finding the people who’ll shape telli’s next chapter

  • you find it hard to keep many candidates and interviewers moving at once

  • you’d rather wait for instructions than pick up the phone and follow up yourself

  • you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success.

title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy. Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house. La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave.

Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business.

Principali responsabilità:

  • sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365, con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale
  • supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti
  • partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali, contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business
  • seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico, collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale
  • garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni


Requisiti richiesti:

  • conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps
  • competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python, e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne
  • conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati, con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali
  • capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici


Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali:

  • laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente
  • esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365
  • esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
  • familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
  • esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
  • approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
  • capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi


Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on, autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo.

In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso.

title: IT Network Architect (m/w/d) Enterprise Networking & Security
descriptionHtml:
In dieser Position als IT Network Architect (m/w/d) Enterprise Networking & Security gestalten Sie die strategische und technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Netzwerklandschaft. Sie entwickeln leistungsfähige und sichere Architekturen, treiben Infrastrukturprojekte voran und sorgen für eine zukunftsfähige Vernetzung über verschiedene Standorte und Systeme hinweg. Dabei verbinden Sie tiefgehendes technisches Know-how mit konzeptioneller Verantwortung und arbeiten eng mit angrenzenden IT- und Security-Bereichen zusammen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Bei der Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitskonzepten setzen Sie auf moderne Ansätze wie Zero Trust, Netzwerksegmentierung, Firewall-Architekturen und Network Access Control
  • Als Schnittstelle zu Security-, Cloud- und Infrastrukturteams koordinieren Sie externe Partner, analysieren komplexe Störungen und stellen die Einhaltung relevanter Sicherheits- und Compliance-Vorgaben, insbesondere NIS2, sicher
  • Von der technischen Planung bis zum Rollout begleiten Sie Netzwerkprojekte, Migrationen und Infrastrukturveränderungen
  • Mit Ihrem Architekturverständnis definieren Sie technische Standards, entwickeln Zielbilder und leiten daraus langfristige Technologie-Roadmaps ab.
  • Sie konzipieren und optimieren komplexe Netzwerkarchitekturen mit Fokus auf Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Verfügbarkeit

Ihr Profil

  • Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder ein abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium
  • Moderne Netzwerk- und Security-Architekturen sowie regulatorische Anforderungen wie NIS2 sind Ihnen bestens vertraut
  • Ihr technisches Know-how umfasst LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Remote Access und Cloud Connectivity; Erfahrung mit Aruba ist besonders willkommen
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Netzwerkdesign oder in der Netzwerkarchitektur sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Aufbau komplexer Enterprise-Netzwerke zeichnen Sie aus
  • Mit Ihrer analytischen Denkweise, eigenständigen Arbeitsweise und Kommunikationsstärke treiben Sie technische Themen strukturiert voran. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringen Sie ebenfalls mit

  • Fort- und Weiterbildungsbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien

title: IT Support Administrator W/M
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France

(and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and

Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and

finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the

best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small

businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon

Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and

much more...

‍‍‍ Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of

the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong

remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of

Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding

ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000

accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Every great employee experience starts with great IT.

At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our

teams can focus on building the future of finance.

As an IT Support Administrator, you'll be one of the main points of contact for our

employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to

building an IT environment that scales with our growth.

What you'll do

Deliver an outstanding IT experience

Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the

most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience.

Employee onboarding & offboarding

You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one.

From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they

need to work successfully.

You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to

our IT environment and security best practices.

You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external

partners.

Keep our IT environment secure

Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of

everyone's daily habits.

You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review

permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company.

Manage our internal tools

You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and

ensuring employees have the right access at the right time.

You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools.

Share knowledge

You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company.

That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering

onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security.

Who are you?

We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT

fundamentals.

Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously

improving the employee experience.

You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine.

What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to take

ownership.

Why you'll love this role

● You'll work with every team across the company.

● You'll have real ownership from day one.

● You'll continuously improve our internal IT experience.

● You'll play a key role in scaling the internal IT environment of one of Europe's

fastest-growing fintechs.

We'd love to meet you if...

● You enjoy helping people and delivering a great employee experience.

● You have previous experience in IT Support, Workplace IT or IT Administration.

● You're proactive and enjoy taking ownership.

● You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.

● You're curious and enjoy learning new tools.

● You're comfortable administering modern workplace tools. Experience with Google

Workspace, Microsoft 365, Jamf, Intune, Okta or similar platforms is a plus.

● You care about security and access management (experience with ISO 27001 or

SOC 2 is a plus).

● You're fluent in English and French.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a

monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and

more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work

remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum

time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days

(which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar,

fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on

top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue

healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon,

Bordeaux, Nantes...)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as

well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

● To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department

you’re applying to)

● To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

● To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

● Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they

meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a

meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your

exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings

published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional

email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the

recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not

respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that

we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender,

sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If

anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

title: IT Support Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

A proactive IT Lead who thrives on developing and scaling high-performing support teams. You’ll be responsible for the operational effectiveness of our IT function, guiding IT Engineers to provide best-in-class service in a fast-paced environment.

You’re passionate about empowering teams, solving complex challenges, and continuously innovating to improve business outcomes. You balance people leadership with technical excellence, and you have a knack for inspiring others to achieve high standards, all while fostering a collaborative, inclusive team culture.

You’ll be pivotal in shaping Lendable’s IT strategy and ensuring our IT environment supports both rapid growth and industry-leading user experiences. Crucially, you will be hands-on actively resolving technical issues and automating workflows while growing your skills and leadership to progress into an IT Manager role.

What you'll be doing

  • Support the Head of IT to Lead and support the IT team, overseeing day-to-day operations, workload distribution, and performance

  • Set strategic direction for IT, aligning team objectives to business needs and company growth goals

  • Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues, ensuring prompt resolution and maintaining excellent user satisfaction

  • Ensure consistent, compliant support for Windows, MacOS, and Linux platforms as well as mobile devices and office equipment

  • Develop and implement IT standards, knowledge base articles, and training resources

  • Drive continuous improvement of IT workflows, through automation and process optimisation

  • Oversee onboarding and offboarding processes for new joiners across multiple UK and international locations

  • Collaborate with IT, Security, and Engineering counterparts to maintain high levels of uptime, reliability, and data protection

  • Select, configure, and manage ITSM/ticketing systems and ensure accurate reporting on support metrics

  • Support office and remote working technology needs and encourage a culture of innovation and accountability

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 5+ years in IT Support/IT Systems/Service Desk environments

  • Demonstrated experience with MDM platforms such as Jumpcloud, Jamf, or Kandji

  • Experience in leading teams

  • Proven coaching abilities, with a track record of supporting high-performing, inclusive teams

  • Experience implementing and optimising ITSM systems (e.g. Zendesk, Jira, Freshdesk) within scaling organisations

  • Advanced troubleshooting skills with computers (especially MacOS), mobile devices, and other peripherals

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Understanding of security protocols and strategies for threat mitigation

  • Willingness to travel to office locations in Kent and London as needed

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g. Bash, PowerShell) for automation and process improvement

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS and Google Cloud

  • Direct experience scaling IT functions in high-growth tech environments

  • Industry experience in fintech or financial services is a plus

  • Experience with network management and troubleshooting

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with one of the team

  • Technical Interview

  • Team Interview

    • Meet the team you’ll work with daily

  • Culture Interview

    • Meet a member of the senior tech leadership.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

 

Your Role

As IT support specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for day-to-day IT support across our Berlin and Darmstadt offices, keeping employees connected, equipped, and secure so they can focus on building fusion technology. You will own the full IT support lifecycle at both sites, from ticket resolution and device management to onboarding and security compliance.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the device lifecycle for Windows and macOS endpoints: imaging, configuration, inventory tracking, and patching.

  • Prioritise and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues across Berlin and Darmstadt, proactively and independently.

  • Enforce the security baseline by ensuring MFA coverage, completing access reviews, and maintaining patch compliance under IT security policy and GDPR.

  • Support improvement projects such as cloud device management migration, DLP implementation, and EDR rollout, and escalate scope or security issues early to the Senior IT Manager.

Who You Are

  • You have solid IT support fundamentals in hardware, software, networking, and endpoint security, with hands-on experience in both Windows and macOS.

  • You take ownership without waiting to be asked, follow up without prompting, and communicate fluently in German and English.

 

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

Während die Strategie und das technische Setup vorgegeben werden, verantwortest du das fehlerfreie Einbuchen, die tägliche Pflege und das exakte Monitoring unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System.
  • Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen.
  • Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf.
  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung mit.
  • Erste Marketing-Einblicke: Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing gesammelt (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder erste Berufsschritte).
  • Google-Kenntnisse als Plus: Idealerweise hast du schon mal mit Google Ads oder Analyse-Tools gearbeitet – das ist ein großer Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell in diese Systeme einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, arbeitest extrem gewissenhaft und prüfst deine Aufgaben lieber doppelt, bevor etwas online geht.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Du hast eine gute Affinität zu Daten und kannst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets umgehen, um Listen und Tabellen zu pflegen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben

title: Junior Grafik Designer:in / Mediengestalter:in (m/w/d) - Hamburg
descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Für unser Grafik & Designteam suchen wir Unterstützung in Hamburg vorerst auf 2 Jahre befristet. Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Für unsere nationalen Standorte bist du erste Ansprechperson wenn es um die Kreation von benötigten Grafiken geht
  • Du setzt Flyer, Einladungen, Anzeigen, Werbemittel, Poster, Standortbrandings uvm. nach unseren CI-Richtlinien um
  • Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Director Design und dem Rest des Design Teams der 1KOMMA5° Holding zusammen
  • Du erstellst und adaptierst praktische Design-Vorlagen, die von den Standorten teilweise auch selbst genutzt werden können und stellst damit eine zügige Umsetzung sicher
  • Dabei agierst du auch als CI Polizei und stellst sicher, dass Grafiken standort- und kanalübergreifend von ansässigen Designern oder Marketeers korrekt umgesetzt werden
  • Du wirst zudem als genereller Grafik Support für diverse Designprojekte innerhalb der Holding eingesetzt
  • Du bist im regelmäßigen Austausch mit dem Brand-Content-Team und unterstützenden Dienstleistern

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium in Kommunikationsdesign/ Grafikdesign/ Mediengestaltung oder besitzt eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du konntest bereits erste Berufserfahrung sammeln und aktiv Projekte umsetzen (mind. 1,5-2 Jahre)
  • Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop und Lightroom) sowie MS Office-Programmen
  • Erfahrungen im Print Grafik Bereich und mit dem Tool FIGMA sind sehr willkommen
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Typografie, Ästhetik und Trends und besitzt Kreativität und Weitblick
  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit absoluter Teamfähigkeit sind für dich Standard
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit und kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen
  • Du kannst mit Zeitdruck umgehen und hältst dich an Deadlines und Vorgaben
  • Du liebst es, deine Arbeit zu dokumentieren und eine saubere Ablage zu pflegen

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem tollen Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten direkt am Ballindamm.
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

descriptionHtml:

title: (Junior) Graphic Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Role

As a (Junior) Graphic Designer in our Licensing Team at Statista R, you will work closely with Sales and Project Management to create effective, on-brand marketing and licensing materials. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience across print design, digital assets, brand implementation, and AI-supported design workflows.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and develop sales and licensing materials, including brochures, cover letters, order forms, certificates, and presentation assets

  • Create premium quality seals and award badges that reflect the credibility and high standards of our rankings

  • Handle layout, final artwork, file preparation, and the creation of print-ready PDFs

  • Edit and optimize images for print and digital use

  • Improve and further develop existing sales collateral using innovative design methods and AI-powered creative tools

  • Design merchandise and promotional materials, such as stickers, roll-ups, and additional point-of-sale assets

  • Ensure all materials align with corporate design guidelines and maintain a consistent visual brand identity

  • Collaborate closely with Project Management and Sales to develop targeted, effective, and visually engaging sales communications

 

Your Profile

  • You have completed vocational training or hold a degree in Graphic Design, Media Design, Communication Design, or a comparable creative field

  • You have a strong eye for design, typography, composition, color, and detail

  • You enjoy developing creative concepts and translating ideas into clear, high-quality visual communication

  • You are proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Adobe InDesign and Adobe Illustrator

  • You are curious about AI-based design tools and eager to explore how they can enhance creative workflows

  • You have initial experience with print products, prepress, print production, and corporate design implementation

  • You work in a structured, reliable, and organized way, with strong time-management skills

  • You communicate confidently in both German and English

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Junior or Medior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem.

What you will build:

The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like:

  • Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

  • Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

  • Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

  • Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

  • Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

  • Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening.

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.


Who you are:

You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity.

Three signals that tell us you are that person:

  • You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long.

  • What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once.

  • You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered.

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory.

  • Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line.

  • Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users.

  • Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness.

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process.

  • Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week.

This role is not for you if you:

This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. Who finds it genuinely difficult to explain why they build: it is just what they do. Who would rather spend a Sunday solving a hard systems problem than almost anything else. If you have to think about whether that description fits you, it probably does not.

  • Got into AI because it became an important skill, not because you could not imagine doing anything else.

  • Need a brief, a PM, or a defined scope before taking action.

  • Measure your output in technical quality or feature count rather than business impact.

  • Would answer 'what would you build first?' with an infrastructure question.

  • If you think a workweek of 40h is a lot.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to win new logos and then grow them. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and then earn the rest of their estate by delivering and building the relationship from the inside.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone who loves the hunt. Rather than inheriting a book of accounts to farm, you'll build your own: the accounts you develop will be the ones you win, and the commission you earn on them is uncapped. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys both landing the first deal and then multiplying it.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on the commercial relationship, the next site and the next logo.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a named list of target organisations and be accountable for converting them into Hozah clients — from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Own the growth of every account you win: map the estate, build relationships beyond the original buyer, and secure the next sites and additional services.

  • Hit your sales targets. You will carry a new-logo target and an account-expansion target, with commission on both.

  • Run a disciplined outbound engine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks, with the activity, pipeline and forecast recorded accurately in the CRM.

  • Run the full sales cycle yourself: discovery, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation and close, with support from the wider team where a deal needs it.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down, and stay the commercial owner of the relationship after go-live.

  • Hold regular commercial reviews with the accounts you own — performance, value delivered, and what else we can do for them.

  • Feed what you learn from prospects and clients back to the CEO, product and operations, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

  • A track record of winning new logos in B2B sales, with the numbers to show for it: targets carried, attainment over multiple periods, and deals you personally sourced from cold.

  • A track record of then growing those accounts — not a career spent only developing accounts somebody else won. We want to see both halves: the first win and what you turned it into.

  • Genuine comfort with cold calling and outbound prospecting as a daily discipline, and the resilience to keep going through a run of rejections.

  • The ability to run a consultative sale: ask the questions that uncover the real problem, write a proposal that leads with it, and handle price and timing objections without caving or bulldozing.

  • Commercial judgement on deal structure — knowing when to hold price, what to trade, and when a deal is not worth doing.

  • Pipeline and CRM discipline: a real, repeatable routine for managing, prioritising and forecasting a pipeline.

  • Comfort working alongside an operations and customer success team, handing over cleanly and resisting the temptation to become the client's help desk.

  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and clients in person across the UK.

Useful but not essential: experience selling to landowners, managing agents, hotels, retail or leisure operators, or in parking, property services, facilities management or another multi-site B2B service.

What you get in return

We ask a lot of this role, and we give a lot back.

  • A generous, uncapped commission structure on both new logos and account growth, in a commercial team that already has people earning well above OTE.

  • Real room to grow. We hold only a small percentage of the market, so there's a huge amount of ground still to win and plenty of scope to progress as the commercial team grows.

  • The pace and energy of a fast-growth tech start-up, where your work is visible and your results directly shape the business.

  • A direct line to the CEO while the commercial leadership team is built out, and a seat close to the decisions on pricing, proposition and territory.

  • A proven, cash-generative product with strong references and award-winning technology. You are selling something that works.

  • Client Success Managers who run the operational side, so your time goes on selling and growing.

  • A purpose-driven company reshaping how parking and mobility work, a collaborative culture, and friendly office dogs.

descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein PEPP-Wissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR-Psych im Detail, weißt, wo im Klinikalltag Erlöse verloren gehen, und hast schon mit dem MD über Fälle diskutiert? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bringst sie in psychiatrische und psychosomatische Kliniken in ganz Deutschland.

Die Kodierung in Psychiatrie und Psychosomatik folgt eigenen Regeln. Therapieeinheiten, ergänzende Tagesentgelte, Fallzusammenführungen und Personalvorgaben machen PEPP zu einem der anspruchsvollsten Systeme im Krankenhaus, und jede Lücke in Dokumentation oder Kodierung kostet Erlöse und führt zu MD-Prüfungen. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software PEPP so gut versteht wie die besten Kodierfachkräfte. Genau dafür brauchen wir Dich.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in weniger Streit mit dem MD und in Stunden, die Kodierteams und Therapeut:innen zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova PEPP beibringen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS Kapitel 9, DKR-Psych, PEPP-Katalog und PsychPV/PPP-RL in klare Kodierregeln, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Testfälle, inklusive Therapieeinheiten, ergänzender Tagesentgelte und Fallzusammenführungen.

  • KI-Vorschläge prüfen: Du bewertest die Kodiervorschläge von Valova und markierst, was stimmt und was nicht. So wird die Qualität messbar besser.

  • Auf dem Laufenden halten: Du arbeitest Katalogänderungen zum Jahreswechsel und neue Rechtsprechung ein.

  • Kliniken begleiten: Du betreust Pilot- und Rolloutprojekte vor Ort und remote, schulst Kodierfachkräfte, Medizincontrolling sowie ärztliches und therapeutisches Personal und bist nach dem Go-live die erste fachliche Ansprechperson. Dafür bist Du rund 20–30 % Deiner Zeit unterwegs.

  • Brücke bauen: Du gibst Feedback aus dem Klinikalltag strukturiert an unsere Produktentwicklung weiter.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der PEPP-Kodierung, z. B. als Kodierfachkraft, im Medizincontrolling einer psychiatrischen oder psychosomatischen Einrichtung, beim Medizinischen Dienst oder ärztlich in der Psychiatrie

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR-Psych und dem PEPP-Entgeltsystem

  • Freude daran, Wissen verständlich weiterzugeben, und fließendes Deutsch

Schön, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit MD-Prüfungen

  • Kenntnisse in PsychPV/PPP-RL, stationsäquivalenter Behandlung (StäB) oder PIA-Abrechnung

  • Erfahrung mit KIS- oder Kodiersoftware (z. B. ID DIACOS, Solventum, Orbis, iMedOne) oder mit Software-Einführungen

  • Englisch-Lesekenntnisse

  • Interesse an Daten (z. B. Excel) oder KI

Du erfüllst nicht alles? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Dein PEPP-Praxiswissen zählt für uns mehr als jedes Zertifikat.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin.

  • Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch.

  • Sinn mit Hebel. Statt Rückstände in einer Klinik abzuarbeiten, entlastest Du Kodierteams in vielen Kliniken gleichzeitig.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Reisen ohne Kosten für Dich. Reisekosten übernehmen wir.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

Nach Deiner Bewerbung lernen wir uns in einem ersten Gespräch kennen. Anschließend tauschen wir uns vertiefend über Deine Erfahrung und Deinen Vertriebsansatz aus.

Zum Abschluss lernst Du unser Team persönlich in Berlin oder München kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, freuen wir uns auf die Zusammenarbeit!

Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

  • Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, selbstständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

Benefits

  • Zukunftsorientierte Projekte: Gestalten Sie anspruchsvolle Kraftwerks- und Energieanlagen und bringen Sie Ihre Expertise in die Konstruktion moderner technischer Anlagen ein
