title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
descriptionHtml:
About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.


How We Work
You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. The first is architecture: whether a solution scales, holds across use cases and growing volumes, and runs without constant support. The second is anything that feeds high-stakes decisions. Priorities are set by final business impact.


Who You Are
- You've worked in or closely with Finance: in a finance team, as a finance data partner, or in data work centred on treasury, reconciliation, accounting or FP&A.
- You understand how a finance function works: the close, cash and liquidity, reconciliations and the reports that come out of them.
- You write expert SQL and have strong dimensional or semantic data modelling skills.
- You've built metrics and data products that other teams depend on.
- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end.
- You choose precision over speed when the two conflict.
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value.


Nice to Have
- Databricks and Unity Catalog
- Experience integrating ERP, accounting, banking or treasury systems
- Experience with workflow automation or agents in finance processes
- CI/CD, orchestration and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech, banking or payments


How You'll Grow
In your first months you get to know Finance, the model, the stack and your stakeholders. By six months you're self-sufficient and make judgement calls on scope and design without escalating. From there, you set long-term goals together with your Finance stakeholders, own the data roadmap for treasury, reconciliation and accounting, and mentor others on analytics-engineering practice.

The Team
We're a small central team that works with every function, and Finance is our primary partner. We use a modern stack, you're free to try new tools, and there are incentives for driving change. AI assistants take on routine work so people can focus on harder problems. We work in English, think long term, and build data that functions keep developing after we deliver it

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen und dich mit Datasolut zusammenzubringen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Ressourcen in Microsoft Azure auf, verbindest Netzwerke und Datenquellen und bettest alles sauber in das Gesamtkonstrukt ein.

  • Du setzt Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform selbst um, inklusive Deployments, und sorgst mit CI/CD für saubere und robuste Prozesse.

  • Du führst das wachsende Cloud-Team mit aktuell drei Engineers fachlich.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Data & AI Engineers zusammen, damit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Datenplattformen wie Databricks und KI-Lösungen nahtlos zusammenspielen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • 4 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Cloud Engineering, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, insbesondere Terraform, sowie mit CI/CD und DevOps-Prinzipien.

  • Gutes Verständnis von Netzwerken, Security und der Anbindung von Datenquellen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Databricks ist ein großes Plus. Kenntnisse in AWS oder Snowflake sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist sehr wünschenswert. Vor allem solltest du Bock auf Kundenkontakt haben.

  • Führungserfahrung ist kein Muss. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und andere fachlich weiterzubringen.

  • Organisationstalent und Kommunikationsstärke: Du behältst den Überblick und erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich; im Team genauso wie gegenüber Nicht-Techies.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache oder C1-Niveau mit Nachweis) und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das bekommst du

  • Projekte mit echtem Impact statt Beschäftigungstherapie

  • Arbeiten mit modernsten Data- & AI-Technologien wie Databricks und Microsoft Fabric

  • Ein Team, das Bock auf Daten hat und dich mitzieht

  • Raum zum Lernen, Ausprobieren und Wachsen

  • Wahl zwischen JobRad und Deutschlandticket (Urban Sports Club folgt bald!)

  • 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche

  • Modernes Office mit zwei Büroflächen im Herzen von Köln-Ehrenfeld - viele Restaurants für die Mittagspause sind fußläufig erreichbar

  • Eigenes Gym im Office und alle 2 Wochen dienstags nach Feierabend Training mit unserer Personal Trainerin

  • Siebträgermaschine für richtig guten Kaffee

Warum Datasolut?

Als hochmotiviertes Team sind für Datasolut gute Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und offene Kommunikation sehr wichtig. Das Team besteht aus echten Machern mit starken Meinungen, die sich trotzdem nicht zu ernst nehmen.

Die Projekte sind in der Regel auf den Großraum Köln fokussiert, lange Reisezeiten werden also möglichst vermieden. Datasolut legt sehr viel Wert auf ein starkes Team und versucht, Projekteinsätze wenn möglich gemeinsam als Team zu lösen. Neben der Arbeit bei Kunden ist es Datasolut wichtig, interne Projekte und innovative Datenprodukte voranzutreiben.

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Engineer - Front End & Design System
descriptionHtml:
Tech Specialist (Front-end & Design System) TL1

  • Location: London, UK - Hybrid

  • Team: Global Engineering - Commerce & Customer Care

  • Visa: This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You will be fully embedded in the Customer Care org, specifically working on KAE (Kaluza Agent Experience) which is integral to building and enabling an energy specific agent product for servicing customers across multiple channels and the enterprise design system (Nebula) that will enable the next phase of scale for Kaluza. You will be the design system technical expert for the team and the hands-on bridge between design and engineering, turning design intent into accessible, production-quality React components and patterns, bolstering the existing team members with specific technical depth in building and scaling design systems across internal teams. You will work with designers as equal partners.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Working in a product development team with internal users to understand emerging and existing needs to steer the development of the enterprise design system, and supporting the teams who build with it

  • Working closely with designers as equal partners, and with product and engineering, to help shape the future of the global Agent Experience product and the design system

  • Designing, building and shipping React components and patterns that conform to WCAG 2.2 AA to help the team meet their delivery goals

  • Reviewing code from your colleagues, including contributions from outside the team, and setting the quality bar for design fidelity and accessibility

  • Making the design-to-code workflow work in practice, including design tokens, handoff and component documentation

  • Running the contribution process so that teams beyond our own can propose, build and ship into the design system, and leading changes that affect several apps from first proposal to final migration

  • Creating and delivering against the technical strategy for your team in partnership with the engineering manager

  • Promoting engineering, design and delivery best practices within the team, and coaching the engineers and designers who use the design system

  • Shaping how we use AI-assisted development in design system work

  • Championing progressive architecture and reviewing design solutions with other engineering leaders

  • Representing the design system to engineering and wider stakeholders, and helping set its direction

  • Working within a team of other senior leaders responsible for designing and evolving the architecture of the enterprise design system at Kaluza

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Deep experience building Frontend components with React and TypeScript

  • Deep experience designing, building and running design systems, including tokens, component APIs, documentation and versioning

  • Knowledge of implementing and maintaining WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, with practical empathy for users with accessibility needs

  • Good design and UX judgement, starting from the user, and comfortable challenging and being challenged by designers

  • Experience running changes across multiple apps

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with stakeholders across engineering, design, product and the wider business, holding opinions loosely and raising what matters even when it is inconvenient

  • A bias to action and a ‘Can do’ approach to problem solving in the face of uncertainty

  • Experience of mentoring, training and developing other engineers

  • An ability to deliver against a technical strategy iteratively, working through ambiguity to deliver change over longer periods

  • Experience of building and nurturing highly collaborative and engaged teams

  • Comfort with AI-enabled development, ideally leading others in using it well

  • An ability to collaborate with people managers, product managers and agile practitioners to contribute to a high-performing culture

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most

  • 26 days holiday

  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget

  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :
Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet
Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :
    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d'un projet à l'autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • Health Hero : On a aidé HealthHero à scaler une plateforme de télémédecine critique à l’échelle européenne, avec un focus fort sur la qualité et la fiabilité. Résultat : un produit robuste, qui tient la charge et supporte des millions d’utilisateurs sans compromis sur l’expérience.
  • LCL : Développement de la nouvelle néobanque du LCL (L by LCL), une plateforme digitale permettant aux professionnels d’ouvrir et gérer leur compte bancaire en ligne.
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:
  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect : participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager
Une méthodologie basée sur l'apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
  • Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables, faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code.
  • Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ? title: Lead Technical Product Manager, Protocol (Vision Chain)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are building the premier ecosystem for European financial institutions to issue and distribute euro-denominated tokenized assets. We're hiring a Lead Technical Product Manager to own Vision Chain as a product: the foundation that Bitpanda's onchain products run on.

You'll own how the chain works and evolves, covering topics spanning proof systems, core protocol modifications, selecting the infrastructure providers, and more. You'll design and implement compliance, identity and privacy solutions into and on the chain, to satisfy the requirements of both financial institutions and developers. You'll work on this in collaboration with both internal and external product and engineering teams, as well as Bitpanda's Compliance, Legal and Data Protection teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product within a small, senior team.

What you’ll do 

  • Own Vision Chain at the infrastructure level, managing configuration choices (fee mechanism, block building logic, etc.), and modifications to the OP Stack, in collaboration with the OP Labs team.
  • Manage infrastructure partnerships, owning the technical relationship with providers (RPC nodes, indexing, oracles, etc.). 
  • Collaborate with Compliance and Legal to implement regulatorily-compliant onchain transaction screening, identity, and privacy solutions.
  • Run reliability, incidents and cost, and own developer documentation and partner technical onboarding until a developer relations lead joins.
  • Coordinate with the other Vision Web3 product leads to ensure the chain’s technical roadmap supports the product roadmap being built on top of it.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of product or engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on blockchain infrastructure (e.g., L1/L2, rollup-as-a-service, node infrastructure provider, account abstraction, or an exchange protocol team).
  • Deep understanding of EVM rollup mechanics, including sequencing, fees, proofs, withdrawals, bridges, upgrade keys, and account abstraction.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory needs into precise technical requirements and drive them to delivery through engineering teams and external partners without direct management.
  • Experience partnering with Compliance, Legal, and Data Protection teams, possessing working knowledge of the EU crypto regulatory landscape (MiCA, DORA, AML/CFT, sanctions screening).
  • Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills for internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

title: Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

Legal Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers.

You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates.

It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for analytical thinkers who are comfortable with technology and ideally have deployed legal tech before — people who can understand how a legal team works, then build the system that supports it. Where the work turns on legal judgement, we already have lawyers as part of the team who can bring the legal expertise.

What you’ll do

1. Customer Implementation

  • Lead implementation projects for new customers

  • Design workflows and automation tailored to each organisation

  • Configure the platform to support real legal use cases

  • Scope implementations for complex enterprise customers — use cases, sequencing, and where value will land first

2. Solution Design

  • Work directly with legal teams and Legal Ops leaders to understand how they operate

  • Translate legal processes into structured workflows and AI-enabled automation

  • Advise on best practices for implementing legal technology

  • Build and adapt playbooks with the customer, bringing in Legal Intelligence where clause language or negotiation positions need a lawyer’s judgement

3. Technical Build

  • Build integrations and connect Wordsmith to customers’ systems, knowing when to bring in Engineering

  • Build agents, skills, automations and workflows, from standard templates to complex multi-step processes

  • Take on complex reports and playbooks, leaving standard ones, such as a basic NDA blueprint, to the wider customer team

4. Escalation & Fixes

  • Reconfigure playbooks and workflows when a customer’s risk appetite or process changes

  • Act as the escalation point for technical issues and complex training questions from Support and Enablement

  • Run deeper health checks where a setup needs technical or process review

5. Customer Success & Expansion

  • Support onboarding and early adoption

  • Help customers expand into additional workflows and use cases

  • Create the template flows Enablement uses to demo and train on standard product workflows

  • Provide on-site embedded support where a customer needs hands-on technical help

6. Product Feedback

  • Surface patterns, insights, and recurring requests to Product and Engineering

  • Help shape how the product evolves based on real usage

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in legal tech, legal operations, or process transformation

  • Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work

  • Ability to manage customer projects and guide stakeholders through change

  • Comfortable working across legal and technical domains

  • Technical enough to build integrations, agents and automations yourself, and to judge when a problem needs Engineering

  • A fixer’s instinct — comfortable diagnosing a live setup and reworking it when a customer’s needs change

  • Structured thinker — you can turn messy processes into clear systems

  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers

Typical backgrounds include

  • Prior Legal Engineering experience

  • Implementation or solutions consultants in SaaS (CLM / Legal Tech is a plus)

  • Legal Operations Professionals

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. How legal work gets rebuilt around AI is still being written, and Legal Engineers are the people writing it with our customers.

You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. It is a rare place to combine legal judgement with building things.

title: Legal Engineer

Joining Legora means three things.

Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

title: Legal Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

About the Role:

Our Legal team, based in Paris, supports every deal, hire and partnership at H. As requests grow, we want legal work to run on clear processes and good tools rather than on inboxes. You will be the front door for legal requests, run the contract lifecycle day to day, and above all build the tooling and automations that let the team move faster. You will report to our General Counsel.

This is a 6 month internship, open to EFB (Barreau de Paris) students completing their PPI, or to recent graduates of an M2 in business law.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Tooling and automation (the core of the role):

    • Map our existing legal processes and identify bottlenecks.

    • Benchmark tools (contract lifecycle management, e-signature, request management) and deliver a costed recommendation.

    • Build simple automations: intake forms, approval workflows, and Claude projects for first-pass contract reviews.

    • Create a dashboard showing request volumes, turnaround times and active contracts.

  • Front door for legal requests:

    • Receive, triage and route internal requests (NDAs, customer contracts, vendors, HR).

    • Set up and maintain a request tracker (Notion, Linear or similar) with status, priority and deadline.

    • Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep matters moving.

  • Contract lifecycle:

    • Prepare first drafts from templates (NDAs, POCs, standard order forms), always reviewed by the General Counsel.

    • Coordinate internal approvals with Sales, Finance and Engineering, and own our e-signature workflows from start to finish.

    • Maintain a register of signed contracts: parties, dates, term, auto-renewal, notice periods and liability caps.

    • Flag key deadlines such as renewals, terminations and POC end dates.

  • Documentation and knowledge management:

    • Organise the template library and fallback clauses.

    • Write internal playbooks, for example “how to request an NDA” or “customer contract approval flow”.

    • Keep the data room and corporate records up to date (shareholder meetings, President’s decisions, statutory registers).

  • Compliance and inventories:

    • Maintain GDPR records: processing activities, sub-processors and signed DPAs.

    • Inventory our trademark and IP portfolio.

    • Prepare tracking sheets for AI Act compliance.

  • Legal spend tracking:

    • Centralise outside counsel invoices and track budgets per matter.

Requirements:

  • Education:

    • EFB (Barreau de Paris) student looking for a PPI internship, ideally, or a recent M2 graduate in business law.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Solid grounding in contract law, with an interest in commercial, data protection (GDPR) and IP topics.

    • Fluent French and English, written and spoken.

    • Comfortable with modern tools (Notion, Google Workspace, spreadsheets) and keen to use AI in your daily work.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Highly organised and rigorous: nothing falls through the cracks, and every deadline is tracked.

    • You follow up without being asked and keep several matters moving at once.

    • Clear writer, able to turn a process into a playbook anyone can follow.

    • Discreet with confidential information.

  • Bonus Skills:

    • Experience building simple automations or no-code workflows.

    • Exposure to legal tech (CLM, e-signature platforms) or legal operations.

    • Interest in AI regulation, including the AI Act.

Location:

  • Paris.

  • This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

What We Offer:

  • Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups.

  • Real ownership: the processes and tools you build will become how our Legal team works.

  • Work directly with our General Counsel on live deals and compliance topics.

  • Collaborate with a fun, dynamic, and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment.

  • Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development.

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Sleutel jij graag aan techniek die blijft bewegen? Als Liftmonteur in onze werkplaats zorg jij ervoor dat bouwliften in topconditie blijven. Met jouw technische kennis los je storingen op en maak je iedere lift klaar voor gebruik.

Jouw baan als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats bij RECO

Als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats van de afdeling Verticaal Transport bij RECO zorg jij dat onze bouwliften altijd veilig draaien en klaarstaan voor de volgende klus. Jij sleutelt aan personen- en goederenliften, loopt ze volledig na en zorgt dat storingen snel opgelost worden. Of het nou mechanisch of elektrisch is: jij zoekt het probleem op en vindt de passende oplossing. Ook bij grotere of ingewikkelde storingen draai jij je hand niet om voor een goede oplossing.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

✅ Onderhouden, inspecteren en gereedmaken van bouwliften in onze werkplaats.
✅ Opsporen en verhelpen van mechanische en elektrische storingen.

✅ Zelfstandig complexe storingen uitlezen, analyseren en verhelpen;
✅ Werken vanuit de werkplaats en waar nodig afstemmen met collega-monteurs om samen tot de beste oplossing te komen.

Requirements

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 Je bent 32 - 40 uur per week beschikbaar van 7-16 uur;👍 Werkervaring hebt op het gebied van mechatronisch en bij voorkeur ook elektrotechniek;
👍 Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;
👍 Je hebt bij voorkeur een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer in bezit;
👍 Je bent in het bezit van je VCA-certificaat óf wil deze via ons behalen;
👍 Je bent een echte doener, neemt initiatief, probleemoplossend vermogen én kunt goed samenwerken.

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met:

✅ Een goed salaris;

✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waardering voor geen ziekteverzuim;

✅ Overwerkvergoeding;

✅ Een collectieve zorgverzekering én goede pensioenregeling met maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO;

✅ Een mobiele telefoon van de zaak;

✅ Veel opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via onze RECO Academy;

✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie: iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, de lijnen zijn kort en je loopt gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnen. Daarnaast organiseren we een goed verzorgde zomerbarbecue en een groots eindejaarspersoneelsfeest! Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze .

Over RECO

RECOis dé specialist in het verhuren van bouwplaats materialen voor uiteenlopende projecten in de bouw, infra, renovatie, overheid en evenementen. Met een aanpakkers mentaliteit en betrokken collega’s werken we samen aan slimme materieeloplossingen.

title: Manager, Business Development
descriptionHtml:
Manager, Business Development

 

About us
We’re solving AI’s hardest problem: alignment.

 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world’s leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we’re solving AI’s hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

 

We’re a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

 

We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

 

The role
You’ll be the first-line leader of Encord’s Commercial Associates (CAs) and the person who makes sure they win. Our CAs aren’t traditional SDRs. They own their territory, build their own playbook, and learn by sitting on live deals alongside our senior sellers. You’ll coach them day to day, hold the standard for pipeline, and turn a group of ambitious, hungry people into our next generation of Account Executives.

 

You’ll be obsessively focused on making sure the leading AI teams, from exciting growth-stage startups to F500 organizations, know how Encord can help them bring their AI applications to market, and why they should choose to work with us. You’ll work with our Sales, Marketing and Customer Success leadership to keep the engine running, and you’ll have the autonomy to build the team to continue to achieve our targets.

 

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of CAs day to day through 1:1s, call reviews, pipeline reviews and live-deal shadowing

  • Own the team’s pipeline and meeting targets, and inspect the numbers so you know where to step in

  • Hire and onboard new CAs, with ramp plans that help them get productive fast

  • Be the bridge between CAs and Account Executives, creating opportunities for CAs to sit on deals and learn

  • Help shape how the CA program evolves as the team and the company scale

 

Who we’re looking for
You’re ambitious, driven, and make up for any gaps in experience with intelligence, grit, and a growth mindset. You’re a coach at heart. You get your energy from seeing the people on your team grow and win, and you’re comfortable being in the details of their day. You have natural hustle, build relationships easily, and thrive on lofty goals.

 

You like building things as you go and you move toward ambiguity. You want high impact and fast pace.

 

Experience requirements

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS or technology sales, including 2+ years managing or coaching a team of SDRs, BDRs or early-career sellers

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline targets, both as an individual and as a leader

  • Experience hiring, onboarding and developing reps, including helping them move into AE or other commercial roles

  • Experience with outbound prospecting at volume, including into technical buyers such as engineers, ML practitioners or data scientists

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot), sales engagement tools and structured qualification methodologies

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Bonus: experience selling developer tools, infrastructure or technical platforms. Experience using AI tools in prospecting and coaching. Experience in a high-growth startup. Curiosity about AI, robotics, or the future of Physical AI.

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

 

Operating principles


High agency
You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency
We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry
We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn’t last long.

Invent in real time
We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there’s no playbook.

 

If you’re looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we’d love to meet you.

descriptionHtml:
Was wir tun
"Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen"

Mit dieser Zielsetzung hat sich VISPIRON ENERGY eine strategische Position im Zukunftsmarkt der erneuerbaren Energien erarbeitet. Das ursprünglich auf Photovoltaikparks spezialisierte Unternehmen legte im Jahr 2017 den Fokus auf die Vernetzung regenerativer Energiesysteme und konzipierte das Ökosystem ENERGY WORLD. Regenerative Energieerzeuger, Verbraucher, Speicher und Hochleistungsladesäulen werden in diesem Ökosystem vernetzt und intelligent bewirtschaftet. Wir decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Hierzu arbeiten die hochspezialisierten Unternehmen VISPIRON ENERGY, VISPIRON EPC und SEtrade als Einheit zusammen und decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

  • hast Freude daran, neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, Menschen für gemeinsame Projekte zu begeistern und nachhaltiges Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir

  • Wir arbeiten seit 20 Jahren täglich daran, die Abhängigkeit von fossilen Energieträgern zu beenden.
  • Wir wollen eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.
  • Wir glauben an das Potential unserer Mitarbeiter:innen.

  • Entwicklung neuer Konzepte zur Erweiterung der Projektpipeline.
  • Pflege und Ausbau eines belastbaren Netzwerks aus Flächeneigentümern, Projektpartnern und Branchenkontakten.

Qualifikation

Deine Kompetenzen

Background: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, wünschenswert im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien. Wichtiger aber als dein Ausbildungsweg sind für uns deine Erfahrungen in der Akquise, dein Verhandlungsgeschick und dein unternehmerisches Denken.

Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Projektakquise, Projektentwicklung, Flächensicherung, Immobilienentwicklung, Geschäftsentwicklung oder im Vertrieb komplexer Infrastruktur-, Energie- oder Immobilienprojekte.

Verhandlungsgeschick: Erfahrung in der Verhandlung von Nutzungsverträgen, Gestattungsverträgen, Kooperationsvereinbarungen oder vergleichbaren Vertragswerken.

  • Wirkung: Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass neue Charge Farms, Energieparks und Batteriespeicherprojekte wie unser Energiepark Egling Realität werden – und damit zur Energiewende und zu einer enkeltauglichen Zukunft.

  • Standort: Unser Büro befindet sich in München und ist öffentlich gut erreichbar.

Warum brauchen wir dich im Team?

Unsere Projektakquise ist der Ausgangspunkt unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Hier entstehen die Projekte, die später entwickelt, finanziert, gebaut und betrieben werden.

Als Manager Business Development (m/w/d) identifizierst du neue Potenziale, erschließt neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Flächeneigentümer, Unternehmen, Kommunen und Projektpartner für gemeinsame Vorhaben und sicherst die Projektrechte für zukünftige Energieprojekte.

Du baust Netzwerke auf, verhandelst auf Augenhöhe mit unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern und schaffst die Grundlage für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen.

Dabei verbindest du unternehmerisches Denken mit Umsetzungsstärke und leistest einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum unserer ENERGY WORLD.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Chancen zu erkennen, Menschen zu begeistern und Projekte von Anfang an auf den Weg zu bringen, wirst du in dieser Rolle maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Mission beitragen:

Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

RV Tech is redefining what a car can be by making continuous iteration and improvement core to the product. Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates are what make that model possible — allowing us to seamlessly and rapidly deliver the latest software to both engineering and customer vehicles. As a result, the OTA system sits on the critical path of RV Tech's entire development chain.

As Manager of OTA Vehicle Engineering Berlin, you will lead and grow the Berlin chapter of RV Tech’s OTA team so that they may develop end to end features within the broader OTA ecosystem and support the Volkswagen Group directly in our joint effort to build a software defined vehicle.

We are looking for a highly motivated leader who can operate credibly from the electrical layer to the business strategy layer, and who thrives in complex, ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow the team from a technical and architectural perspective so that they can become an autonomous and self sustaining chapter within the larger OTA organization

  • Own development and testing of OTA features assigned to the Berlin chapter

  • Collaborate with the larger OTA engineering org across all sites (Palo Alto, Irvine, and Belgrade) to build effective work distribution processes to ensure the efficient operation as a satellite chapter

  • Collaborate with Volkswagen Group partners

  • Ability to spend at least 50% of their time contributing technically to the OTA system

Qualifications

Leadership Qualifications

  • 5+ years in software development or integration, including 2+ years managing engineers.

  • Track record of leading technical teams within a highly cross functional, international environment

  • Proven ability to bring order to a complex product and stakeholder network — technically, operationally, and organizationally.

  • Ability to reason across the full tech stack, from domain software to larger vehicle architecture architecture, and speak authoritatively at each level.

  • Experience building software platforms for complex, distributed, electromechanical systems (aerospace, automotive, defense, or robotics).

  • Experience with systems engineering and architectural development.

  • Experience establishing software development processes, test automation, and operational KPIs.

Technical Experience

Required

  • High-performance C++ and/or Rust applications for co-habitated POSIX systems.

  • Embedded software in C and/or Rust for real-time operating systems.

  • Experience Developing test automation software in Python and Go.

Preferred

  • Experience in developing software infrastructure Over the Air Updates on deployed products

  • Experience with automotive diagnostic protocols UDS, SOVD

title: Marketing Intern
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Most people have no idea what benefits they actually have. And most of the teams running those benefits spend their week managing them in spreadsheets. Both of those are problems AI can help solve.

Ben is the agentic benefits platform for global enterprise. One system across every market, with AI doing the checking and the chasing so the people can do the deciding. We're seven years in, we built it from scratch, and there's a lot left to solve.

Your Mission

As Ben's Marketing Intern, you'll turn marketing strategy into the things people actually see. The direction is set — the positioning, the argument, who we're talking to. Your job is to make the work that carries it: the posts, the pages, the campaign assets, the video clips.

You'll sit with the marketing team for twelve months and learn from how great marketing actually gets made. You’ll get to experience the whole process: from the argument to the thing that ships: the report, the posts, the pages, the ad variants, the clips, the event stand. At a bigger company you'd get one of those. Here you get all of it, and quick, direct feedback from experts who care how it's done.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Content production and reuse: taking a report, a podcast episode or an article and building the posts, emails, pages and sales assets that carry it

  • Social: owning the company page calendar, and making it easier for our execs and the wider team to post

  • Website and SEO housekeeping: on-page fixes, metadata, internal linking, blog uploads, and the audit items that never reach the top of anyone's list

  • Event and campaign creative build: turning a concept into the invites, stand copy, follow-ups and post-event content.

  • Video and podcast support: clips, captions, show notes, distribution

  • Paid and campaign build alongside our demand gen lead: social ad variants and audiences, HubSpot landing pages, forms, emails and lists, and tracking.

You'll Love This Role If You...

  • Have built something of your own. A social account with a following, a YouTube series, a newsletter, a side project. Growing an audience from nothing teaches you how content moves people, and that's most of what we do

  • Can take a brief and improve it. Not follow it to the letter, not rewrite it from scratch. Interpret, then make something

  • Are comfortable with new tools, including AI. You'd rather work out how something functions than wait to be shown

  • Care who's reading. You want to know who's on the other end of the thing you're making. Everything else is teachable

No marketing degree and no marketing experience required. What you've made matters more than where you learned to make it.

Why Join Us?

Most internships hand you a spreadsheet and a coffee order. This one hands you the LinkedIn account.

You'll be one of a small marketing team, reporting to our Content Lead, working on the launches and campaigns that the rest of the year hangs off. You'll get the whole experience, from strategy to content shipped, because you'll be the one shipping it. You'll get direct feedback, quickly, from people who care about the craft.

It's a twelve-month fixed term. If it goes the way we think it will, we'll want to talk about what comes next.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you.

  • 💰 £25,000-£30,000 plus our other Ben benefits

  • 🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays (pro rata)

  • ❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

  • 💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase - this also includes an annual health check

  • 🧠 Comprehensive and tailored mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider

Diversity and Culture at Ben

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying but all applications are very much welcome. title: Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

  • Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.

  • Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

  • Du machst aus unseren Beta-Familien Fans: Reviews, Videos, Testimonials, echte Geschichten.

  • Du baust den Funnel von Warteliste bis Abo: Landingpage, Shop, E-Mail-Flows, Empfehlungsprogramm, Abo-Aktivierung, Kündigungs-Prävention.

  • Du schaltest Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) selbst, misst sauber (Tracking, Attribution, CAC, LTV) und entscheidest nach Zahlen.

  • Du bringst uns in die Magazine, Podcasts und Feeds, die Eltern in DACH wirklich lesen und hören.

  • Du machst die Gründer sichtbar (LinkedIn, Instagram) – vor dem Launch unser günstigster Kanal.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Marketing hält, was das Produkt verspricht: keine Kinder als Werbefiguren, Datenschutz vorgelebt, Werbung sauber gekennzeichnet, kein Fake-UGC.

  • Du hast ein Krisen-Playbook in der Schublade, falls Onoo einem Kind mal etwas Falsches sagt.

  • Du baust ab dem Launch das Team und holst Freelancer und Agenturen dazu, wo es sich lohnt.

Melde dich, wenn:

  • Du 5+ Jahre Consumer-Marketing gemacht hast, am liebsten D2C mit Abo oder Hardware.

  • Du schon mal eine Marke von null aufgebaut hast oder beim Aufbau ganz vorne dabei warst.

  • Du UGC nicht nur kennst, sondern eine Creative-Testing-Maschine gebaut hast und uns sagen kannst, welche Hook-Rate dein bestes Creative hatte und warum.

  • Du Lifecycle-Marketing kannst: Klaviyo oder Ähnliches, Flows, Segmente, Churn.

  • Du Zahlen magst: CAC, LTV, Cohorts, Payback und mit unserem Finance-Mitgründer eine Sprache sprichst.

  • Du selbst Ads schaltest, Texte schreibst, Videos schneidest, Decks baust und nicht nur delegierst.

  • Du den DACH-Markt kennst und verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse mitbringst.

  • Du KI-Tools für Content täglich nutzt und weißt, wo ihre Grenze ist.

  • Du Kinder, Eltern und Bildung spannend findest. Nicht nur als Zielgruppe.

  • Du Verantwortung willst, bevor alles fertig ist.

Eher nicht, wenn: du zuletzt vor allem Budgets und Agenturen gesteuert hast und nicht mehr selbst Hand anlegen willst. Oder wenn du nur Performance kannst, aber keine Marke. Oder nur Marke, aber keine Zahlen.

title: Marketing Manager (12-18 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE BRAND TEAM

The Brand Team is responsible for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, performance and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and exploration.

THE ROLE

Plan and deliver integrated marketing that builds the Carwow brand and drives results, from big campaigns to always-on activity.

You’ll own campaigns from brief to results, working across brand and performance so everything we put out works hard at every stage of the funnel. You’ll brief and manage in-house creatives and agency partners, as well as working closely with performance, CRM and content teams. You’ll also use data to shape the work and prove its impact as part of a performance-focused Marketing team. Most of your focus will be the UK, with some work supporting our team in Spain.

This is a 12-month contract with real ownership. In that time you’ll establish test and learn plans across our marketing stack, run flagpole campaigns for new launches and leave behind ways of working that last beyond your time with us.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver integrated campaigns from brief to results, across brand and performance channels.

  • Building relationships across the org to ensure adoption of systems and processes, including AI innovation

  • Manage campaign budgets and keep spend accurately tracked.

  • Support our team in Spain to adapt campaigns for their market.

  • Find and test new ways of working, including AI, to plan and deliver faster.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in marketing, in-house or agency, ideally at a consumer brand or scale-up.

  • A track record of integrated campaigns that delivered commercial results, across brand and performance.

  • Strong knowledge of ATL and digital channels, including TV, OOH, Meta, YouTube and paid search.

  • Experience briefing and managing creative and media agencies.

  • Comfortable with data: reading results, running tests and turning insight into action.

  • Confident managing budgets and tracking spend.

  • Hands-on use of AI in your marketing work, and a clear view on where it helps and where it doesn’t.

  • Strong stakeholder management, adapting your style for different teams and levels.

  • Able to get up to speed quickly and deliver from the start.

  • Organised and calm under pressure, running several projects at pace as priorities shift.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in marketplace or other two-sided businesses.

  • Experience running creator or brand partnerships.

  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as Looker or Amplitude.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

descriptionHtml:

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingstrategie & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründer:in und dem restlichen Kreativteam die Markenstrategie von Cell Labs weiter und gestaltest u. a. den bevorstehenden Produktlaunch aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events.

  • Digital Marketing & Performance: Du entwickelst unsere digitale Sichtbarkeit weiter, optimierst Website, SEO und SEA und setzt zielgerichtete Kampagnen auf. Dabei testest du neue Ansätze und verbesserst kontinuierlich ihre Wirkung.

  • Content & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt komplexe Robotik-Technologien in verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte für unsere Website, Social Media, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Gründern, dem Brand- und Designteam sowie den Engineers zusammen.

  • Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Marketingkampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, entwickelst Maßnahmen zur B2B-Leadgenerierung und machst Cell Labs bei relevanten Industrieunternehmen und Partnern sichtbar.

  • Events & Kooperationen: Du planst und begleitest relevante Messen, Konferenzen und Partneraktivitäten – von der Vorbereitung der Marketingmaterialien über die Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung.

  • Marketing Operations & Analytics: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten.

  • Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit unseren Gründern unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Materialien, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Zahlenverständnis: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und Performance-Kennzahlen gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt Daten, um Marketingmaßnahmen kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
