When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for an ambitious, commercially driven B2B Sales Executive to join our Sponsorship Sales team at The Alliance.

Ideally, you’ll have experience in B2B sales, events, media, or delegate sales, and be comfortable working towards ambitious targets and KPIs. You’ll already understand the importance of prospecting, building relationships, and closing deals, and now you’re ready to develop those skills further in a new commercial environment.

At The Alliance, we connect leading B2B brands with senior decision-makers through our professional communities, exclusive events, and tailored sponsorship solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to work with established brands, develop your commercial expertise, and learn how to sell higher-value solutions.

We’re looking for someone who wants more than just their next sales job. Someone who is motivated to improve, ready to take ownership of their results, and determined to build a successful long-term career in sales.

Sponsorship products:

  • Sponsored Digital Products: (i.e webinars, reports and lead generation campaigns): Scalable, bespoke programs that connect vendors with our communities through awareness and lead generation.

  • Face-to-Face Events: Summits sponsorships, from an expo table to becoming part of the event itself. These give sponsors direct, in-person access to our community, from meeting attendees at their stand to being part of the event experience, with the chance to build relationships.

What You Will Be Doing

  • New Business Development: Proactively identify and approach prospective clients to generate new business opportunities.

  • Prospecting & Outreach: Build a strong pipeline through outbound calls, emails, research, and consistent follow-up.

  • Building Relationships: Develop relationships with prospective clients, understand their needs, and identify commercial opportunities.

  • Sales & Negotiation: Present relevant solutions, handle objections, negotiate effectively, and close deals.

  • Revenue Generation: Work towards ambitious sales targets and KPIs, taking ownership of your performance and results.

  • Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate sales records, track opportunities, and manage your pipeline effectively.

  • Account Development: Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships and generate repeat business.

  • Continuous Improvement: Learn from experienced colleagues, act on feedback, and continuously develop your sales skills.

What We’re Looking For

  • Sales Experience: Ideally, experience in B2B sales, delegate sales, events, media, or another target-driven commercial environment.

  • A Proven Sales Mindset: You’re comfortable working towards demanding targets and KPIs and motivated by achieving results.

  • Confidence & Communication: You can build rapport, engage prospects, and communicate commercial value effectively.

  • A Hunter Mentality: You enjoy prospecting, opening doors, generating opportunities, and winning new business.

  • Resilience & Determination: You can handle rejection, stay focused under pressure, and maintain momentum.

  • Commercial Ambition: You want to develop your sales ability, take on greater responsibility, and increase your earning potential as you progress.

  • A Desire to Learn: You’re receptive to coaching, willing to challenge yourself, and committed to continuous improvement.

Above all, we want people who are hungry to succeed, take pride in their results, and are serious about taking their sales career to the next level.

If you have the drive to deliver results and the ambition to become an exceptional salesperson, we’d love to hear from you.

Location: This role can be either Hybrid in our London office or completely remote across the UK (not abroad).

Salary: Base Salary range £32K - £38K (*Based on previous experience) - OTE £60K+

_______________________

 

Benefits

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

  • Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

  • WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget

  • A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office

Health & wellbeing

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa

  • Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary

  • On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill

  • Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes

  • Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes

  • Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you

Learning & development

  • A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year)

  • Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

  • Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.
If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.
We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

Compensation: £32K – £38K • £15K – £40K Commission

descriptionHtml:
Ready to grow your claims career faster than the traditional industry allows?

We’re looking for a Pet Claims Handler to join ClaimSorted.

This role is ideal for:

  • a Claims Handler who wants to build their career at a company that rewards performance, not tenure

  • someone with 6+ months of claims experience who is hungry to learn and grow fast

We are not looking for tenure for the sake of it. We are looking for people with talent, ambition, work ethic, and the drive to build a real career.

If you join us, we will give you the training and support to become the best Claims Handler possible - from people management to performance management, data, quality, and capacity planning. Our goal is to help you become one of the best claims leaders of the future.


Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What you’ll do

  • Handle claims end to end: from first notification of loss through to settlement

  • Communicate with policyholders throughout the claims journey, ensuring a clear and positive experience

  • Review documentation, verify coverage, and assess liability accurately

  • Set appropriate reserves and manage claims within your authority

  • Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately

  • Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by flagging process inefficiencies

What we’re looking for

  • Based in the UK or Ireland with work authorisation

  • 6+ months of pet claims experience or 12+ months veterinary experience and must be APA or CIP qualified

  • Fluency in Spanish or Italian is a strong plus

  • Strong organisation and ability to prioritise independently

  • Comfortable using data to make decisions

  • Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching others is a plus

  • Startup or high-growth experience is a plus

Why join us

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

You’ll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work.

If you’re ready to step up, work hard, and build a career in claims, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Health insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • 28 days annual leave

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: €29K – €40K • Offers Equity • 15% Quaterly Bonus

descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

What you would do

  • Take warm opportunities from our SDR and Marketing teams and run with them, your job is to close, not to chase cold leads all day

  • Get under the skin of every prospect: understand their real business challenges and show them exactly how Sanity solves them

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close enterprise deals and get well rewarded when you do

  • Map organisations from the inside out, building relationships across teams from developers to the C-suite

  • Be the voice of the customer internally - your feedback shapes product, messaging, and strategy

  • Keep your pipeline tight: accurate forecasting, clean Salesforce data, and deal reviews that actually reflect reality


About you

  • You're based in Germany and fluent in both German and English - You can close a deal in either language without breaking a sweat

  • You've sold a complex SaaS product before and you know how to navigate technical buyers, marketing leaders, and enterprise procurement all at once

  • You have experience selling into large enterprises and are comfortable managing big, multi-stakeholder deals from first call to signed contract

What we can offer

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive location-based salary and stock options program

 

Who we are

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 200+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

 

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote (Australia or New Zealand)

Type: Full-time, remote

About Neuphonic

Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

Why we're hiring

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.

A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in Australia or New Zealand to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions.

Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale.

What you'll own

  • Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

  • Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.

  • Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements.

  • Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours.

  • Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

  • CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability.

  • Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic.

  • Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response.

  • A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.

  • Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents.

  • A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems.

  • Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems.

  • Based in Australia or New Zealand and comfortable providing production support during agreed hours that complement our UK and India engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM.

  • Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications.

  • Experience with C++.

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks.

  • Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services.

We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world.

You'll collaborate closely with our UK and India teams, with clear handovers between time zones to help ensure our production customers are supported around the clock.

title: Product Manager Website (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Dein Team und Umfeld

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

descriptionHtml:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Regional Field Chief Technology Officer

Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)

Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.
  • Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.
  • Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.
  • Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.
  • Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.
  • Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.
  • Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.
  • Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.
  • Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.
  • Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.
  • Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.
  • Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.
  • Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or other advanced degree.

title: Senior Mobile Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 6+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  1. Quick call with a Recruiter

  2. 15 minute cognitive test

  3. Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  4. Technical interview (90 minutes)

  5. Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.

  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.

descriptionHtml:

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

  • Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

  • Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Responsable comptable adjoint(e)
descriptionHtml:
Vous aimez la comptabilité dans toute sa dimension opérationnelle ? Vous appréciez autant la technicité des travaux de clôture que l'analyse des résultats et la fiabilisation des données financières ?

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Comptable Adjoint(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et accompagner le suivi comptable et financier de notre entreprise et de ses filiales françaises.

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Administrative et financière, vous occupez un rôle polyvalent et central, associant production comptable, révision des comptes, reporting financier et suivi fiscal. Vous intervenez concrètement dans les opérations du quotidien tout en contribuant aux travaux financiers et aux remontées d'informations destinées au Groupe.

Vos missions

  1. Assurer la gestion comptable au quotidien

  • Réaliser les opérations courantes de comptabilité générale et fournisseurs.

  • Assurer ponctuellement la saisie et l'enregistrement des factures fournisseurs.

  • Effectuer le rapprochement des factures avec les commandes et les réceptions.

  • Contrôler les imputations comptables et analytiques.

  • Participer au suivi et à la justification des comptes.

2. Participer aux clôtures et à la révision des comptes

  • Préparer et contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles.

  • Participer à l'élaboration du bilan et du compte de résultat.

  • Réaliser les travaux de révision : justification des comptes, contrôle des écritures, rapprochements et régularisations.

  • Veiller à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données comptables.

3. Contribuer au reporting et à la consolidation

  • Participer aux travaux de consolidation des comptes du Groupe.

  • Collecter, contrôler et fiabiliser les données financières des différentes entités.

  • Élaborer les reportings périodiques et les tableaux de bord destinés au Responsable Administratif.

  • Participer à l'analyse des résultats et à la préparation des données financières présentées au Groupe.

4. Apporter votre soutien au contrôle de gestion

  • Participer à la préparation et à l'analyse des résultats.

  • Contribuer au suivi des données analytiques et à l'analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et les prévisions.

  • Participer à la fiabilisation des indicateurs de performance.

5. Participer au suivi de la trésorerie et de la fiscalité

  • Contribuer au suivi des flux et des positions de trésorerie des filiales françaises.

  • Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de trésorerie.

  • Préparer, établir et contrôler les déclarations de TVA et autres déclarations fiscales.

  • Veiller au respect des échéances et des obligations déclaratives.


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance, de type DCG, Licence professionnelle ou équivalent (Bac +3 minimum).

Vous justifiez idéalement de plus de 5 années d'expérience minimum en comptabilité générale, acquises de préférence dans un environnement multi-sociétés ou au sein d'une PME structurée.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes comptables, les opérations de clôture et de révision ainsi que les obligations fiscales courantes, notamment en matière de TVA.

Une connaissance des processus de consolidation, du reporting financier et du suivi de trésorerie sera particulièrement appréciée.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel, et savez exploiter des données comptables pour en tirer des analyses fiables.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée, attachée à la fiabilité de son travail.

  • Autonome et impliquée, capable de prendre en charge ses missions de bout en bout.

  • Polyvalente, appréciant autant les opérations comptables concrètes que les travaux d'analyse.

  • Dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

  • À l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et appréciant le travail en équipe.

title: Responsable de mission - identification électronique des professionnels de santé H/F
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé et contribue au développement de services numériques sécurisés, interopérables et adaptés aux besoins des professionnels et des usagers.

Au sein de la Direction des Territoires et de l’Expérience Client (DTEX), rattaché au domaine Études, Offre, Déploiement et Formation, vous contribuez au déploiement des services et référentiels socles du numérique en santé, notamment ceux liés à l’identification électronique des acteurs de santé. Le programme Identité Substantielle de Santé (ISS) porte une transformation majeure des processus d’identification électronique, avec des enjeux de sécurité, de conformité réglementaire et d’évolution des pratiques à l’échelle nationale. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produits et programmes, les équipes métier, les acteurs de la relation client ainsi qu’avec les partenaires institutionnels et territoriaux.

🎯 Responsabilités principales

  • Structurer et accompagner le déploiement : contribuer à la définition de la stratégie et des modalités de déploiement des nouveaux processus et services, identifier les populations à accompagner en priorité et définir les dispositifs adaptés à leurs besoins.

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les dispositifs d’accompagnement : élaborer les modalités d’accompagnement des différents acteurs de l’écosystème (relais territoriaux, établissements, professionnels de santé, etc.), notamment à travers des supports et modules de formation, des actions d’information et des dispositifs de support.

  • Accompagner l’appropriation des services et produits : vulgariser les évolutions techniques et fonctionnelles auprès de publics variés et faciliter la prise en main des solutions liées à l’identité numérique en santé, notamment Pro Santé Connect (PSC), ePSC, France Identité et les solutions d’identification électronique.

  • Assurer l’interface entre les équipes produits et le terrain : recueillir les besoins, questions et difficultés rencontrées par les utilisateurs, analyser les retours du terrain et assurer leur transmission auprès des équipes produits et de développement afin de contribuer à l’amélioration continue des services.

  • Animer les réseaux et les parties prenantes : travailler avec les relais territoriaux et les différents acteurs de l’écosystème, adapter les messages aux différents publics et contribuer à la diffusion d’une information claire et homogène sur les évolutions du programme.

  • Vulgariser les sujets techniques : rendre accessibles les éléments techniques portés par la Direction Expertise, Innovation et International (DEII) et faciliter leur compréhension par les acteurs non techniques, notamment sur les enjeux d’identité, d’authentification et de sécurité.

  • Piloter l’activité et les contributions externes : suivre les indicateurs liés au déploiement et à l’appropriation des services, garantir la qualité des livrables et coordonner les contributions de prestataires externes nécessaires à la mise en œuvre des dispositifs d’accompagnement.

  • Assurer le suivi administratif des prestations : contribuer au suivi des prestations externes, notamment à travers la préparation et le suivi des documents administratifs nécessaires à leur réalisation (BDC, SF, etc.).


💼 Profil recherché

  • Expérience confirmée d’au minimum 5 ans dans l’accompagnement au déploiement de services ou de transformations numériques

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement avec un background ingénieur ou technique

  • Expérience dans le domaine de l’identité numérique, de l’authentification, du numérique en santé et/ou du secteur public

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à l’identification électronique en santé et, idéalement, des solutions telles que Pro Santé Connect, ePSC, France Identité, les clés FIDO ou les cartes CPS

  • Capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes et à les rendre accessibles à des interlocuteurs variés

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en pédagogie

  • Très bonnes qualités relationnelles et diplomatiques, avec une capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs aux profils et niveaux d’expertise variés

  • Capacité à travailler en transversalité avec des équipes techniques, métier et opérationnelles

  • Capacité à recueillir, analyser et faire remonter les besoins et retours du terrain auprès des équipes produits

  • Expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de dispositifs d’accompagnement, de formation ou de conduite du changement

  • Capacité à animer un réseau de parties prenantes et à coordonner différents contributeurs

  • Autonomie, rigueur et capacité à piloter plusieurs sujets dans un environnement complexe et évolutif

  • Fort intérêt pour les missions de service public et les enjeux du numérique en santé

title: Responsable du Développement Commercial , Location d’Équipements Industriel
descriptionHtml:
Région Normandie | Basé au Havre | Temps plein

À propos de l’entreprise

Rain for Rent International France est spécialisée dans la location d’équipements industriels et propose des solutions adaptées de stockage et de transfert des fluides dans des environnements industriels exigeants, notamment dans les secteurs chimique et pétrochimique.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance, nous renforçons notre développement commercial en Normandie, et plus particulièrement dans la région du Havre, l’un des principaux bassins industriels de France.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable du Développement Commercial pour contribuer activement au développement de notre activité régionale et à l’acquisition de nouveaux clients industriels.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

En tant que Responsable du Développement Commercial, vous êtes au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance dans la région havraise.

Votre mission principale consiste à identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, développer notre portefeuille clients et construire des relations durables avec les principaux acteurs industriels de la région.

Vous êtes un véritable ambassadeur de Rain for Rent auprès de nos clients et prospects. Vous comprenez leurs enjeux, identifiez leurs besoins et leur proposez des solutions techniques à forte valeur ajoutée, en collaboration étroite avec nos équipes internes et notre réseau de partenaires.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Régional, auquel vous reportez, et contribuez directement au développement et à la croissance de l’activité sur votre territoire.

Vos missions

Développement commercial

  • Identifier et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales dans la région Normandie
  • Prospecter activement de nouveaux clients et développer notre présence auprès des sites industriels
  • Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille de clients industriels
  • Construire et entretenir des relations durables avec les interlocuteurs et décideurs clés
  • Comprendre les besoins techniques et opérationnels des clients et proposer des solutions adaptées
  • Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection à la contractualisation
  • Développer la visibilité de Rain for Rent sur le marché régional

Gestion de projets & coordination

  • Identifier les besoins des clients et contribuer à la définition des solutions techniques appropriées
  • Suivre les opportunités et projets commerciaux en collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles
  • Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes nécessaires à la réalisation des projets
  • Assurer un suivi régulier des projets et maintenir une relation de proximité avec le client
  • Contribuer à garantir la qualité de service et la satisfaction des clients

Stratégie commerciale & analyse de marché

  • Analyser le marché régional et identifier les secteurs et comptes à fort potentiel
  • Assurer une veille commerciale et concurrentielle
  • Identifier les tendances du marché et les nouveaux besoins des clients industriels
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre, en collaboration avec le Responsable Régional, un plan d’action commercial adapté à votre territoire
  • Suivre votre pipeline commercial et vos principaux indicateurs de performance
  • Assurer un reporting régulier de votre activité et de vos opportunités commerciales

Vos compétences

Votre profil

  • Expérience confirmée en développement commercial B2B, idéalement dans un environnement industriel
  • Une expérience commerciale auprès de sites industriels constitue un véritable atout
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements industriels, de leurs contraintes opérationnelles et de leurs processus de décision
  • Expérience ou forte appétence pour les domaines de la gestion des fluides, du traitement des eaux, de la dépollution ou de secteurs industriels similaires
  • Bonne connaissance du tissu industriel de la région du Havre et de la Normandie
  • Un réseau établi auprès d’acteurs industriels de la région sera fortement valorisé
  • Capacité à identifier les besoins des clients et à proposer des solutions techniques adaptées
  • Expérience dans la gestion de projets et la coordination de différents interlocuteurs
  • Forte orientation commerciale et résultats
  • Excellentes capacités relationnelles, de négociation et de communication
  • Autonomie, sens des responsabilités et esprit entrepreneurial
  • Capacité à travailler de manière structurée et à gérer plusieurs opportunités simultanément
  • Français courant ; anglais professionnel ou bonnes notions d’anglais
  • Permis de conduire indispensable

Une expérience dans l’environnement industriel, un véritable atout

Le développement de nouvelles activités auprès des sites industriels nécessite une bonne compréhension de leur environnement, de leurs contraintes opérationnelles et de leurs processus de décision.

Une expérience préalable dans ce type d’environnement constitue donc un véritable avantage pour réussir dans ce poste.

Bien que nos activités ne se limitent pas aux secteurs du raffinage et de la pétrochimie, ces industries représentent actuellement des marchés à fort potentiel de développement dans la région.

Une bonne connaissance des acteurs industriels du bassin havrais et de leurs écosystèmes, ainsi qu’un réseau établi auprès des principaux sites industriels, seront particulièrement appréciés.

Informations complémentaires

  • Prise de poste : dès que possible
  • Localisation : Le Havre, Normandie
  • Déplacements : déplacements réguliers en Normandie et ponctuellement au niveau national
  • Type de contrat : temps plein

Avantages

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un rôle commercial à fort impact sur le développement de notre activité régionale
  • Une grande autonomie dans la gestion et le développement de votre territoire
  • La possibilité de développer un marché industriel à fort potentiel de croissance

Nous nous engageons en faveur de l’égalité des chances, de la diversité et de l’inclusion. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
