title: Revenue Enablement Manager (m/f/d), Just-in-Time Enablement
descriptionHtml:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

Every month, something new reaches our field teams from Product, Product Marketing and Marketing: a new use case, a fresh sales narrative, a campaign, a product update. Too often it arrives as a Slack post or a long deck, and sellers never really pick it up.

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Just-in-Time Enablement, you own that last mile. You are the front door between the teams who create news and the teams who use it, and you make sure every launch reaches Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships across Europe at the right time, in a format they can use in their next conversation.

What you'll do:

  • Run the launch intake. Be the single entry point for PMM, Product, Marketing and others who want something to reach the field. Prioritize with clear criteria so sellers aren't overloaded.

  • Own the field release calendar. Keep one view of what's coming, when, and for whom, shared with creators and sales managers.

  • Turn launches into what sellers need. Shape each release into: what's new, who it's for, why customers care, how to talk about it, and how to handle the likely questions.

  • Coach the creators. Brief PMM, Product and Marketing on what the field needs and review their materials before they go out. When the input is raw (specs, messaging docs, long decks), write the enablement content yourself: short, clear and practical.

  • Deliver just in time. Pick the right format and moment: a 20-minute live session, a short recording, a one-pager, a talk track. Not so early it's forgotten, not so late it's useless.

  • Make it stick. Run practice sessions, give managers simple talking points, and check that sellers can explain the new thing in their own words.

  • Check it landed. Track attendance, usage in calls and deals, and rep feedback. Share what you learn with the creators so the next launch is better.

  • Keep one home for launch material. Everything findable in one place with an owner and a review date; retire what's outdated.

  • Hand over to curriculum. Work closely with your colleagues in the revenue enablement team, who fold a launch into the regular training once it is no longer new. Agree what moves over, when, and in what form, so nothing is built twice.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years in revenue enablement, product marketing, sales training or a similar role in B2B SaaS, ideally at a scaleup.

  • Experience rolling out launches, messaging or campaigns to sales teams, with examples you can share.

  • Ability to explain a product use case or sales narrative simply, and to spot what a seller really needs from it.

  • Strong stakeholder skills: you can say "not this month", ask for a 3-slide version of a 40-slide deck, and keep the relationship strong.

  • Well organized: you juggle several launches at once and hit dates.

  • Clear writing and confident live facilitation.

  • Hands-on with LMS, AI, video editing tools, a CRM and call recording tools, and a habit of using data to check adoption.

  • Fluent English and German.

Nice to have:

  • Background in product marketing or product management.

  • Experience with security, compliance or HR-related products.

  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPICED or MEDDICC.

How success looks like:

First 30 days: learn

  • Meet the leads in PMM, Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Learn how launches reach the field today and where they get lost.

  • Review the last 3-5 launches: what reached the field and what stuck.

  • Agree which upcoming launches come first and who owns what, intake process and readiness gates.

Days 31-60: set up and pilot

  • Start the launch intake and a first field release calendar.

  • Take 1-2 launches through the process, writing the enablement content from the raw input.

  • Agree with the Curriculum team how a launch moves into regular training once it's no longer new.

Days 61-90: prove and adjust

  • Run 2-3 launches end to end; sellers can explain each one in their own words within two weeks of release.

  • Collect feedback from reps, managers and creators, and fix what slowed things down.

  • Share first results with leadership (reach, use in real calls) and a plan for the next quarter.

Who you'll work with:

  • Reports to the Head of Revenue Enablement.

  • Product Marketing and Product, who own the narratives and use cases.

  • Marketing, who run campaigns that sellers need to follow up on.

  • Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships leaders and frontline managers, who receive and reinforce the message.

  • The Curriculum team in Revenue Enablement, who take over launch content for the long-term training programs.

  • Revenue Operations for tools and data.

What we offer*:

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: Sales Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
À propos d’Everfield

Everfield acquiert, développe et accompagne la croissance d’éditeurs européens de logiciels métiers et spécialisés, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l’ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l’écosystème logiciel européen.

Vous transformez les opportunités qualifiées par nos SDR/BDR en nouveaux clients. Chaque deal vous appartient, du discovery call à la signature :

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in London, with a hybrid remote policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

  • Educate & build interest: communicate our value proposition and show how Dotfile helps fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions streamline onboarding, strengthen compliance and scale efficiently

  • Fuel the sales funnel: book qualified meetings with high-potential prospects for our Account Executives

  • Collaborate with Sales & Growth: work closely with AEs and the Growth team to refine targeting, messaging and sequences, and to improve conversion rates

  • Track & optimise performance: keep accurate records in our CRM (HubSpot) and keep improving your outreach based on data and feedback

About you

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a similar role, ideally in fintech, regtech or a fast-growing tech company selling to fintechs, crypto companies or financial institutions

  • Knowledge of the AML, KYC/KYB or risk management space is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message…)

  • You are creative and never run out of new ideas to test, and you’re not afraid to make bold bets

  • You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to your work

  • You are fluent in English and in a second language (French preferably), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • A fast-learning environment with diverse career development options

  • Competitive package and medical plan

  • Hybrid remote policy with an office in Paris

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Deep dive into your past experiences and the choices that shaped your career.

Round 3: Case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 4: Reference check.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France 
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

descriptionHtml:
About the team

The OpenAI Startups team helps founders build and scale products with AI. We combine technical understanding, commercial judgement and startup ecosystem relationships to help customers move from promising ideas to building and scaling their businesses with OpenAI.

About the role

You will lead one of our EMEA Greenfield sales teams, helping high-potential startups choose OpenAI, reach production and establish the foundations for growth. Greenfield covers two distinct motions: Early Stage, focused on activation and meaningful expansion, and Pursuits, focused on high-stakes conversion of the startups with highest potential and new customers with complex buying decisions.

You will translate regional strategy into clear account priorities, hire and develop Account Directors, and coach the customer and commercial work appropriate to the team you lead. You will work closely with technical partners and VC Partnerships to turn founder access and technical engagement into customer value, qualified pipeline and consumption revenue.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week.

In this role, you'll:

  • Recruit, onboard and develop a strong team of Account Directors. Set clear expectations, coach live customer work, sales methodology and deal strategy, as well as giving direct, actionable feedback.

  • Build and execute the Greenfield GTM strategy and sales plan for your team. Prioritise companies using customer need, workload, decision timing, founder and funding signals, commercial potential and available technical capacity.

  • Coach the motion your sellers own. For Early Stage, strengthen discovery, activation, first production use and initial growth. For Pursuits, strengthen competitive strategy, executive access, evaluation, migration planning and negotiation.

  • Create a disciplined pipeline and consumption forecasting rhythm. Connect opportunity stages and revenue expectations to customer evidence, production milestones and specific next decisions.

  • Build trusted relationships with founders, technical leaders and commercial decision-makers. Help the team explain how OpenAI can improve product quality, delivery speed and economics for the customer’s workload.

  • Partner with VC Partnerships, Marketing and developer-facing teams on qualified sourcing and activation. Match direct sales effort, nurture and scaled engagement to customer intent and potential.

  • Align with Solutions and AI Engineering on technical scope, evaluation criteria and support capacity. Bring in Product, Deal Desk, Legal and other partners when their expertise can advance the customer’s decision.

  • Turn technical success into a credible commercial path and sustained paid adoption. Use approved programmes and commercial processes, and ensure customer commitments reflect a realistic production and consumption plan.

  • Build reusable discovery guides, sales plays, competitive playbooks and migration plans. Route routine billing, credits and support requests to the right channels while retaining clear ownership of material customer blockers.

  • Coordinate account transitions with Core and strategic coverage. Preserve customer context, relationships and the next growth plan, and keep ownership clear until a handoff is accepted.

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • Six or more years leading sales teams, including hiring, developing and managing technical sellers in fast-changing markets.

  • Working closely with startups as a founder, early employee or commercial leader serving startup customers.

title: SAP Developer - ABAP & Batch (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die IB.SH

Die Investitionsbank Schleswig-Holstein (IB.SH) ist das zentrale Förderinstitut des Landes. Rund 900 Menschen sorgen in Kiel dafür, dass Wohnungsbau, Unternehmen, Kommunen, Bildung sowie Umwelt- und Energieprojekte in Schleswig-Holstein vorankommen.

Gerade läuft eine der größten Transformationen in der Geschichte der Bank. Die gesamte SAP-Landschaft zieht auf S/4HANA um, die Private-Cloud-Umgebung steht bereits, und bis Ende 2027 soll das neue System produktiv sein.

Du baust das, was nachts läuft, und sorgst dafür, dass die Bank am nächsten Morgen damit arbeiten kann.

Du bist ein IT-Mensch durch und durch, arbeitest aber nicht still im Hintergrund, sondern gern im Austausch mit den Menschen, für die du entwickelst.

Must-haves

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld, oder einen vergleichbaren Weg in die IT

Du kennst nicht jedes Modul? Kein Problem. Das Wissen rund um die bankspezifischen Systeme und Schnittstellen gibt das Team im Alltag weiter.

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit: Deine Systeme stehen hinter der Förderung von Wohnungsbau, Energieprojekten und Unternehmen in ganz Schleswig-Holstein.

title: Security and Compliance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Read up on our $100m Series C

Primer processes payments for some of the world's best companies, which makes us an attractive target and means getting detection and response right really matters. We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response function and own a meaningful slice of how we detect, investigate and respond to threats across our cloud infrastructure and SaaS estate.

You'll write and tune the detections in our SIEM, build the automation that speeds up how we react, and be a first responder when something looks wrong. You'll have real ownership of the areas you work on, and the freedom to shape how we detect and respond to threats across them.

You'll also work closely with our Application Security/Product Security engineers: what we learn from detections and incidents shapes how we build, and what they know about our products shapes what we look for.


What you'll be doing

Detection

  • Build, tune and maintain detections in our SIEM (Elastic), and identify opportunities to onboard new log sources (e.g. AWS, Google Workspace, Kubernetes) and build new detections on top of them.

  • Find what our current detections miss, and keep the rule set lean by removing what no longer adds value.

  • Use Python and Terraform to build and maintain the infrastructure behind your detections and tooling.

Response

  • Own investigation: triage, investigate, escalate and resolve security incidents, and write up findings clearly enough to stand on their own

  • Build runbooks and automations (Python, Tines or similar) to cut manual work out of triage and response

Across both

  • Make and document risk decisions in your area, and know when to pull in others.

  • Use AI tools to work faster across detection and response, from drafting rules and queries to summarising investigations, while maintaining a healthy level of scepticism.

What we're looking for

  • Real experience responding to security incidents, from first alert through to write-up

  • Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk or similar), using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to reason about coverage

  • Experience with cloud-native detection and response in AWS or Google Cloud

Nice to have

  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO27001

  • Background in fintech, payments or another regulated industry

title: Semiconductor Test Engineering Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We are seeking a senior Semiconductor Test Engineering leader to drive manufacturing test strategy and silicon production readiness for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role combines deep technical expertise in high-performance compute silicon with leadership responsibility for internal product engineering teams and external development partners. The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of production test development — from DFT strategy and ATE bring-up through silicon characterisation, yield optimisation, advanced packaging test, and high-volume manufacturing ramp — ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-effective test solutions for advanced AI accelerator platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the manufacturing test strategy for an AI accelerator chip featuring PCIe Gen6, LPDDR, advanced CMOS nodes, and advanced packaging (e.g., 2.5D/3D, chiplet).

  • Lead and manage a team of chip test engineers responsible for test planning, test program development, pattern bring-up, silicon characterization, debug, and optimization.

  • Manage subcontracted test development partners (OSATs, ATE vendors, external engineering services). Includes scoping, technical oversight, schedule tracking, and quality control of deliverables.

  • Define and drive test software architecture, DFT usage, and test pattern development strategies for high-speed logic, SRAM, DRAM, and High Speed IO blocks.

  • Work closely with design, DFT, product engineering, packaging, and validation teams to ensure robust test coverage, manufacturability, and yield ramp success.

  • Oversee test development for high speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen6 and multi-GHz LPDDR.

  • Guide development of structural and functional test content (scan, MBIST, JTAG, HSIO tests, system-level tests).

  • Lead silicon bring-up and development on ATE: correlation, failure analysis, shmooing, corner testing, stress testing, and yield improvement activities.

  • Define KPIs and metrics for subcontractor performance, test coverage, yield, time-to-test, and cost optimization.

  • Drive continuous improvement in test methodologies, automation, data analytics, and debug infrastructure.

  • Ensure robust test flows for advanced packaging (thermals, interposer/bridge connections, TSV integrity, die-to-die IO testing).

  • Support qualification, reliability testing, and high-volume manufacturing transfer.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in semiconductor test engineering, including leadership or technical lead roles.

  • Deep experience with ATE test development (e.g., Advantest 93K, Teradyne).

  • Strong understanding of DFT (scan, ATPG, LBIST, MBIST), memory testing, and high-speed interface testing.

  • Experience managing external test development partners or OSATs.

  • Proven ability to lead and mentor test engineering teams.

  • Solid background in advanced CMOS nodes and familiarity with advanced packaging test challenges.

  • Expertise in silicon debug, characterization, and correlation across ATE and system-level environments.

  • Ability to collaborate across design, architecture, product engineering, packaging, and operations..

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/ML accelerator chips or other high-performance compute ICs.

  • Prior involvement with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or LPDDR4/5/6 test methodologies.

  • Familiarity with signal-integrity-aware test development and high-speed IO margining.

  • Experience with chiplets, 2.5D/3D IC test flows, or heterogeneous integration.

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

title: Senior Airspace Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra.aero is seeking an experienced Senior Airspace Engineer to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.

The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.

This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.

The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.

The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.
  • Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.
  • Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.
  • Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, FAA 8260-series Orders, and international equivalents—to identify regulatory and policy gaps affecting proposed procedures.
  • Evaluate candidate procedures with Electra’s product team, the FAA, airport operations teams, and local air traffic control to prepare for flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and future policy and standards development.
  • Define learning objectives and data collection requirements for flight demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.
  • Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.
  • Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.
  • Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.
  • Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.

What you Bring

  • Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAA and/or EASA regulatory frameworks, including the AC 150 series, Part 135, Part 23, TERPS/PANS-OPS, 8260-series Orders, and relevant airport design standards.
  • Experience working with regulators, air navigation service providers, airport operators, and industry partners.
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading or contributing to airspace integration research, including FAA, NASA, or MITRE airspace modernization initiatives.
  • Experience as an air traffic controller or with a non-FAA service provider specializing in instrument procedure design and development.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und den anderen Engineers zusammen, damit wir das bauen, was zählt - nicht nur das, was dir gesagt wurde. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist.
Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend.
Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (NestJS im Backend, React im Frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (mehrere Datenbanken inkl. PostGIS), Queue-basierte Job-Verarbeitung, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), Infrastructure-as-Code, Claude

Was du konkret tust

  • Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
  • Du modellierst komplexe Immobilien- und ESG-Domänen in relationalen Schemas. Wir betreiben mehrere Postgres-Datenbanken parallel (eine davon geospatial), und Schema-Entscheidungen haben hier langfristige Konsequenzen.
  • Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt.
  • Du entwickelst unser Berechtigungsmodell weiter. Unsere Kunden reichen vom einzelnen Eigentümer bis zum Konzern mit Zugriff auf Organisations-, Portfolio- und Gebäudeebene. Das richtig zu bauen ist echte Design-Arbeit, keine Middleware-Konfiguration.
  • Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar.
  • Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur.
  • Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du hast Features end-to-end über Schema, API und Hintergrundverarbeitung ausgeliefert, die unsere Kunden aktiv nutzen.
  • Unsere asynchrone Verarbeitung (Importe, Extraktion, Analyse-Jobs) ist messbar robuster: weniger stille Fehler, klare Retry- und Recovery-Pfade und Observability, die uns sagt, was kaputt ist und warum.
  • Du hast Ownership für mindestens einen Kernbereich übernommen - z. B. das Berechtigungsmodell, die Job-Orchestrierung oder die LLM-Extraktions-Pipeline - und bist dafür die Anlaufstelle im Team.
  • Du hast Testing und Developer Experience im Backend auf ein neues Level gehoben, und andere Engineers liefern dadurch schneller.
  • Du bist für Product und das Team ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner, wenn wir entscheiden, was wir bauen und wie.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist stark in Postgres. Schema-Design fällt dir leicht, du kannst einen Query Plan lesen und weißt, wann das ORM dich anlügt. Geospatial-Erfahrung ist ein Bonus, keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du bist fließend in typisiertem Backend-TypeScript. Wir arbeiten täglich mit NestJS und GraphQL; wenn deine Erfahrung aus einem vergleichbaren Stack kommt, ist das völlig okay - du arbeitest dich ein.
  • Du hast echte Queue-basierte Verarbeitung gebaut. Nicht „ich habe mal einen Job in eine Queue gelegt", sondern Worker designt, Retries und Teilausfälle behandelt, mehrstufige Workflows orchestriert.
  • Du hast Authorization für ein Multi-Tenant-Produkt designt und weißt, wo es haarig wird.
  • Du hast lieber einen Integrationstest gegen eine echte Datenbank als zehn Unit-Tests, die alles mocken. Du schreibst den Test, der die kaputte Migration erwischt.
  • Du behandelst Production als debuggbares System. Du findest über Dashboards und Traces heraus, warum etwas langsam ist, und Infrastruktur ist für dich nicht das Problem von jemand anderem.
  • Du kommunizierst klar - mit Engineers, Product und bei Bedarf direkt mit Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser und fließend Englisch. Unsere Kunden sind deutsche Banken und Asset Manager, und du wirst mit ihnen sprechen.

Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) sowie Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • LLMs in Production, vor allem Dokumenten- oder Datenextraktion - und die Fähigkeit, sie zuverlässig statt nur beeindruckend zu machen.
  • Data-Pipeline-Erfahrung: stufenweise, reproduzierbare Verarbeitung, Dataset-Versionierung.
  • Mentoring oder Führung von Engineers - oder der Wunsch, da reinzuwachsen.
  • Debugging von Tooling- und Build-Problemen, nicht nur von Anwendungscode. Unsere Toolchain entwickelt sich schnell und ist gelegentlich nicht Standard.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier baust, ist das, worauf sich unsere Kunden jeden Tag verlassen. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 2,5 Tage/Woche.

descriptionHtml:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
  • Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
  • Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
  • Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
  • Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
  • Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences.
  • Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

title: Senior communicatieadviseur interne en corporate communicatie
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan de volgende fase van HeinenoordZicht Groep?

Na een zeer recente fusie van twee bedrijven hebben we onze krachten gebundeld in HeinenoordZicht Groep, een wervelende speler in de assurantiebranche. Eén met ambitie en potentie. Eén die bouwt aan een gezamenlijke cultuur en gedeeld verhaal. Aan een organisatie waar collega's elkaar weten te vinden, waar strategische keuzes helder worden vertaald naar de praktijk en waar communicatie een belangrijke rol speelt in verbinding, verandering en groei.


Hiervoor willen we ons team nu uitbreiden met een senior communicatieadviseur die moeiteloos schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Iemand die ons mede richting geeft, beweging creëert, mensen weet mee te nemen in verandering en de communicatiestrategie vertaalt naar een concrete communicatieaanpak. Iets voor jou?

De functie in het kort:

Enerzijds ligt de nadruk op interne communicatie en het versterken van onze positie als werkgever. Je helpt collega’s begrijpen waar we als organisatie staan, waar we naartoe gaan en wat dit betekent voor hun werk. Je versterkt onze gezamenlijke identiteit en zorgt voor communicatie die helder, relevant en herkenbaar is. Tegelijkertijd bouw je mee aan onze positie op de arbeidsmarkt en aan een sterke candidate en employee experience. Je onderhoudt contacten met interne stakeholders en externe partijen en geeft zo binnen jouw aandachtsgebied mede vorm aan de corporate en directiecommunicatie over onze organisatie, strategie en het werkgeversmerk. Je levert ook bijdragen aan perscommunicatie, woordvoering en events en signaleert reputatierisico’s.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een strateeg én een creatieve doener. Je krijgt energie van grote, soms complexe communicatietrajecten. Staat op als eigenaar van het totaal: van eerste goed doordachte idee tot uitvoering en zichtbaar resultaat. Het is daarbij je tweede natuur om niet meteen in middelen te duiken. Je verdiept je altijd eerst in ‘de bedoeling’. Wat willen we bij wie bereiken en wat is daarvoor nodig? Je adviseert over de communicatieaanpak bij projecten, veranderingen en andere organisatieontwikkelingen. De rol van strategisch gesprekspartner voor managers en directie is dan ook ‘100% comfort zone’.


En ook mooi: je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verdere vorm te geven aan je functie. Deze is namelijk nieuw en daarmee nog in beweging.

Waar kom je te werken?

Jouw werkplek vind je in ons splinternieuw en moderne hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, dicht bij het Provinciehuis. Maar thuiswerken is ook helemaal onderdeel van onze cultuur. Samen met een communicatieadviseur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de interne, corporate en arbeidsmarktcommunicatie van HeinenoordZicht Groep. Je rapporteert aan de directeur HR & Communicatie en werkt nauw samen met de collega’s van MarCom, die zich richten op klantcommunicatie.


De sfeer is informeel. Werken in jeans en op sneakers vinden we de normaalste zaak van de wereld. We geven je ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen vanuit je eigen expertise en werken vanuit vertrouwen en samenwerking. Zo maken we samen communicatie die helder, relevant en effectief is.

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

  • Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 5.000,- tot € 7.623,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring.

  • Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank.

  • Maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-.

  • 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG.

  • De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden.

  • De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken, waarbij ook gezorgd wordt voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek.

  • Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group.

  • Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid.

Wanneer pas je goed in ons team?

  • Als de liefde voor communicatie onderdeel is van je DNA: Je bent een energieke bruggenbouwer tussen vraag en antwoord, tussen vandaag en morgen. Je houdt van verandering en voortuitgang. Van dynamiek en groei.

  • Als je ‘aan’ gaat van stakeholdermanagement: Je weet precies hoe je hen moet betrekken bij jouw projecten en zorgt voor een soepele communicatie.

  • Als strategie en hands-on creatie twee delen van jouw geheel zijn: Innovatieve ideeën, creatieve concepten, aansprekende online en offline communicatiemiddelen, verbindende content: jij brengt het mee. Met een neusje voor visueel aantrekkelijke beelden en een hart voor het schrijven van heldere en doelgroepgerichte teksten. Als het maar inspireert en verbindt.

  • Als je je organisatietalent ook wilt inzetten: Je hebt geen moeite met het organiseren van evenementen. Van concept tot uitvoering: jij hebt alles onder controle.

  • Als op jouw kilometerteller behoorlijk wat interne communicatie staat: Jij bent de spil van onze interne communicatie. Door jouw inspanningen blijft iedereen binnen de HeinenoordZicht Groep goed geïnformeerd en betrokken. Je draagt zorg voor een levendig en informatief intranet, organiseert inspirerende interne bijeenkomsten en zorgt voor een consistente stroom van boeiende updates en nieuws.

  • Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is onderdeel van je rol. Heb je hier al ervaring mee? Mooi. Zo niet, dan verwachten we dat je je hierin verder ontwikkelt.

Wat willen we sowieso terugzien op je cv?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie.

  • Heb je ervaring met PR, arbeidsmarkt- en/of corporate communicatie? Plusje!

Wie zijn wij?

Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs, samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler.

En wat is ons DNA?

Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes, om slagvaardig te blijven bij financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, vanuit de wens om persoonlijk, als team én als organisatie te groeien, en vanuit de lokale verbinding. Dat is waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen én blijven. En wat ons verbindt. We werken er zo iedere dag samen aan, om van HeinenoordZicht Groep steeds verder te laten groeien als GAAF bedrijf: Goed geregeld, Aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, Aantrekkelijk voor klanten en Financieel gezond.

Solliciteren?

We sluiten deze vacature als we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy. We look forward to receiving your application!

If you have any questions, feel free to send us a message at -----

title: Senior Consultant - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 5-6 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Specialisation. You are a generalist with shallow expertise and a thin network → AI will eat your lunch. We bet on depth. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now. 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Own your deliverables, client relationships, and the quality of everyone working in it end-to-end. You are not support staff for the partnership — you aim to become the standard. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and project teams independently. Set the bar for junior consultants — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Drive business development that other strategic consultancies reserve for managers and partners. At ALAIKA, building the business is not a privilege reserved for managers and partners. It is an expectation. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track from day one. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. Take full ownership of work normally reserved for far more senior profiles. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. On average 4 years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, PE/VC-backed company, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience required. Financial services experience preferred. 
  • Leadership. You have led — a team, a club, a project, a cause. We hire people who make things happen. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Five years from senior to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space
