title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer.

Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS.

You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on.

You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on.

You will:

  • Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain.

  • Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog.

  • Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents.

  • Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

  • Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10.

Responsibilities

Data Ingestion

  • Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break.

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources.

  • Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data.

  • Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

Platform Maintenance

  • Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights.

  • Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage).

  • Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments.

  • Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow.

  • Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills.

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact.

  • Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to.

  • Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems.

Supporting Expansion

  • Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion.

  • Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone.

  • Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.

  • Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code.

  • AWS or GCP experience.

  • Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4.

  • Terraform experience.

Bonus points

  • Experience with time-series data at scale.

  • Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse).

  • Experience in energy or climate tech.

  • Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups.

  • Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering.

We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end.

Benefits & Perks

  • Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

Home working and wellbeing budgets:

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes.

  • Behavioural interview, 60 minutes.

  • Skills interview with cross-functional leaders, 60 to 90 minutes, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders, 45 minutes.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

title: (Senior) Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

(Senior) Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Consultant (m/w/d)

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Digitale Forensik: Du führst forensische Untersuchungen bei Cyberangriffen und IT-Sicherheitsvorfällen durch und analysierst betroffene Systeme und Umgebungen

  • Beweismittelsicherung: Du sicherst digitale Spuren auf Clients, Servern sowie in Netzwerk- und Cloud-Umgebungen strukturiert und nachvollziehbar

  • Angriffsrekonstruktion: Du identifizierst Angriffspfade, rekonstruierst den Ablauf von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bewertest deren Ursache und Ausmaß

  • Dokumentation: Du bereitest Deine Untersuchungsergebnisse in technischen Berichten und verständlichen Management-Zusammenfassungen adressatengerecht auf

  • Incident Response: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Bearbeitung von Sicherheitsvorfällen und begleitest insbesondere die Analyse, Eindämmung und Bereinigung betroffener Systeme

  • Prävention: Du führst Compromise Assessments, OSINT-Analysen und Threat-Hunting-Aktivitäten durch und unterstützt bei Threat Intelligence sowie Workshops für unsere Kunden

  • Weiterentwicklung: Du entwickelst unsere Methoden, Prozesse und Werkzeuge im Bereich Digital Forensics & Incident Response kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Digitalen Forensik und hast bereits reale Sicherheitsvorfälle untersucht. Idealerweise bringst Du zusätzlich Erfahrung in Incident Response oder OSINT-Analysen mit

  • Systemkenntnisse: Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der forensischen Analyse von Windows- und Linux-Systemen, EDR-Meldungen, Logdaten und Cloud-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in der macOS-, Mobilgeräte- oder Netzwerkforensik sind von Vorteil

  • Angriffsverständnis: Du kennst aktuelle Angriffstechniken, typische Vorgehensweisen von Angreifern und relevante Taktiken, Techniken und Prozeduren, beispielsweise nach MITRE ATT&CK

  • Toolkenntnisse: Du bist mit gängigen forensischen Werkzeugen vertraut und verfügst idealerweise über Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365, Azure oder AWS sowie IOC-Scannern wie THOR

  • Programmierung: Du verfügst idealerweise über Kenntnisse in Python oder PowerShell

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest analytisch, hypothesenbasiert und sorgfältig und behältst auch unter Zeitdruck den Überblick

  • Kommunikation: Du kannst komplexe technische Ergebnisse verständlich erklären und sicher gegenüber IT-Teams, Management und weiteren Stakeholdern vertreten

  • Kundenorientierung: Du trittst auch in kritischen Situationen professionell auf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden pragmatische und umsetzbare Lösungen

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Rufbereitschaft: Du bist bereit, im Wechsel mit Deinen Kollegen gesondert vergütete Rufbereitschaft für unseren 24/7 Incident Response Service zu übernehmen

Was erwartet Dich noch?

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. title: Senior Director of Product Management, Models and Data
descriptionHtml:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.

That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next.

Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in.

You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model.

If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required.

By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market.

  • Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training.

  • Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version.

  • Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform.

  • Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers.

  • Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready.

  • Direct work on training data, such as setting a data mix, running labeling or human-feedback programs, or negotiating data licenses.

  • Enough depth in how large models are trained, post-trained and evaluated that researchers bring you into their technical decisions. Many strong candidates for this role were ML engineers or researchers before they moved into product.

  • Experience setting direction for research and engineering teams that did not report to you.

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 3D computer vision, reconstruction, localization, mapping, geospatial data, robotics or autonomous systems.

  • An advanced degree in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or a related field.

  • Experience with Gaussian splatting, neural fields or visual positioning systems.

  • Experience with government or defense requirements for data provenance and security.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our embedded software team develops real-time safety-critical firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. We partner closely with hardware, systems, and controls engineers to take novel designs from concept to flight-ready software. You will join an agile cross-functional team focused on high-reliability execution in mission-critical environments.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will architect, implement, and validate firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. You will drive hardware-software integration and ensure system reliability and safety standards are met across multi-domain environments.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Architect and write high-performance C/C++ software and firmware for microcontroller and RTOS-based embedded systems.
  • Develop low-level device drivers, bus communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet), and hardware abstraction layers.
  • Lead hardware-software integration, system bring-up, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing in laboratory and field environments.
  • Optimize software for low latency, memory constraints, and deterministic execution on embedded microcontrollers.
  • Collaborate with hardware, systems, and QA teams to design robust fault-handling and safety-critical fail-safe mechanisms.

title: Senior Engineer I, Systems Engineering - Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Senior Engineer I - Controls Engineer

ASM | Simulation & Modeling Hub | Almere, Netherlands

Design, tune and validate control systems for ASM semiconductor process tools, with an emphasis on precision temperature control. Work with experienced controls engineers and equipment and process teams to translate process requirements into control strategies, then verify their performance on physical tools. The role combines dynamic modeling, controller development and hands-on testing, with opportunities to take ownership of control functions.

Responsibilities

  • Translate process and equipment needs into measurable control requirements for temperature accuracy, stability, uniformity, repeatability and response during recipe changes.
  • Design and tune feedback and feedforward control strategies for heating and cooling systems. Address interactions between zones and account for sensor and actuator limits.
  • Plan and run tests on laboratory and production-representative equipment. Analyze sensor and actuator data, use system identification to develop or calibrate dynamic models, and compare predictions with measured responses.
  • Work with software, equipment and process engineers to integrate control logic, troubleshoot performance on the tool, and support commissioning and validation.
  • Document control logic, test procedures, tuning parameters and validation results so other engineers can reproduce tests and maintain the controls.

Required qualifications

  • Degree in controls, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing, testing or tuning closed-loop controls on physical equipment. Relevant industry, laboratory or applied research projects are welcome.
  • Working proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink or an equivalent environment for dynamic modeling, data analysis and control design. Familiarity with system identification and instrumentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment methodically and communicate results to colleagues across engineering disciplines.

Preferred experience

  • Precision temperature control, heat transfer or thermal instrumentation in semiconductor equipment or other precision industrial systems.
  • Experience with multizone or cascade control, model-based control, sensor calibration or equipment commissioning.
  • Experience with Simcenter Amesim or other tools for modeling system dynamics and validating control strategies

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
  • Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
  • Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
  • You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Recruiter Screening Conversation 
  • Initial HM Interview 
  • Role Specific Interview 
  • Behavioural Interview 

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior) FP&A Manager based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced (Senior) FP&A Manager to act as a strategic finance business partner and drive financial performance across an international organization. In this role, you will lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning while transforming complex financial data into actionable business insights. You will work closely with senior leadership, commercial teams, operational stakeholders, and finance professionals to influence strategic decisions and improve business performance. Your expertise will help strengthen financial reporting, enhance planning processes, and ensure alignment between local and group-level objectives. This is an opportunity to take ownership of impactful financial initiatives in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment where analytical excellence and commercial thinking are highly valued.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business.

  • Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

  • Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases.

  • Ensure alignment between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment.

  • Drive continuous improvements across FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines.

  • Collaborate with external auditors, system implementation partners, and corporate reporting teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial processes.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders in an international business environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, preferably within an international or matrixed organization.

    • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management.

    • Good understanding of the relationships between the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow statement.

    • Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, financial planning, and reporting tools such as Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, or similar platforms.

    • Strong commercial mindset, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence strategic decisions.

    • Fluent English is required.

    • Experience preparing board materials, earnings support schedules, management review packs, or group reporting deliverables is a plus.

    • Exposure to finance transformation, planning system implementation, BI dashboards, or reporting automation projects is an advantage.

    • An MBA, CFA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification is considered a strong asset.

    • Previous experience in a high-growth, complex, multinational, or publicly listed company environment is beneficial.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary: Starting from €55,000 gross per year, depending on location, skills, and experience.

      • Remote-first flexibility: Fully remote position within a time zone of approximately ±2 hours of Central European Time.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for 

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React / Typescript / Java)
descriptionHtml:
We are a high-momentum Munich-based AI startup pairing rapid frontend prototyping and product design with deliberate architecture and AI-assisted execution. As a senior full-stack engineer, you'll prototype intuitive user experiences in Storybook before building out robust full-stack features alongside the CTO and experienced peers.

Why this role matters

We are scaling our engineering team past 6+ developers and need an experienced, versatile full-stack builder who excels at frontend craft and rapid design prototyping. We design and iterate directly in Storybook before building, ensuring exceptional user experience before locking in our robust Java/Spring backend architecture. Your contributions will directly accelerate our product velocity and lift our frontend and design standards across the board.

What you'll own

End-to-end feature delivery, rapid UI prototyping, and full-stack development across our core platform.

  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and refine UI designs in Storybook before building production code.

  • Design, build, and ship polished frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and modern design systems.

  • Build robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Collaborate closely with the CTO and senior developers on domain modeling (DDD/Arc42), testing (TDD/BDD), and heavy execution.

  • Leverage AI-agent pairing workflows and modern CI/CD automation on Azure and Kubernetes to maximize development velocity.

  • Coach and support junior engineers through active code reviews, pairing, and shared UI/craft standards.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Ramp up on our product domain, explore our Storybook setup, and deliver your first rapid UI prototypes and production-ready contributions.

  • Month 2-3: Ship end-to-end features with polished UI design, tackle complex full-stack tasks alongside the CTO and senior peers, and introduce constructive design system or tooling improvements.

  • By end of Q1: Operate as an autonomous senior contributor and trusted peer in the Munich office who collaborates closely with the team and shares new prototyping or frontend techniques.

Who you are

  • ~7+ years of software engineering experience delivering robust, production-grade applications.

  • Strong product and visual design sensibility with deep hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, and Storybook.

  • Solid backend proficiency building services with Java and Spring Boot.

  • Dedicated practitioner of clean code, automated testing (TDD/BDD), and rapid prototyping.

  • Comfortable collaborating closely as a peer and mentoring junior developers in a flat team.

  • Based in Munich (or relocating) for regular in-office collaboration.

What you'll get

  • High autonomy to shape product design, iterate rapidly in Storybook, and influence architecture.

  • Direct collaboration and high trust alongside the CTO and senior peers in a flat setup.

  • Modern AI-agent pairing workflows that supercharge individual delivery and eliminate busywork.

  • A culture that values thoughtful upfront prototyping, clean design, and deliberate engineering.

  • Energetic in-person team collaboration in the heart of Munich.

This probably isn't for you if...

  • You prefer pure backend work and dislike hands-on UI design, prototyping in Storybook, or frontend craft.

  • You are looking for a formal technical lead title or hierarchical management role rather than direct hands-on building.

  • You prefer purely remote work and do not want regular face-to-face collaboration in Munich.

Let's talk

If you are an experienced builder who thrives on fast-paced UI prototyping, modern frontend craft, and robust backend engineering in a flat team, let's talk. Apply with a link to your GitHub, Storybook, or design work to start the conversation.

descriptionHtml:

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung in Enterprise- und regulierten Umgebungen

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Erfahrung in einem dieser Umfelder ist ein starkes Plus – sag uns in den Fragen, wo du herkommst.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Backend-Kern (das erwarten wir):

  • Java (17+) und Spring Boot (Microservices, Domain Driven Design)
  • REST-Schnittstellen und relationale Datenbanken, vor allem PostgreSQL
  • Docker und Kubernetes
  • Testgetriebene Entwicklung (TDD) mit JUnit – Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit
  • Apache Kafka / asynchrone Kommunikation
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Git, agiles Arbeiten

Frontend (das erwarten wir):

  • Angular mit TypeScript

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • LLM-Integration in Fachanwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling/MCP, Agenten), gern mit einem Projektbeispiel
  • Kotlin, Camunda (BPMN-Prozessautomatisierung)
  • AWS oder Azure, JPA/Hibernate
  • Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Tests im Frontend (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)
  • Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design (öffentlicher Sektor)

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Senior G&E Executive
descriptionHtml:
SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE

Is organizing truly your passion, and do you know how to turn a client request into a successful and memorable event? We are looking for a Senior G&E Executive to strengthen our team at the Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon!

WHAT DOES YOUR DAY AS A SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE LOOK LIKE?

As a Senior G&E Executive, you are responsible for the organization and coordination of groups and events for Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon. From the first inquiry until the final evaluation, you make sure every detail is taken care of.

You manage a broad range of meetings, conferences, dinners, group bookings, and special events. With your experience and commercial mindset, you know how to translate clients' wishes into successful events while identifying opportunities to maximize revenue. You work closely with operational departments and are a trusted point of contact for both clients and colleagues.

As a senior member of the team, you take ownership of more complex requests and events, support your colleagues when needed, and contribute to continuously improving our commercial approach and way of working.

A FEW RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Managing groups, meetings, and events from the initial inquiry through to execution and follow-up.

  • Maximizing revenue and guest satisfaction by responding quickly to requests, converting inquiries into confirmed business, and identifying upselling opportunities.

  • Using your commercial insight to strategically manage pricing, availability, and event planning in line with the hotels' revenue objectives.

  • Taking ownership of larger and more complex groups and events and ensuring all agreements and details are communicated accurately.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event planners, and other business partners.

  • Ensuring contracts, deposits, cancellations, and invoicing are handled accurately and according to agreed procedures.

  • Coordinating menus, packages, room requirements, and additional services while balancing the client's wishes with the commercial opportunities for the hotels.

  • Working closely with operational departments to ensure a smooth handover and successful execution of each event.

  • Supporting and sharing knowledge with colleagues within the G&E team and contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and commercial performance.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade is located in the heart of international The Hague, right next to the green Van Stolkpark. The hotel lies between The Hague city center and Scheveningen beach. Guests can relax in our Promenade Healthclub & Spa or enjoy delicious international dishes at LEO’S International Flavors.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade has 178 rooms and features a classic yet modern design, reflected throughout the hotel’s atmosphere. The hotel also offers 10 meeting rooms, making it the perfect choice for both business and leisure guests.

Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon has been an icon at The Hague Central Station since 1978 and is part of Leonardo Hotels. Centrally located, with a fantastic view and all the famous attractions within easy reach, the hotel has 143 rooms and several special meeting rooms. On the first floor of the hotel you will find our bar and restaurant "The Livingroom", where we create a real feeling of home for our guests.

As Leonardo Hotels Benelux, we are part of the larger Leonardo Hotels Group and responsible for all activities for our 28 hotels in the Netherlands and Belgium. At Leonardo Hotels, we care deeply about personal growth, connection, and making an impact together. On average, our colleagues work with us for four years because we always look for good internal career opportunities, and we are quite proud of that!


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT ADDITION TO OUR TEAM

  • At least 2 to 3 years of relevant experience within Groups & Events, Meeting & Events, or a similar hospitality environment.

  • Bachelor-level working and thinking capability (HBO), preferably combined with a hospitality-related education such as Hotel Management or Facility Management.

  • Experience with both corporate and social events and confidence in managing larger or more complex bookings.

  • Experience with Opera Sales & Catering is strongly preferred.

  • Strong command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written.

  • A strong commercial mindset and the ability to recognize opportunities to increase conversion and revenue.

  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

  • Professional, service-oriented, and a true team player who enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to connect easily with clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong numerical insight and the ability to think strategically while keeping an eye on the details.

  • You remain calm and solution-oriented when plans change, because in events, they sometimes do!

To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE FROM US

• Travel allowance from 10 kilometers.

• Overtime can be paid out or saved as extra time off.

• Training and development opportunities.

• Clear internal growth opportunities.

• Access to a mental well-being support platform.

• Tax-friendly purchase options through a benefit program.

• Worldwide employee discount programs.

• An introduction experience including an overnight stay, dinner and breakfast.

title: Senior German Tax Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

  • 1. Investment Tax Mechanics & Fund Processing

    • Daily KEST: Own the daily KEST activities, run controls, solve incidents and support the Product team.

    • Vorabpauschale (Advance Lump-Sum Tax): Support Product in the complete execution lifecycle of the annual Vorabpauschale calculation under the German Investment Tax Act (InvStG).

    2. Digital Dividend & Regulatory Reporting Transformation

    • MiKaDiv Execution: Support Product in the technical implementation and operational governance of MiKaDiv (Mitteilungsverfahren Kapitalertragsteuer auf Dividenden). Lead continuous data gathering throughout the custody chain, validate beneficial ownership timelines, and secure the electronic transmission paths required to fetch the mandatory unique tax reference numbers (UUIDs) from the BZSt.

    • NEK (Nichtentrichtete Kapitalertragsteuer): Manage reporting and exception workflows surrounding non-withheld or uncollectible capital gains tax (e.g., when an account lacks sufficient cash liquidity during a tax event like the Vorabpauschale), ensuring seamless reporting logs to the local tax offices via CPB.

    3. Customer Tax Exemptions & Account Adjustments

    • FSAk (Freistellungsauftrag / Kontrollverfahren): Support CPB with the submission and by running controls.

    • NV-Bescheinigungen: Validate, track, and audit Non-Assessment Certificates (Nichtveranlagungs-Bescheinigungen), ensuring proper single vs. joint application rules.

    • Loss Pot Management (Verlusttöpfe): Oversee the automated real-time logic of the Share Loss Pot (Aktienverlusttopf) and General Loss Pot (Allgemeiner Verlusttopf), cross-pot optimization offsets, and cross-border or marital Verlusttopf-Überträge (loss pot transfers) during account migrations or closures.

    • Deceased Account Backward Correction (Erbfall): Blueprint and implement the technical logic for backward tax corrections (rückwirkende Korrektur) in the event of an end-user's death, ensuring the immediate freeze and retro-active dissolution of exemption orders (FSA) and the automated cross-year recalculation/neutralization of loss pots (Verlusttöpfe) up to the exact date of death.

    • Church Tax Automation: Control the query process (KiStAM) to the BZSt, including ensuring the application of the correct split-tax formulas (Halbteilungsgrundsatz) to joint accounts with mixed religious denominations.

    4. Tax Documentation & Core IT Collaboration

    • Jahressteuerbescheinigung: Support CPB and Product in the flawless generation of the annual German tax certificate (Jahressteuerbescheinigung e.g., Erträgnisaufstellung), including complex edge cases for joint account primary address routing.

    • Product Tax Engine Architecture: Act as the primary business analyst for Product and Tech Engineering teams, writing technical tax specifications to translate German tax updates into automated core banking system logic.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior HPC Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
