title: Senior HR Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we’re passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We’re looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You’ll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.
  • Use employee feedback, case themes and engagement insights to identify emerging concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • Coach and upskill managers through sensitive people matters, helping them build the confidence and judgement to handle issues effectively.
  • Deliver practical sessions on employee relations policies, UK employment legislation and effective people management.
  • Guide managers towards the right People tools and resources, encouraging greater self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex or higher-risk situations.
  • Communicate complex processes and decisions clearly to a range of audiences, adapting your approach to the situation and the people involved.

People Partnering and Strategic Support

  • Partner with leaders across our Merchant organisation, building a strong understanding of their teams, priorities and people challenges.
  • Support core People processes, including performance calibrations, engagement activity and organisational change.
  • Use data and people insights to support leadership discussions and inform practical, evidence-based decisions.
  • Contribute to targeted UKI People projects and work collaboratively across the wider People team to deliver meaningful improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing complex end-to-end employee relations cases within a fast-paced environment, backed by up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Strong advisory and coaching capability, with a proven ability to constructively challenge managers and balance commercial risk with employee experience.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations with limited direction.
  • An analytical mindset, with experience using case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify root causes and deliver proactive HR solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines and deliver consistently across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or sensitive information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.
  • Confidence using HR systems and digital tools to manage work, identify insights and improve the employee and manager experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial, operational or technology-led business units.
  • Broader exposure to, or an interest in, HR Business Partnering and organisational design.
  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.
  • Experience improving HR guidance, self-service tools or digital processes to increase adoption and make support easier to access.
  • Familiarity with people analytics or AI-enabled tools and an interest in how emerging technology can improve HR decision-making and operational efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day
    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role
    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
    Join collaborative, values-driven teams that support you to do your best work.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes three to four stages. You can find out more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Senior Key Accounts Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact between their executives and many Airbnb teams including Connectivity, Product, Legal and Market Management teams.

A Typical Day: 

  • Be accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle from prospecting, to acquisition, contracting, rollout and performance management  of Key Account partnerships
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and position Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels.
  • Through the creation of mutual account plans with your partners you will design clear actions which deliver on the Objectives and KPIs of Airbnb and our Key Account Partners
  • Negotiate agreements with partners to unlock new opportunities for both parties & promote long term mutual success
  • Leverage data to make decisions and design projects to best expand and enhance availability and revenue through existing partnerships.
  • Monitor & analyze over/underperformance, market trends, growth opportunities or anomalies and regularly communicate performance to Executives leveraging available production data and global market insight.
  • Work with partners to ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as operational SLAs are met.
  • Develop close working relationships with key internal teams and individuals to ensure that they  provide appropriate levels of support to these key partnerships and key enhancements are made to unlock revenue for the business.
  • Conduct regular business reviews, formal presentations for internal and external purposes.
  • Work cross-functionally to execute changes at scale while collaborating with Market Management as a subject matter expert in Key Accounts accounts to drive local property performance. 
  • Proactively contribute to the development and standardization of Enterprise team processes, playbooks, and best practices across the global function

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of Travel IndustryAccount Management experience; including 5 years in a Key Account Manager role with at least 2 years  being responsible for a global partner base. 
  • Proven track record of executing on strategic priorities
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to structure and close high-value, complex deals that establish long-term, strategic partnerships.
  • Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results
  • Ability to balance time spent between strategic initiatives and operations while diving into the details when necessary.
  • Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C-Suite level
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry
  • Have a passion for redefining travel, Airbnb, and being the best!
  • Proactive self-starter able to prioritize and manage work autonomously
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range€74.000—€92.000 EUR

title: Senior Lead, Trade Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Role Purpose 

The Senior Manager, Global Compliance Risk Assessment designs and runs ASM's global compliance risk assessment program. The main focus is export control, with wider coverage of general compliance risks. The role gives leadership a clear, data-driven view of compliance exposure and makes sure risks are identified, prioritized and mitigated before they affect the business. In doing so, it protects market access, revenue and reputation. 

Key Responsibilities 

  1. Global Risk Assessment Framework
  • Design, implement and maintain a risk-based framework for export control and general compliance across all regions and business units. 
  • Define the risk methodology, including scoring, likelihood and impact criteria, risk appetite and escalation thresholds. 
  • Run the annual global compliance risk assessment and targeted assessments when the business or regulations change. Examples include new markets, products, customers and export control developments. 
  1. Export Control Risk (Primary Focus)
  • Assess risks under U.S. (EAR), EU (Regulation 2021/821), Japanese, Singapore, Korean and Chinese export control regimes. 
  • Evaluate exposure in high-risk areas, such as:  
  • Classification 
  • Licensing 
  • End-use and end-user due diligence screening 
  • Technology transfer and deemed exports 
  • Spare parts and service 
  • U.S. Persons Rules 
  • Assess the business impact of new regulations, such as BIS rules, entity list expansions and China countermeasures, and translate it into concrete mitigation actions. 
  • Test the effectiveness of the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) and of system controls, for example in ERP and Teamcenter. 
  1. General Compliance Risk
  • Extend risk assessment to general compliance related risks. 
  • Work with Internal Audit so there is one consistent view of risk and no duplication. 
  1. Monitoring, Testing and Assurance
  • Develop and carry out a risk-based compliance monitoring and testing plan, including site and process reviews in Europe, the U.S. and Asia. 
  • Identify control gaps and root causes, agree corrective actions with the business, and track them to closure. 
  • Prepare the organization for regulator inquiries, government audits and external reviews. 
  1. Reporting and Governance
  • Produce clear, executive-level risk reporting for the Corporate Director, the Management Board, the Audit Committee and the Supervisory Board. 
  • Maintain the compliance risk register and key risk indicators (KRIs). 
  • Turn complex regulatory risk into business terms such as revenue at risk, operational disruption and reputational impact. 

Qualifications and Experience 

Required 

  • Master's degree in Law, Business, Economics, International Trade, Finance or a related field. 
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in internal audit, compliance risk assessment or risk management. 
  • Proven track record of designing or running risk assessment or audit programs in a multinational environment. 

Competencies 

  • Analytical and risk-based thinking, with the ability to set priorities 
  • Business acumen: positions compliance as a business enabler, not a barrier 
  • Clear, concise communication at executive and Board level 
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgment 

Travel 

International travel of about 20–30%, mainly to the U.S. and Asia.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
descriptionHtml:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Job Description

🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel.

What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation.

Responsibilities:

Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role)

  • Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps.

  • Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against.

  • Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design.

  • Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements.

Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role)

  • Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts.

  • Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements.

  • Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions.

Scale legal as a business enabler

  • Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset.

  • Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation.

  • Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company.

  • 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders.

  • 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly.

  • 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products.

  • 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works.

  • 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate.

  • 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems.

  • 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a shared drive. It will shape how a category-defining company builds products and does deals. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

title: Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production.

  • Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners.

  • Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance.

  • Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements.

  • Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model.

  • Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes.

  • Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered.

  • Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline.

  • Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation.

  • Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels.

  • Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability.

  • Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

     

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

descriptionHtml:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Requirements

  • Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Statista's core platform capabilities, aligning technical investments with company-wide product and business goals

  • Translate complex platform challenges into clear, prioritized requirements and work closely with engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions across areas such as data infrastructure, APIs, and internal tooling

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to accelerate platform development, improve developer experience, and unlock new capabilities for product teams

  • Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on platform priorities, trade-offs, and delivery timelines

  • Evaluate and shape integration strategies for emerging technologies, including AI/ML services, MCP protocols, and data pipeline architectures

  • Continuously assess platform performance, scalability, and reliability, driving improvements through data-informed decision-making and close collaboration with engineering leadership

Responsabilities

  • 7+ years of experience in the tech industry with a strong understanding of product and engineering workflows, team dynamics, and modern software development practices

  • At least 2 years of recent, hands-on experience in a heavily technical product domain such as platform engineering, data infrastructure, AI/ML, or API development

  • Proven background in platform or technical product management; experience in data platforms or data engineering is a strong plus

  • You actively integrate AI into your daily workflows and are continuously refining and expanding how you use AI-powered tools to increase your effectiveness

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between deeply technical concepts and strategic business language

  • Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder alignment

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, legacy systems, and evolving technical landscapes

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help expand the breadth and depth of the 9fin platform.

You’ll join a cross-functional product and engineering team solving complex, high-value problems for professionals across global debt markets, spanning AI-powered workflows, financial data and analysis, transaction intelligence, document management, and other emerging product areas.

You’ll help shape products used by teams at leading investment banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisory businesses - sophisticated users working with large volumes of complex information, where speed, accuracy, and trust are critical.

It’s a chance to shape frontier AI-native products inside a company using technology to transform one of the world’s largest financial markets.

What you'll work on


Product & Design Strategy

  • Partner with customers, Product Managers, engineers, and subject matter experts to shape product vision and design strategy — not just how it looks, but how it works and why it matters.

  • Synthesise research, feedback, domain expertise, and data to frame clear problems, and translate complex financial workflows into intuitive product experiences.

  • Run discovery to understand what users need, how they work, and where technology can create real value.

  • Align your work to clear outcomes, manage competing priorities, and focus your effort where it has the most impact in high-precision environments.

Designing AI-Native Workflows

  • Design interfaces that help users explore, understand, and act on AI-generated insights and complex datasets.

  • Translate model outputs into clear, trustworthy interfaces — with source attribution, confidence, transparency, and appropriate user control.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on feedback loops and evaluation workflows to improve AI-powered experiences in production.

  • Spot opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to real customer problems, prototyping new patterns where no playbook exists yet.

Craft & Collaboration

  • Own design end-to-end — flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI that hold up across edge cases and complex data conditions.

  • Work as an embedded partner to Product, Engineering, Data, and subject matter experts.

  • Communicate design rationale clearly and bring stakeholders along, especially in new or ambiguous territory.

  • Contribute to and evolve the design system to support increasingly sophisticated, data-heavy, AI-driven workflows.

About you

This role will be a great fit if you are:

  • Comfortable with complexity: you’ve designed for sophisticated users or high-stakes domains (fintech, enterprise SaaS, data platforms, professional tools). Financial markets experience is useful but not required — curiosity matters more.

  • A systems thinker: you shape workflows, behaviours, and trust, not just screens, zooming from the big picture to the finest interaction detail.

  • Focused on trust and precision: you think in edge cases, error states, and ambiguity, especially where AI is involved.

  • AI-native in how you work: generative AI is a natural part of your process, from research to prototyping to stress-testing ideas.

  • A natural prototyper: you find the fastest way to make an idea tangible, whether that’s AI tools, Figma, code, or a pencil sketch.

  • Energised by a blank page: you thrive defining something new and iterating quickly through ambiguity.

  • A strong communicator: you run discovery interviews, facilitate workshops, and know when to challenge, align, or move a team forward.

  • Skilled in your craft: fluent in Figma, comfortable choosing the right fidelity, and experienced contributing to a design system.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.

Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities.

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.

We offer

  • A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.


Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

  • You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you.

  • You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.

  • You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.

  • You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.

  • You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.

  • You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.

  • You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

About the role

Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up.

You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them.

You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production.

  • Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it.

  • Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight.

  • Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.

  • Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control.

  • Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship.

  • Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it.

  • Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.

 

What you’ll need to have done

  • Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language.

  • Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years.

  • Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end.

  • A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket.

  • Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each.

  • Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy.

  • Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

  • Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back.

 

Helpful, not required

  • Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it.

  • Experience across both backend and frontend.

  • Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Manager Interview

  3. Technical Assessment (e.g., code review, system design)

  4. Values Interview

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.
