For over 10 years, Andela has connected customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries, the majority residing in emerging markets across Africa and Latin America. As one of the world's largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies the flexibility to deploy qualified technologists fast — across Application Development, AI, Cloud & DevOps, and Data Engineering. Andela Talent Cloud (ATC) is our platform for managing the complete global talent lifecycle.

We're at the intersection of two industry transformations — one in staffing and hiring, one in software development — both accelerated by AI. We're looking for a builder who wants to own the platform at the center of it.

About the Role

Andela is building a modern Sales Engineering function that helps customers solve complex technology and organizational challenges across our three primary offerings:

  • Talent Solutions - specialized technical expertise that works as part of the customer’s team.

  • AI Solutions - managed delivery and repeatable solutions where Andela owns defined outcomes.

  • Learning & Assessment Solutions - assessing, training, and upskilling customer teams.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a technical partner to customers, Sales, and Delivery. You'll lead discovery, translate ambiguous business needs into technical and delivery requirements, shape solutions across Andela's portfolio, and help ensure that what we sell can be successfully delivered.

Sales Engineering also helps improve how Andela sells. The team is developing new approaches to technical qualification, AI-assisted assessment, solution design, demonstrations, and sales tooling. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to those systems and practices while working directly on some of Andela's most complex customer opportunities.

This reflects the department's broader mandate to support opportunities across Talent Solutions, AI Solutions, and Learning & Assessment Solutions rather than operating within a single offering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery and qualification with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer objectives, environments, constraints, capabilities, and desired outcomes.

  • Shape customer solutions by developing initial recommendations around architecture, scope, delivery model, team structure, technical requirements, timelines, risks, and dependencies.

  • Work across Andela's full portfolio, identifying when customer needs are best addressed through Talent Solutions, AI Solutions, Learning & Assessment Solutions, or a combination.

  • Bring technical depth to the sales process, including architecture discussions, technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, proposals, and RFPs.

  • Partner closely with Delivery and specialist teams to validate proposed approaches and ensure opportunities are well-defined before commitments are made.

  • Contribute to Sales Engineering technology and methodology, including technical assessments, AI-assisted qualification, discovery frameworks, demonstrations, internal tooling, and automation.

  • Improve how Andela sells by turning field experience into reusable playbooks, technical content, solution patterns, and better sales-to-delivery processes.

  • Bring the voice of the customer back into Andela, identifying patterns and opportunities that can improve our offerings, technology, and go-to-market approach.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, professional services, engineering leadership, or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong technical fluency across modern software development, cloud architecture, data platforms, APIs, and AI-enabled systems.

  • Experience with managed services, technical assessments, training/enablement, application modernization, data engineering, or enterprise technology solutions is a plus.

title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
locations: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Compliance & Recording
descriptionHtml:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.

Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own how recorded communications are captured, delivered and analysed. This is an API-first, backend role: there is little UI at its core, because for our customers the integration is the product.

About the Role

You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it.

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance & Recording, covering customer-managed (on-site) recording, Cloud Compliance and the integrations that connect them to customer systems.
  • Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
  • Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
  • Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 6+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of API-first, backend or platform products where there is little or no UI.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers.
  • Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control.
  • A track record of leading large, cross-functional projects for enterprise customers with demanding technical, security and reliability requirements.
  • Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork.
  • A genuine interest in compliance products and enterprise integrations. You want to understand how regulated firms capture, retain and supervise communications, and why every record matters.
  • Confident communication with engineers, customer technical teams, compliance officers and executives, in fluent written and spoken English.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example mobile voice and SMS, MVNO platforms, SIP, call recording or CDRs.
  • Compliance or regtech experience, such as communications recording, archiving or surveillance.
  • Experience shipping AI features in production, such as speech-to-text, LLM evaluation or human-in-the-loop review.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do

The Field Engineering organization at CoreWeave supports the customers running some of the largest AI workloads in the world. Technical Solutions Management owns the technical relationship with our strategic customers: we're the people their engineering leaders call first, and the people who get CoreWeave's delivery, operations, support and engineering teams moving for them.

About the Role

As a Technical Solutions Manager, you'll own the technical relationship with a small number of strategic customers who are defining how AI gets built. Their deployments run to thousands of GPUs, often on hardware that is new to the whole industry. You'll be the customer's technical advocate inside CoreWeave from contract through delivery, onboarding and day-to-day operations, and you'll drive the programs that get their capacity into production.

We're hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Staff TSMs take our largest, multi-site accounts and lead programs across the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical relationship with your customers' engineering and executive leaders, and be the person they trust to tell them what's really happening.
  • Run delivery and onboarding programs end to end, from contract and site readiness to the day the customer runs production work on new capacity.
  • Read each account's health every week, catch problems early, and drive cross-team issues to an owner and a resolution.
  • Coordinate Fleet Operations, Capacity, data center, support and engineering teams on your customers' behalf, leading through influence.
  • Carry customer needs into Product and Engineering and follow them through to a decision, then close the loop with the customer.
  • Partner with account executives on one customer message, and with Specialist Field Engineers on technical depth.
  • Help the team scale: improve our playbooks and tooling, interview, and mentor newer TSMs.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in technical program management, technical account management, solutions architecture, customer success engineering or professional services delivery with cloud infrastructure customers. For Staff, 8+ years and ownership of large, complex accounts.
  • Experience owning the technical relationship with large customers, including their engineering and executive leaders.
  • A track record of driving long-running, multi-team programs to a date and an outcome, with senior visibility.
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure: compute, networking, storage and Kubernetes.
  • Strong written communication, both long form (plans, status reports, incident reviews) and short form (chat and email).
  • Raises risk early, escalates with judgment, and stays calm under customer pressure.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with GPU clusters, HPC, or AI training and inference platforms.
  • Familiarity with Slurm, InfiniBand or high-performance storage.
  • Experience at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or AI hardware or systems vendor.
  • Experience bringing up new data center capacity or new hardware generations for customers.

Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams, even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You'd rather own the outcome than track the tasks.
  • You can explain a hard technical trade-off to an engineer and to an executive in the same afternoon.
  • You give customers bad news early and honestly, with a plan.
  • You like building the process while you're running it.

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications

Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA

and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. Under the GDPR and the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.
The Senior Technical Support Engineer provides advanced technical assistance to customers utilizing a suite of property management solutions. This role involves troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex software-related issues while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer service. The Senior Technical Support Engineer applies substantial knowledge and expertise to handle a wide range of tasks, contributes to process improvements, and mentors junior team members.
Responsibilities:
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting via telephone, ticketing systems, and chat, handling more complex and escalated issues.
  • Develop deep subject matter expertise in core technologies and multiple specialized technology areas.
  • Maintain ownership of assigned incidents from initial report through resolution, ensuring thorough communication and timely updates.
  • Educate customers on software functionalities, best practices, and product updates, while offering proactive solutions.
  • Identify, document, and report software issues, design concerns, and reliability challenges to appropriate internal teams.
  • Act as a resource for junior support engineers, providing guidance and mentorship.
  • Participate in team meetings, contribute to knowledge base documentation, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist with special projects and other duties as assigned.

    • Essential Functions:
  • Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues related to software functionality and system performance.
  • Communicate effectively with customers and internal teams, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolution paths.
  • Adhere to established support protocols, while identifying opportunities for process improvements.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.
  • Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment

    • Minimum Qualifications/Skills:
  • Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a high-pressure, multi-platform environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document and articulate issues effectively.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and customer needs while demonstrating initiative.
  • Proven ability to mentor and assist junior support engineers
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to providing an exceptional customer experience.

    • Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Relevant vocational/higher education
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in a technical support role, preferably supporting B2B enterprise-level customers.
  • Experience with property management software or related industry experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with knowledge base systems and documentation best practices is preferred.

    • AI & Operational Fluency:
  • AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables.
  • Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.
  • Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.
  • Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

title: Senior Technische*r Objektleiter*in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine technisch hoch anspruchsvolle Position, in der du das Zusammenspiel von Gebäude und modernster Robotik perfektionierst?

Als Senior Technische*r Objektleiter*in (m/w/d) bist du das technische Mastermind hinter unserem hochkomplexen, vollautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Oberhausen. Du agierst auf einem makrotechnischen Level und sorgst mit deinem tiefen technischen Know-how dafür, dass Gebäudeinfrastruktur und fortschrittliche Automatisierungstechnik wie ein einziger, fehlerfreier Organismus zusammenarbeiten. Während ein separates Automation Team das reine Material Handling Equipment (MHE) betreut, steuerst du das große Ganze: Du managest hohe Budgets, komplexe Dienstleistungsverträge und stellst die technische Betriebsbereitschaft in einem absoluten High Stakes Umfeld sicher.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Verantwortung: Du trägst die alleinige Verantwortung für den technischen Zustand und die Betriebssicherheit des automatisierten FCs. Du überbrückst die Lücke zwischen TGA und Logistikprozessen.
  • Stakeholdermanagement: Du bist die primäre strategische Ansprechperson für die Standortleitung und agierst auf Augenhöhe mit dem Automation & Engineering Leadership.
  • Krisenmanagement: Bei kritischen Systemausfällen behältst du den Überblick, koordinierst hochspezialisierte Dienstleistende unter massivem Zeitdruck und erstellst messerscharfe Root Cause Analysen.
  • Budgetpflege: Du leitest hochkomplexe, großvolumige technische Projekte (CAPEX/OPEX) und steuerst spezialisierte Verträge (z.B. für hochentwickelte Kühl- und IoT-Systeme).
  • Innovation: Du nutzt fortschrittliche Datenmodelle sowie IoT-Infrastrukturtools, um systemische Probleme proaktiv zu lösen und netzwerkweite Innovationen voranzutreiben.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Facility Management, Gebäudetechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich.
  • 5–7 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im technischen Facility Management, idealerweise in der Betreuung von hochautomatisierten Logistikzentren (z. B. mit TGW-, Dematic- oder Vanderlande-Systemen).
  • Fließende Deutsch-, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und ein Führerschein der Klasse B.
  • Konzeptionelles, abstraktes Denkvermögen auf Makroebene gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Anforderungen in klare operative Schritte zu übersetzen.
  • Eine starke Act-like-an-Owner-Mentalität. Du setzt außergewöhnlich hohe technische Standards und verteidigst FM-Anforderungen auch unter operativem Druck.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Treibe Projekte eigenständig voran, teste neue Ideen und profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unseren Standorten, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unsere Standorte sind auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

title: Senior Transformation Consultant - FSI
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

(Internal Job Title: Senior Value Engineer)

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the FSI sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English and French communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and FSI trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Senior UI/UX Engineer- Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the end-to-end experience of working with our quantum computers, from the customer-facing web platform for submitting quantum programs and exploring results to the internal interfaces used to run, monitor, and calibrate our machines in the lab. You set the design direction for both, and you build the component library that both are made of.

This is a design-led role for someone who is not satisfied handing over a Figma file and hoping for the best.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the design direction for our customer-facing cloud platform and our internal operator interface, and keep them coherent as one product family

  • Run the research: interview operators and physicists, observe real calibration workflows in the lab, and turn what you learn into design decisions

  • Produce wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for both surfaces

  • Build and own our design system as production-ready, tested components in code — the shared foundation that our engineers assemble applications from

  • Make dense telemetry and calibration data legible: define the visualisation patterns that let operators see what matters at a glance

  • Validate what ships: run usability tests on implemented interfaces and hold the quality bar between design intent and delivered product

  • Shape APIs together with backend and platform engineers, advocating for the user's perspective early in the process

  • Set the standard for accessibility, usability, and visual consistency, and raise the design literacy of the wider engineering team


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product or interaction design, with a portfolio of shipped digital products

  • Ability to build your own designs as reusable components in production code: confident with TypeScript and React, including component testing and documentation (e.g. Storybook)

  • Mastery of the full design toolkit — research, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, visual design — with Figma as your daily driver

  • Demonstrated experience designing for complex, data-heavy, or expert-user products rather than consumer apps

  • Track record of building or substantially owning a design system

  • Experience planning and running usability testing, and acting on what it tells you

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with domain experts, and to turn ambiguous problems into clear designs

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Real-time data in the browser (WebSockets, streaming telemetry)

  • Experience with scientific, industrial, or laboratory control software

  • Accessibility standards (WCAG) applied in practice

  • Experience mentoring designers or leading design in a cross-functional team

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains.


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen.

Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform.

Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren.

Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung?

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann.

Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt. Über das konkrete Arbeitsmodell sprechen wir gerne individuell.

Aufgaben

  • Interaction & Workflow Design: Du entwickelst intuitive Interaktionskonzepte für komplexe industrielle Softwareanwendungen und optimierst die Abläufe zwischen Informationen, Entscheidungen und Aktionen.

  • User Journey & Task Flow Design: Du analysierst, wie unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen ihre täglichen Aufgaben erledigen, und entwickelst daraus effiziente, verständliche und möglichst reibungslose Bedienabläufe.

  • Information Architecture & Navigation: Du konzipierst die Informationsstruktur und Navigation unserer Anwendungen. Nutzer sollen relevante Informationen und Funktionen schnell, intuitiv und ohne unnötige Schritte erreichen.

  • User Research & Prozessanalyse: Du verstehst die Arbeitsrealität von Maschinenbedienern, Schichtleitern, Instandhaltern und Produktionsmanagern und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete UX Konzepte.

  • Komplexität reduzieren: Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows, identifizierst unnötige Interaktionen und entwickelst Lösungen, die auch unter Zeitdruck und in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen funktionieren.

  • Produktübergreifende UX: Du entwickelst konsistente Navigations- und Interaktionsmuster für unsere wachsende Softwareplattform und sorgst für ein einheitliches Nutzererlebnis über verschiedene Anwendungen hinweg.

  • Konzeption & Validierung: Du visualisierst Konzepte durch User Flows, einfache Wireframes oder interaktive Prototypen und validierst sie gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und tatsächlichen Anwendern.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem erfahrenen Entwicklerteam zusammen, diskutierst technische Möglichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Nutzerfreundlichkeit von Anfang an in die Produktentwicklung einfließt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich User Experience, Interaction Design, UX Architecture oder Product Design, idealerweise mindestens fünf Jahre.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption komplexer B2B Software, Enterprise Applications oder datenintensiver Anwendungen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kompetenz in Information Architecture, Navigation Design, User Journeys, Task Flows und Workflow Optimierung.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe fachliche Prozesse zu analysieren, zu strukturieren und in einfache, intuitive Interaktionskonzepte zu übersetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit nutzerzentrierten Methoden wie User Research, Usability Testing, Journey Mapping und Prototyping.

  • Verständnis für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen, ihre Aufgaben, Entscheidungsprozesse und Arbeitsumgebungen.

  • Fähigkeit, UX Entscheidungen fundiert zu begründen und eigenständig mit Produktverantwortlichen und Softwareentwicklern zu diskutieren.

  • Pragmatische, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf funktionierende Lösungen statt aufwendiger Designprozesse.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Erfahrung mit industrieller Software, MES, ERP oder vergleichbaren komplexen Fachanwendungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wichtig: Wir suchen keinen klassischen UI Designer, dessen Schwerpunkt auf visueller Gestaltung, Branding oder der Erstellung schöner Screens liegt. Entscheidend ist deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Software durch bessere Interaktionen, Navigation und Workflows einfacher nutzbar zu machen.

Benefits

  • Direkter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Du definierst, wie Nutzer mit unserer Software arbeiten, und prägst grundlegende Interaktions- und Navigationskonzepte.

  • Erfahrenes Engineering Team: Du konzentrierst dich auf UX Konzeption und Nutzerführung, während unser Entwicklerteam die technische Umsetzung übernimmt.

  • Schnelle Umsetzung: Deine Konzepte können mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen und KI Unterstützung schnell prototypisiert, getestet und produktiv umgesetzt werden.

  • Direkter Zugang zu Anwendern: Du erhältst Einblicke in reale Produktionsumgebungen und kannst deine Ideen mit den Menschen validieren, die unsere Software täglich nutzen.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du entwickelst eigenständig Konzepte und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam zusammen.

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung und der Möglichkeit zu hybridem Arbeiten.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Du gestaltest die User Experience einer wachsenden industriellen Softwareplattform mit.
