title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.



What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

title: Technical Account Executive UK
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The role

Retailers and brands use EDITED's market data to make pricing, assortment and trading decisions. More of them now want that data inside their own systems, through our API and our MCP server, which lets their AI tools query EDITED directly. So the person evaluating us is often a Head of Data, an Engineering lead or an Ecommerce tech lead, as well as the commercial buyer.

We're hiring a Technical Account Executive to win those accounts. You'll report to our CRO and join a small new logo team.

This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role. You find the opportunities, run them and close them. It isn't pre-sales or Sales Engineering. What makes it different is that you can hold your own with a technical buyer on the first call and still take a commercial deal all the way to signature.

You don't need to know retail yet. We'll teach you. You do need to know how to sell B2B SaaS and close.

What you'll do

  • Build and run outbound into target accounts, including technical people who ignore a standard commercial pitch

  • Run discovery with commercial and technical stakeholders to understand the problem they're solving and how our data would fit into their stack

  • Walk a prospect's Data or Engineering lead through how our API and MCP server work, and know when to bring in product for deeper questions

  • Write and present proposals that make the commercial case and the technical case in the same deal

  • Negotiate and close, working with legal, finance and P&E on contracts

  • Forecast your pipeline accurately and keep the CRM up to date

  • Build relationships with senior and technical decision-makers in each account

What you'll need

  • 4 + years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales role, winning new logos yourself. Pre-sales, Sales Engineering or solutions consulting experience on its own isn't enough for this role.

  • A track record against quota you can talk through in numbers: targets, attainment, deal sizes and sales cycles

  • Experience closing deals of $200,000 + ACV with mid-market and enterprise organisations, with several stakeholders and a procurement process

  • Experience selling technical products, such as APIs, data platforms, analytics or BI tools, developer tools or AI/ML products

  • Confidence in technical conversations about integrations, APIs, data pipelines or agentic AI tooling. You don't need to write code. You do need to understand how the pieces connect and keep control of the conversation when the questions get specific.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You qualify hard, you know where a deal really stands, and you can explain why in a forecast call.

  • Clear writing and presenting for commercial and technical audiences

  • Willingness to travel

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to retailers, brands or ecommerce teams

  • Experience where Data, Engineering or Product teams were your main buyer

What We Offer You As A Technical Sales Executive

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

  • At EDITED we are set up to work remotely and can also offer hybrid working via our London and Sofia offices

  • Enhanced parental leave policy

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

  • Healthcare via SimplyHealth Cash Plan

  • You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Employee Referral Programme

  • Gifts for work anniversaries and big life events

  • Find out more here: https://edited.com/careers/

Apply now and don't miss the opportunity to join our journey to revolutionise the retail industry!

They act as a consultant and technical expert during the customer onboarding and implementation phase, ensuring that Kaluza’s SaaS platform is configured and deployed successfully to meet the client's specific energy-related challenges.

This role requires a unique combination of technical expertise, data analysis, problem solving skills, and a solid understanding of the energy industry.

As a Technical Analyst, you are the critical link between our clients' ambitions and Kaluza's cutting-edge SaaS platform. This is a hands-on, hybrid role where you'll act as both a technical consultant and a subject matter expert, guiding our enterprise clients through the entire implementation lifecycle. You won't just be configuring software; you'll be solving complex business problems and enabling the energy transition.

Your role will focus on taking a new client from the initial sale to a fully operational system. This includes:

  • Requirements Gathering and Analysis: You'll meet with clients to deeply understand their specific business needs, data sources, and operational processes. You'll translate these high-level requirements into detailed technical specifications for our engineering and delivery teams.

  • System Configuration and Design: You'll lead the technical configuration of the Kaluza platform, aligning it with the client's operational model and regulatory requirements. This involves customising parameters, dashboards, reports, and workflows to ensure a perfect fit.

  • Data Integration and Migration: A critical part of this role, you'll be responsible for integrating the client's existing data systems with our platform. You'll work with APIs and data pipelines, build and manage ETL processes, and ensure historical data is migrated accurately and securely.

  • Testing and Quality Assurance: In close collaboration with our Quality Assurance teams, you'll develop and execute test plans to ensure the implemented solution performs flawlessly. You will validate data accuracy, test system performance, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

  • Client Training and Enablement: You'll empower client teams by providing comprehensive training and creating detailed user guides. You'll also serve as the primary technical point of contact, troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise during the implementation phase.

  • Project Management Support: You will work alongside our Programme Managers, providing the technical expertise needed to develop project timelines, manage key deliverables, and proactively identify and mitigate technical risks.

About You 

You are a hands-on, analytical problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You have a passion for detail and a proven ability to translate complex client needs into practical, scalable solutions. You are comfortable working with large, diverse datasets and possess a strong understanding of how enterprise systems function.

Ideally, you'll have/be:

  • Proven Implementation Experience: Hands-on experience in a similar role, successfully implementing enterprise-level SaaS solutions for B2B clients.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working with large datasets, APIs, and ETL processes, with a strong understanding of the core principles of data integration and migration.

  • Business Analysis & Requirements Management: Strong business analysis skills, with experience eliciting, analysing, documenting, validating and prioritising complex business and technical requirements. Confident using a range of requirements-gathering techniques, including stakeholder interviews, workshops, process mapping, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria. Able to translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements, identify gaps and dependencies, manage requirements traceability, and support stakeholders through solution design, testing and implementation.

  • Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Skilled at engaging business and technical stakeholders, facilitating requirements and solution workshops, challenging assumptions, resolving ambiguity and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Process & Solution Analysis: Able to understand current-state business processes, define future-state requirements, perform gap and impact analysis, and work collaboratively with product and engineering teams to shape practical solutions.

  • A Problem-Solving Mindset: A natural curiosity and an enthusiastic drive for continuous improvement. Motivated by the challenge of breaking down complex problems and finding pragmatic, scalable solutions.

  • Business Acumen: Experience working with enterprise technology systems and a strong understanding of how technology, data and business processes interact to support operational and commercial outcomes.

  • Proficiency in French: Since this role is based in Paris and serves a European market, fluency in French is essential to engage effectively with our clients.

What will set you apart

  • Experience in the Energy Sector: While not essential, prior experience with energy-related data systems (e.g., MDMS, billing systems) or an understanding of the energy industry will be a significant advantage.

  • Client-Facing Excellence: You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted technical advisor to clients, building strong relationships, and managing expectations throughout a project.

  • The Big Picture Thinker: A deep curiosity about how a client’s business works, allowing you to develop solutions that don’t just fix a problem but fundamentally transform their operations.

  • A work ethic and style that brings people and teams together to achieve more than the sum of individual parts. 

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

descriptionHtml:
Über innovIT AG

Die innovIT AG denkt Rechenzentren neu: schneller geplant, modular aufgebaut und technisch präzise umgesetzt. Hinter unseren Lösungen steht ein Team mit mehr als 15 Jahren Erfahrung in Planung, Bau und Betrieb von Rechenzentren – alle Gewerke kommen aus dem eigenen Haus.

Unsere Rechenzentren entstehen in Modulen aus Stahl. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der aus unseren Grundrissen fertigungsreife Pläne macht – und der dabei mit KI arbeiten will statt gegen sie.

  • Du setzt unsere Grundrisse für Rechenzentren in eine durchgängige Planung um.

  • Eine technische Zeichnerin arbeitet dir nach deinen Vorgaben zu.

  • Du erkennst Kollisionen, Lücken und Widersprüche selbst und sprichst sie an, bevor sie in der Fertigung landen.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI: Claude steuert bei uns AutoCAD – du gibst die Richtung vor, prüfst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst die Arbeitsweise mit.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung als Technischer Systemplaner (Stahl- und Metallbautechnik), Techniker Stahl- oder Metallbau oder Studium Bauingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Konstruktion

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Werk- und Fertigungsplanung im Stahl-, Modul- oder Containerbau

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Home-Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch

Ein Plus – und wenn nicht, lernst du es bei uns: Erfahrung mit TGA-Trassen, Rechenzentren, AutoLISP oder Skripten.

Das bieten wir

  • Hier planst du, was gerade die Welt bewegt: Rechenzentren für KI und Datenanalyse – modular, energieeffizient und jedes Projekt anders

  • Komplett remote: du arbeitest von zu Hause, Termine vor Ort nur bei Bedarf

  • Eine Zeichnerin, die dir zuarbeitet – du konzentrierst dich auf die Konstruktion

  • KI im CAD als gelebter Alltag, nicht als Zukunftsmusik

  • Ein erfahrenes Team aus Infrastruktur- und RZ-Spezialisten mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Moderne Ausstattung mit Laptop und Smartphone

  • Weiterbildung und langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Technologiefeld

descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Thermal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

We are looking for a skilled Thermal Engineer with experience in spacecraft thermal management at both the subsystem and spacecraft level.

You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team - including mechanical, propulsion, electronics, and mission planning - to ensure reliable thermal performance of our satellite throughout all mission phases: from launch to operation in orbit and end-of-life.

You should be capable of delivering a thermal control system from scratch and taking full ownership of it, ensuring the success of our mission.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform steady-state and transient thermal analysis of the spacecraft across all mission phases (TVAC testing, launch, orbit).

  • Model and validate heat management strategies in the harsh environment of vacuum, where conduction and radiation are dominant

  • Identify and manage worst-case scenarios in extreme thermal conditions (both hot and cold), accounting for on-orbit environmental factors and internal power dissipation

  • Design and implement thermal control solutions such as multilayer insulation (MLI), radiators, heaters, thermo-optical coatings, thermistors, and thermal straps

  • Develop and support thermal vacuum (TVAC) test procedures, instrumentation setup, and post-test data analysis.

  • Be hands on in hardware testing for validation of processes, instrumentation, and materials and components chosen for in house developments

Fundamental Requirements

  • Solid understanding of thermal engineering principles in the context of spacecraft systems.

  • Hands-on experience with thermal simulation tools such as Systema, Thermal Desktop, ESATAN, or equivalent.

  • Experience with environmental and lab testing (TVAC, thermal cycling, AIT process
    validation).

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative development environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience designing or testing spacecraft thermal systems.

  • Exposure to multidisciplinary space system development or mission analysis.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: UX Researcher
descriptionHtml:
UX Researcher 

  • Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

  • Team: UX

  • Salary: £58,000 - £70,000

  • Contract: Permanent

  • Reporting To: UX Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Hands-on research

  • Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations

  • Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse

  • Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment

Research enablement and operations

  • Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods

  • Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves

  • Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research

  • Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us

  • Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how

  • Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve

  • Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods

  • Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy

  • Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team

What will set you apart 

  • You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight

  • You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)

  • You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Venture Scout
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Venture Scout to find companies worth our diligence, and to open relationships with investors who back private companies directly.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. It is for people who bring in deals on their own. You bring founders from your own network who are raising, learn what makes their companies worth an investor's time, and bring the strongest to Pairs.

Most of the work is first contact done well. You write to founders and investors in a way that earns a reply, turn those replies into calls, and bring the right ones into the network.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about direct investors, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to the conversations, and to learning which companies and investors are ready.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. Drive and judgement matter more to us than years in a seat.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Company sourcing. Founders raising Series A and later, found early and brought to Pairs with the context our team needs.

  • First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

  • Investor research. Who is investing right now, in what, at what stage and cheque size.

  • Your growing network. Every founder and investor you open, kept current and qualified. The network you build here is yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Already have an active network of founders you can bring to the table, built through an accelerator, a VC role, a startup community or your own work.

  • Can write a short, specific message to a stranger that gets a reply.

  • Keep your pace high without letting quality slip, and follow a process without needing a reminder.

  • Understand the basics of a round: stage, cheque size, SAFE versus priced, and why an investor passes.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor or company names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • Room to grow into a Venture Partner role as your network grows

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation: $90K – $150K

  • • Total Compensation $90K – $150K

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

  • Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
  • Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
  • Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
  • Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
  • Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
  • Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
  • Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
  • Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
  • Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
  • Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
  • Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
  • Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
  • Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
  • Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: VP of Product & Engineering - Back of House
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.

You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.

Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.

What You Would Do

  • Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.
  • Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.
  • Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.
  • Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.
  • Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means going beyond using AI to move faster yourself. You'll decide where AI belongs in the Back of House product, understand the underlying models and infrastructure well enough to make real engineering calls about them, and have already shipped something where AI was a core part of the product, not a feature added on afterwards.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What You Would Bring

  • Combined Product and Engineering ownership at VP level, with clear, end-to-end ownership of a complex, multi-service product domain.
  • A track record running globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.
  • Experience operating inside a scaling SaaS business, ideally Series C through pre-IPO or recently public, as an operator rather than an adviser.
  • Effective people leadership: managing managers, developing senior ICs, and building healthy team cultures at scale, plus a track record of improving reliability, performance and technical debt without stopping delivery.
  • AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped AI as a genuine part of a product, not just used it to speed up your own workflow.

Nice To Have 

  • Hands-on experience in hospitality technology: PMS, POS, channel management, revenue management, or closely adjacent systems.
  • Travel tech experience (airlines, GDS, travel management companies), or comparable operationally critical, high-availability B2B platforms.
  • Founder or early-stage builder experience, having built products from zero to scale.

Local benefits

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: VP Sales
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance.

You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Win and close contracts: Lead high-value deals with governments and large space organisations, from first conversation through to signature.

  • Own the full sales cycle: Sourcing, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close - across every stage.

  • Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators.

  • Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events.

  • Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments.

  • Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire.

  • Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry.

  • Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

descriptionHtml:
VP of Technical Marketing – PQShield

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

Location: [Remote / UK / US] ·You must have the right to work in one the above countries in order to be considered for the role. 

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a VP of Technical Marketing to make PQShield the technology and the brand the industry thinks of first for post-quantum security.

You will be the commercial team's technical voice in the market. You'll build the solutions and partnerships that help our sales team grow the pipeline, develop the semiconductor ecosystem around our IP, and lead technical thought leadership with customers, partners, standards bodies, and industry analysts.

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, semiconductor companies, OEMs, and system builders across automotive, defense, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise face a hard and urgent transition. This role puts PQShield at the center of that transition — through the partners who build with our IP, the solutions customers deploy, and the industry relationships that shape how the market moves.

This is a senior role for someone who combines a security IP background with deep industry relationships, and who knows how to turn both into revenue.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

  • Build solutions that grow pipeline: Create reference solutions, joint offerings, and use-case packages that give sales clear, repeatable ways into accounts. Combine PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib with partner technology into solutions customers can adopt quickly.

  • Develop the semiconductor ecosystem: Build and manage relationships with semiconductor suppliers, foundries, EDA and IP partners, processor and security-subsystem providers, and design services firms. Make PQShield IP the default choice for PQC in their roadmaps, reference designs, and platforms.

  • Drive partnerships that create demand: Identify, structure, and launch technical partnerships that open new markets and channels. Own the technical case for each partnership and ensure it produces pipeline, not just announcements.

  • Lead technical thought leadership: Be the senior technical voice of the commercial team. Speak at industry conferences, brief analysts and press, author white papers and technical articles, and represent PQShield in standards and industry forums.

  • Use industry relationships to build the brand: Leverage your network across semiconductors, security, and system OEMs to establish PQShield as the key technology and brand for post-quantum security.

  • Arm the commercial team technically: Give sales, FAEs, and partners the technical narratives, architectures, competitive positioning, and solution content they need to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Shape the market narrative: Define how the industry thinks about the post-quantum transition, cryptographic agility, side-channel and fault-injection protection, and certification (FIPS 140-3, SESIP, Common Criteria, ISO 26262) — and where PQShield fits.

  • Lead technical launches: Plan and deliver the technical go-to-market for new products, certifications, reference designs, and partner integrations.

  • Bring the market back in: Feed customer, partner, and competitive insight into product and engineering so our roadmap stays ahead of where the market is heading.

  • Build the team: Hire and lead a technical marketing team as the role scales.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

We will measure this role on the following deliverables:

  • Reference designs: Deliver 2 PQShield reference designs on widely used MCUs or SoCs, built with silicon partners and used in active sales opportunities.

  • Semiconductor ecosystem: Sign 5 ecosystem partners, such as silicon vendors, EDA and IP partners, or design services firms, that include PQShield IP in their roadmaps, reference designs or platforms.

  • Joint roadmap meetings and OEM requirements: Run 10 joint roadmap meetings that bring together an OEM, its silicon supplier and PQShield, and secure 5 OEM letters or RFQs that ask silicon suppliers for PQC capability.

  • Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A test-and-learn culture with senior support: Bamby brings nearly 20 years of product and growth leadership. You'll get autonomy on execution and direct access to someone who has built products at scale — a combination that's harder to find than it sounds.

You’ll report to Sarah, Lead Product Manager for our Website. Sarah joined Qonto in 2021 as a Senior Product Manager and stepped up as interim Head of Website in 2023. Before Qonto, she built digital products at Sodexo and BNP Paribas.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und erzähl uns kurz von einem technischen Projekt, an dem du selbst gearbeitet hast. Das kann aus dem Studium, Formula Student, einem Praktikum, einer Ausbildung oder einem eigenen Projekt stammen. Uns interessiert:

title: Working Student - Flight Test & Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
We are an innovative aerospace startup seeking a Working Student - Flight Test & Manufacturing to join our team and who is curious about new technologies for our our cutting-edge drone. At Maple Aviation we develop a unique Tail-Sitter Drone, that flies with one propeller only and is controlled in position via a flap-thrust-vectoring system. In this role, you will work closely with our research and development team to test drone prototypes from concept to final production. In this role you will be responsible to support Flight Test execution and leverage our manufcaturing machines, covering classic workshop machines, high quality 3D-printing and advanced aerospace foams and composites to produce parts for our drone. You will assemble and maintain our drone for flight tests and will be deeply involved in optimization together with the design team and flight control system team. We are looking for hobby tinkerer which have long experience in building and flying i.e. model aeroplanes, robots, cars etc.

Tasks

  • Flight test our drone based on Ardupilot and PX4
  • Flight test preparation, including HW and SW readiness checks
  • Manufacturing of drone parts
  • Assembly of drone parts incl. HW assembly, spot welding of batteries, soldering of electrical components
  • Design and Process improvement
  • Deeply involved in development acitivites across the team

Requirements

  • BA Sc., in mechanical, aerospace, robotics, automotive, electric engineering or related field
  • 3 + years of hands on experience in hobby tinkering, such as model aircraft, cars, robots, etc.
  • Very good knowledge in the field of mechanics and ideally electronics
  • Experience with Px4/Ardupilot flight controller
  • Interested in model aircraft construction, drones or robotics and can't wait to

implement and try out new ideas.

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility forward

independently. You teach us new things that holistically improve our team

and make it more efficient.

  • We are an international team communicating in English (other language skills

are also an advantage).

Benefits

We offer flexible working hours in a dynamic and innovative work environment in the heart of the TUM startup world in the TUM Venture Labs in Ottobrunn, where you can grow your career in the exciting field of aerospace engineering. If you are passionate about designing cutting-edge technology and want to work with a dynamic team of engineers and researchers, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to join our team!

title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Pre Sales Support
descriptionHtml:
As a leading global software product company in the field of Compliance & Automation, ITMF Group develop cutting-edge RegTech solutions with a focus on Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud. We are dedicated to automating manual processes using Machine Learning and Data Science, ensuring our clients have the most efficient and effective compliance solutions in the market.

We value innovation, excellence, and continuous learning at IMTF Group. We provide a dynamic, collaborative work environment where your ideas will be heard, and your skills will be put to the test.

As a Working Student, you will support our Pre-Sales team in preparing presentations, demos and proposals that showcase the value of our compliance solutions to potential clients.

Responsibilities

  • Support the Pre-Sales team in preparing product presentations and demonstrations, e.g. slides, demo scenarios and test data
  • Assist in responding to requests for information (RFIs) and requests for proposals (RFPs) by researching information, compiling answers and maintaining our response library
  • Help keep our demo environments up-to-date, including creating test data and checking new product features after releases
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, training materials and presentation templates
  • Support proof of concept projects, e.g. with data preparation and documentation of results
  • Conduct market and competitor research in the field of RegTech, Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud
  • Document customer feedback and prepare it for the product development team

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s program in Business Informatics, Business Administration with a focus on Finance/Banking, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Interest in software and technology; interest in the financial sector or compliance topics is a plus
  • Structured and accurate way of working, with the ability to quickly familiarize yourself with complex topics
  • Confident use of MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Good communication skills, team spirit and a proactive attitude
  • First practical experience from an internship or student job is an advantage, but not a must
  • Fluent in both German and English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus

Benefits

  • Make the World Safer: Contribute to preventing financial crime and help our customers create a safer world.
  • Be Part of an Established RegTech: Make a difference at a leading RegTech company in Switzerland.
  • International Exposure: Expand your horizons by working with international customers on various challenging projects and markets in a dynamic, multicultural team.
  • Ownership and Development: Make an impact and develop yourself by taking on significant ownership and responsibility from the beginning.
  • Paid Further Education: Take advantage of opportunities for paid further education to enhance your skills and career growth.

The anticipated salary for a Working Student – Pre Sales Support in Bensheim, Germany is EUR 18.000 gross per year based on a 20 hours working week (50 % employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral components of our organizational culture, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our team.

title: Working student SAP CoC  (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Flexible working hours

  • Various home office options

  • Personal development and further training

  • Excellent health management

  • Fitness pass in cooperation with Hanse Fit

  • Excellent company restaurant and free drinks (coffee, water)

  • Company parking spaces with charging facilities for electric vehicles

  • Various discounts as part of Benify Benefits (Apple, Nike, Dell, Zalando, etc.)

Your tasks: 📌

  • Support testing activities in SAP ECC and SAP S/4 environments

  • Document incidents and user stories, with a focus on identifying recurring issues and trends

  • Process standard changes (service requests)

  • Identify IT-related challenges and develop suitable solution approaches

  • Support the preparation and follow-up of workshops, meetings, and research activities

  • Contribute to user management concepts and depending on experience level, support ABAP programming analyses

Your profile: 🔎

  • Interest in SAP, business processes, and digitalization

  • Initial experience with SAP applications; ABAP knowledge or SAP certification is a plus

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks after the onboarding phase

  • Very good German and English language skills, both written and spoken

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:

https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/

The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG).
